October 19, 1933.    Morning Translation

LABOUR.
Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

The Staff Members "Go-slow" Strike Committee
of the Shanghai Power Company Staff Members & Workers
Mutual Benefit Society yesterday issued the following
letter addressed to the public:-
"No fewer than 10 labour disputes have
arisen in the Shanghai Power Company since the
Electricity Department of the Shanghai Municipal
Council was taken over by the Company. The disputes
arose as a result of the oppression of employees by
the management. The capitalists have oppressed,
assaulted and dismissed Chinese employees without cause
and these actions have aroused the anger of the 2,000
workers who intend to struggle and to put up a stern
resistance to the capitalists in order to prove that
the Chinese employees cannot be treated like dogs and
assaulted with impunity. Therefore, the staff members
decided to join the "go-slow" movement on October 11(?).
Unexpectedly, the Company used its premises as a food
shop and hotel in order to induce the staff members
to resume work and after several days passed by, this
ruse was successful. We regret that these staff members
have neither strength of character, public spirit or
conscience. We will maintain our firm attitude to the
bitter end and unite together to cope with these
renegades. We still have the support of about 40
staff members, who have the courage of their convictions."

At 3 p.m. yesterday, the General Labour Union
entertained about 40 local newspapermen and afterwards
issued the following manifesto:-
"We realize that the electric supply is a
public utility which is of great importance to the
community. We have advised the workers to maintain
the distribution of electricity in order that the
subscribers may not be affected and have made a detailed
report to the public asking for a fair trial.
"Recently, the Company has engaged a large
number of white Russians to replace the Chinese workers
on strike. Such action aggravates the strikers, and
it is evident that the Company does not intend to settle
the dispute. Should the dispute remain unsettled, it
is to be expected that untoward incidents will occur
which will affect the property and peace of the public.
"The present dispute arose through the
dismissal by the management of 3 workers, but many
dismissals and the refusal of the Company to pay just
gratuities during the past few years have induced the
workers to adopt a firm attitude.
"Since the electric supply is an enterprise
closely connected with the prosperity of the public
and peace and order in the community, we should
settle the dispute, thereby preventing the outbreak of
more unfortunate incidents. Our efforts have been
unsuccessful. We ask the public to give a just verdict
and we will abide by it."

劳工事务。
《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳资局势。

上海电力公司职员与工人互益会的职员“怠工”罢工委员会昨日发出以下致公众信：
“自上海工部局电气处由该公司接管以来，上海电力公司发生的劳资纠纷不下十起。这些纠纷是由于管理层压迫雇员所致。资本家无故压迫、殴打并解雇中国雇员，这些行为激怒了2,000名工人，他们决心进行斗争，对资本家进行严厉抵抗，以证明中国雇员不能被当作狗一样对待且受辱而无需付出代价。因此，职员们决定于10月11日(?)加入‘怠工’运动。出乎意料的是，公司利用其场所作为食堂和旅馆，以诱使职员复工，数日后，这一诡计得逞。我们遗憾这些职员既无骨气，又无公德心或良知。我们将坚持坚定态度到底，并团结起来对付这些叛徒。我们仍有约40名职员的支援，他们坚信自己的信念是正确的。”

昨日下午3时，总工会招待了约40名本地报界人士，随后发表如下宣言：
“我们认识到电力供应是对社区至关重要的一项公用事业。我们已建议工人维持电力分配，以免用户受到影响，并向公众提交详细报告，请求公正裁决。
“最近，公司雇佣了大量白俄人以替代罢工的中国工人。此举加剧了罢工者的愤怒，显然公司无意解决争端。如果争端仍未解决，预计将发生不幸事件，影响公众财产与安宁。
“目前的争端起因于管理层解雇3名工人，但过去几年中的多次解雇以及公司拒绝支付合理的遣散费，促使工人采取坚定态度。
“鉴于电力供应是与公众繁荣及社区和平秩序密切相关的企业，我们应解决争端，从而防止更多不幸事件的发生。我们的努力未能成功。我们请求公众给出公正的裁决，我们将服从该裁决。”

China Times, Chen Pao and other local newspapers.

LETTER FROM THE SHANGHAI GENERAL LABOUR UNION
TO THE S.M.C.

Fearing that the strike in the Shanghai
Power Company might seriously affect the public, this
union has made every effort to settle the trouble.
Although representatives of political organizations,
such as Mr. Wong Siao Lai, chairman of the Shanghai
Chamber of Commerce, Mr. Yuan Li Tung and Mr. Lee
Sin Loh, Chinese councillors of the Shanghai Municipal
Council have submitted proposals to the company, the
company refused to accept them and maintained their
attitude. The company also paid no heed to the
proposals of Mr. Jones, Secretary of your council
which followed the petition of the workers. The
workers were obliged to declare a "Go-slow" strike
as a protest to the company's actions. The strike
took place owing to the company declaring a lockout.
In accordance with the advice of this union the
distribution hands are still working and public order
has not been affected. We cannot guarantee that
distribution will be maintained. Therefore this union
held a conference with leaders of the society and
asked them to preserve peace and order. Up to the
present the company has no definite policy and has
done nothing except publish a letter containing
false statements. There can be no doubt that the
company intends to ignore the advice of this union.
As the council is responsible for maintaining peace in
the municipality you should give your whole attention
to the matter, and carefully examine the letter addressed
to the various bodies and the reply to the workers of
this union. This union has done its utmost to
persuade the workers to modify their demands, and
should the company refuse to accept these it is
evident that the company refused to consider public
right and municipal administration.

《申报》及其他本地报纸（10月17日）：

上海电力公司为已复工的职员购买了120张床铺，以便他们在厂内住宿，此外，还每天从某餐馆订购40桌饭菜，每桌费用3.50元，供上述员工食用。
职员“怠工”罢工委员会委员苏日新（Sou Jih-hsin，音译）和叶桂平（Yih Kwei-ping，音译），以及委员会指定的秘密监察员陈景洛（Chen Ching-loh，音译）、戴凤冈（Tsi Foong-kong，音译）、梅卓邦（Mei Choh-bong，音译）、徐星三（Soo Shing-san，音译）、纪清孙（Zee Ching-sun，音译）、郭宝孙（Kwoh Pao-sun，音译）和黄良元（Wong Liang-yuen，音译）等约290余人，于今晨复工。

《字林西报》、《申报》及其他本地报纸。

上海总工会致工部局函。

鉴于上海电力公司的罢工可能严重影响公众，本工会已尽一切努力解决此次纠纷。尽管诸如上海总商会主席王晓籁先生、工部局华籍董事袁履登先生和李生乐先生等政治组织代表已向公司提交提案，但公司拒绝接受并维持其原有态度。公司也未理会贵局秘书琼斯先生（Mr. Jones）在工人请愿后提出的建议。工人被迫宣布实行“怠工”罢工，以抗议公司的行为。罢工是由于公司宣布闭厂（lockout）而引发的。根据本工会的建议，配电人员仍在继续工作，公共秩序未受影响。我们无法保证配电工作能持续维持。因此，本工会与社会领袖举行会议，要求他们维护和平与秩序。截至目前，公司尚无明确政策，除了发表一封包含虚假陈述的信件外，无所作为。毫无疑问，公司意图无视本工会的建议。由于董事会负责维持市政区的和平，你们应全力关注此事，并仔细审查致各团体的信件以及本工会给工人的回复。本工会已竭尽全力劝说工人修改其要求，如果公司拒绝接受这些要求，显然表明公司拒绝考虑公众权利和市政管理。

5310 Shanghai Power Company - situation

The situatio in the Shanghai Power Company
has not materially changed during the past 24 hours.
Some 300 workers of the Chapei Water and
Electricity Company who are members of the 6th
District Water & Electricity Workers' Union have
arranged with the Management of the Company to
advance to them a sum equivalent to one day's wages.
The sum raised in this way, which amounts to about $300,
will be contributed to the strikers of the Shanghai
Power Company.

At 10.30 a.m. October 18, four Chinese representing
the 6th District Water and Electricity Workers' Uni...
called at the office of the Strike Committee of the
workers of the Shanghai Power Company at 15 Shou Yi..g
- Fang, Tien Doong Road, Chapei, for the purpose of
conveying their sympathy to the strikers.

Four committee members of the General Labour
Union held a meeting in their office, 117 Fuh Yeu
Road, City, between 1.15 and 2 p.m. October 18.
Chu Hsueh Fan (朱学范), one of the number, presided.
The following resolutions were discussed and passed:-

1. That a manifesto be issued urging Chinese members
of the S.M.C. to endeavour to settle the strike
in the Shanghai Power Company.

2. That Chu Hsueh Fan (朱学范) and Chao She Pei (邵虚白),

of persuading Chinese members of the S.M.C. to take
action which will bring about a settlement of the
strike in the Shanghai Power Company.

3. 通知上海电力公司（原文误作 Shang ai Power Company）的罢工者在罢工解决谈判进行期间保持和平与秩序。

1. 罢工代表向上海总商会提出的呼吁得到了同情性的回应。

of three leaflets were then distributed among the attendance.
The first leaflet contains a manifesto issued by the
General Labour Union, dated October 18. This manifesto
announces that the Union has succeeded in dissuading
the shift workers of the Shanghai Power Company from
joining the strike, and consequently the public need not
fear that they will be deprived of electricity. It
states that the Management of the Company deserves con-
demnation for the stubborn attitude it has assumed towards
the dispute, and emphasizes the importance of settling
the strike without delay, in order to ensure that nothing
untoward happens. The manifesto concludes by stating
that the public should make a vigorous effort to compel
the Company to agree to negotiate for a settlement of the
trouble.

The second leaflet contains what purports to be a
copy of a letter addressed to the Shanghai Municipal Council
by the General Labour Union. This letter states that
untoward incidents may occur if the Shanghai Power Company
persists in maintaining a stubborn attitude towards the
present strike and urges the Council to endeavour to effect
a settlement of the dispute.

The third leaflet contains an appeal which purports
to have emanated from the General Labour Union and to be
addressed to various local circles. A translation of this
appeal was attached to the Daily Intelligence Summary XX
of October 11 as an appendix.
page_data.zh:
1933年10月19日。

劳工 (7)

随后在与会者中分发了三种传单。
第一种传单包含总工会于10月18日发布的宣言。该宣言宣布，总工会已成功劝阻上海电力公司的轮班工人加入罢工，因此公众无需担心电力供应中断。宣言指出，公司管理层在纠纷中采取顽固态度，理应受到谴责，并强调必须迅速解决罢工，以确保不发生任何意外事件。宣言最后指出，公众应大力施压，迫使公司同意就解决此事进行谈判。

第二种传单包含一封据称是总工会致上海公共租界工部局的信件副本。该信指出，如果上海电力公司坚持对当前罢工采取顽固态度，可能会发生意外事件，并敦促工部局设法解决纠纷。

第三种传单包含一份据称出自总工会并致当地各界的呼吁书。该呼吁书的译文曾作为附件附在10月11日的《每日情报摘要 XX》之后。

October 18, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

With reference to the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company, the General Labour Union detailed Chu Hsueh-vai to interview Mr. Yu Yah-ching, Chinese member of the Shanghai Municipal Council, and request him to act as mediator in the dispute. It is understood that the request was accepted and Mr. Yu Ych-ching would submit proposals after he had discussed the matter with Yuan Lee-tung, Pei Soong-sun and other Chinese members of the Council.

The "Go-slow" Strike Committee of the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union yesterday morning held a meeting in the premises of the General Labour Union at which about 100 foremen were present. It was resolved that the "go-slow" strike be continued and that no work be resumed until their object be attained.

With a view to enabling the public to understand the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company, the General Labour Union will entertain local newspapermen at 3 p.m. to-day in the Dah Sie Yang (大西洋) Restaurant, Foochow Road.

It is reported that the Federation of Various Fellow Provincials Associations called a joint meeting at 8 p.m. yesterday in the premises of the Ningpo Fellow Provincials Association, Thibet Road, to discuss the situation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE B.A.T. 3RD FACTORY.

At 5.30 a.m. yesterday, the 3,500 workers of the British-American Tobacco Company's 3rd Factory entered the premises as usual, but owing to the fact that the demands submitted by them had not been accepted by the management, they refused to carry on operations. The workers were then driven out of the premises by a foreign overseer of the factory. At 1 p.m., the hands intended to gain entry into the premises but were unable to do so as the gate of the factory was closed and guarded by policemen and detectives.

At 10 a.m. yesterday, the Social Bureau held a meeting at which representatives of the workers only were present. The meeting produced no result and the Bureau instructed the workers to resume work first, and then to await a settlement.

At a joint meeting held at 2 p.m. yesterday by the Executive and the Supervisory Committees of the 4th District Rolled Tobacco Trade Workers Union, the following resolutions were passed:-

劳工。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

关于上海电力公司的劳资纠纷，总工会派遣朱学范（Chu Hsueh-vai，注：此处原文拼写为 vai，前文为 fan，应为同一人朱学范）会见上海公共租界工部局华董余雅清（Yu Yah-ching，音译）先生，请求他担任纠纷调解人。据悉，该请求已被接受，余雅清先生在与袁履登（Yuan Lee-tung，音译）、贝淞荪（Pei Soong-sun，音译）及其他华董讨论此事后将提出建议。

第四区水电业工会“怠工”罢工委员会昨日上午在总工会会所举行会议，约有100名领班出席。会议决定继续“怠工”罢工，在目标达成之前不复工。

为了让公众了解上海电力公司的劳资纠纷，总工会将于今日下午3时在福州路大西洋餐厅（Dah Sie Yang）宴请本地新闻记者。

据报道，各同乡会联合会昨晚8时在西藏路宁波同乡会会所召开联席会议，讨论局势。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草公司第三厂的劳工局势。

昨日上午5时30分，英美烟草公司第三厂的3500名工人照常进入厂区，但由于他们提出的要求未被管理层接受，他们拒绝继续作业。随后，工人们被一名外籍监工赶出厂区。下午1时，工人们试图进入厂区，但未能成功，因为工厂大门紧闭，并由警察和侦探把守。

昨日上午10时，社会局举行会议，仅有工人代表出席。会议未产生结果，社会局指示工人先复工，然后等待解决方案。

October 18/8, 1933

Labour

Foh Lun Silk Filature - workers resume

All the workers of the Foh Lun Silk Filature,
558 Tien Pao Road, Chapei, resumed work this morning,
October 18 as a result of a promise made by the Social
Bureau that it would ask the Filature Owners' Association
to reconsider its decision about reducing the wages of
operatives in silk filatures. This strike started on
October 8 as a protest against the reduction in wages
mentioned, and affected 450 workers.

Shanghai Power Company - Situation

There has been no material change in the situation
at the Shanghai Power Company during the past 24 hours.

The General Labour Union has arranged to entertain
local journalists at 2 p.m. October 18 in the Dah Si Yang
Restaurant, 323 Foochow Road, to discuss matters connected
with the strike in the Power Company.

At 10.30 a.m. October 17, some 40 foremen and
50 workers of the Shanghai Power Company assembled in
the office of the General Labour Union, 117 Foh Yeu
Road, City. Pao Teh-foh (包德福), member of the
Strike Committee of the 4th District Water and Electricity
Workers' Union, addressed the attendance and expressed a
hope that the strikers would persist in the movement to
the bitter end and would not allow themselves to be

1933年10月18日

劳工

佛伦丝厂 - 工人复工

闸北天宝路558号佛伦丝厂（Foh Lun Silk Filature）的所有工人于10月18日上午复工，这是因为社会局承诺将要求丝厂业主公会重新考虑其关于降低丝厂操作工工资的决定。此次罢工始于10月8日，以抗议上述减薪，受影响工人达450名。

上海电力公司 - 局势

在过去24小时内，上海电力公司的局势未发生实质性变化。

总工会安排于10月18日下午2时在福州路323号大西洋餐厅（Dah Si Yang Restaurant）宴请本地记者，讨论与电力公司罢工有关的事项。

10月17日上午10时30分，约40名领班和50名上海电力公司工人在市内福州路117号总工会办事处集会。第四区水电工会罢工委员会委员包德福（Pao Teh-foh）向与会者发表讲话，表示希望罢工者将运动坚持到底，不要让自己被

page_data.en:
October 18, 3.

Labour (2)

misled by propaganda which is being circulated by
reactionary elements. Chu Hsueh-fan (朱学范), a
Committee member of the General Labour Union, then
took the stand. Chu praised the workers of the Shanghai
Power Company and urged them to remain united. He
advised that the workers should remain on strike until
the employers offered reasonable concessions. The last
speaker was Nyi Wen-fu (倪文富), another member of
the Strike Committee. He denounced the clerical staff
for having resumed work, and expressed approval of the
assault committed upon Poh Zuh-sing (浦新). He
hoped that strikers whose loyalty towards the movement
was wavering would learn a lesson from this assault.

About twenty strikers of the Shanghai Power Company
including Pan Keng-ling (潘根林) and Chang Zang-sung
(張長生), called at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce,
North Soochow Road, at 2.30 p.m. October 17 and submitted
the following requests :-

1. That the Chamber take steps to prevent the Shanghai
Power Company from committing illegal acts.

2. That the Chamber negotiate with the Shanghai Power
Company for the payment of superannuation due to
the dismissed workers.

3. That the Shanghai Power Company be requested to give
an assurance that the superannuation will not be
withheld in future.

The callers were received by Zung Zeng-ching (鄭澄清),
a staff member of the Chamber, who promised to refer their
request to the Chairman. They then departed.
page_data.zh:
1933年10月18日。

劳工 (2)

反动分子散布的宣传所误导。随后，总工会委员朱学范（Chu Hsueh-fan）上台发言。朱赞扬了上海电力公司的工人，并敦促他们保持团结。他建议工人应继续罢工，直到雇主提供合理的让步。最后一位发言者是罢工委员会的另一名成员倪文富（Nyi Wen-fu）。他谴责职员阶层复工，并对袭击浦新（Poh Zuh-sing）的行为表示赞同。他希望那些对运动忠诚度动摇的罢工者能从这次袭击中吸取教训。

10月17日下午2时30分，包括潘根林（Pan Keng-ling）和张长生（Chang Zang-sung）在内的约二十名上海电力公司罢工者，前往北苏州路的上海总商会，提交了以下请求：-

1. 请商会采取措施，防止上海电力公司从事非法行为。

2. 请商会与上海电力公司谈判，支付被解雇工人应得的养老金。

3. 请上海电力公司保证今后不会扣留养老金。

来访者由商会职员郑澄清（Zung Zeng-ching）接待，他承诺将他们的请求转呈主席。随后他们离去。

page_data.en:
October 18, 3.

Labour (3)

Representatives of ten local Fellow Countrymen's
Associations together with a delegate of the General Labour
Union held a meeting in the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's
Association, 480 Thibet Road, between 8.50 p.m. and
10.p.m. October 17. The delegate of the General Labour
Union named Chu Hsueh-fan ( 朱學範 ) made a report on
the strike of the workers of the Shanghai Power Company
and declared that the General Labour Union had, so far,
succeeded in dissuading the strikers from resorting to
violence. The difficulties of the Union to have this
policy maintained were increasing, and there were
indications that the growing restiveness of the workers
would result in its abandonment in a few days if the
strike remained unsettled. He therefore hoped that the
public would assist the General Labour Union to maintain
discipline among the strikers and to induce the Company
to negotiate for a settlement of the strike. The
following resolutions were then discussed and passed :-
1. That letters be sent to the S.M.C. and the Shanghai Power
Company to settle the dispute as soon as possible.
2. That Messrs Yu Yah-ching ( 虞洽卿 ), Wong Shiao-lai,
Yuen Lu-tung ( 袁履登 ) and Hsu Singloh be requested
to accelerate the efforts they were making in the
interests of mediation.
3. That the 1st Special District Citizens' Federation
be requested to render assistance.
The meeting was presided over by the representative of
the Chaochow Fellow Countrymen's Association named Tsung
Tsung-tsui ( 鄭正秋 ).
page_data.zh:
10月18日，3。

劳工（3）

10月17日晚8时50分至10时之间，十个本地同乡会的代表以及总工会的一名代表在西藏路480号宁波同乡会举行会议。总工会代表朱学范就上海电力公司工人罢工一事作了报告，并宣称总工会迄今已成功劝阻罢工者诉诸暴力。然而，工会维持这一政策的困难日益增加，有迹象表明，如果罢工仍未解决，工人们日益增长的不安情绪将在几天内导致该政策被放弃。因此，他希望公众协助总工会维持罢工者的纪律，并促使公司进行谈判以解决罢工。随后讨论并通过了以下决议：
1. 致函工部局和上海电力公司，要求尽快解决纠纷。
2. 请虞洽卿、黄筱来、袁履登和徐星洛先生加速他们为调解所作的努力。
3. 请第一特区市民联合会提供协助。
会议由潮州同乡会代表郑正秋主持。

page_data.en:
October 18, 3.

Labour (4)

Copies of a notice entitled "News" dated October 17
were issued by the Strike Committee of the 4th District
Water and Electricity Workers' Union on October 17. A
translation of the contents made as follows :-

" According to information received, a number of
"boilers have broken down at the Riverside Power Station
"and are unfit for further use. Mr. Elmer, Chief
Boiler Engineer of the Power Station, considers the
"situation desperate, as all the foreign engineers are
"exhausted. The management fears that a complete
"breakdown will take place. This union has already
"devised suitable measures and will lodge a final
"warning with a view to awakening the management. We
"hope that you comrades will pay no attention to the
rumours and we expect you to struggle to the bitter end.
"Victory is sure to be ours in the next few days."

Ward Printing and Dyeing Company - transient "tai-kung"
strike

Between 1 and 2 p.m. October 17, workers numbering
100 of the Ward Printing & Dyeing Company, 1514 Ward
Road, went on "tai-kung" strike. This strike was
declared following the circulation of a rumour to the
effect that the management intended to close down the
concern and was called off when the management announced
that the report was an idle story.
page_data.zh:
10月18日，3。

劳工（4）

第四区水电工人 union 罢工委员会于10月17日发布了题为《消息》的通告副本，日期为10月17日。内容译文如下：

“据收到的消息，江边发电站有多台锅炉发生故障，已无法继续使用。发电站首席锅炉工程师埃尔默（Elmer）先生认为局势危急，因为所有外籍工程师均已精疲力竭。管理层担心会发生全面瘫痪。本工会已制定适当措施，并将发出最后警告，以唤醒管理层。希望各位同志不要理会谣言，我们期望你们斗争到底。胜利在几天后必属于我们。”

华德印染公司——临时性“怠工”罢工

10月17日下午1时至2时之间，位于华德路1514号的华德印染公司100名工人进行了“怠工”罢工。此次罢工是因流传着管理层打算关闭企业的谣言而发起的，当管理层宣布该报道纯属无稽之谈后，罢工即告取消。

Morning Translation 17/10/33

October 17, 1933.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE B.A.T. 3RD FACTORY.

Acting on instructions from the
Social Bureau and on the advice of the 4th District
Rolled Tobacco Trade Workers Union and the General
Labour Union, the 3,000 workers of the British-
American Tobacco 3rd Factory on Thorburn Road
yesterday morning proceeded to the factory to
resume work. Unexpectedly, the management refused
to allow them to resume.
About 300 representatives of workers
then attended an extraordinary meeting at 9 a.m.
yesterday at Ying-Siang-Kong at which the following
resolutions were passed:
1. That a "Go-slow" Strike Committee of 11
members be formed to deal with the dispute.
2. That the workers who are non-members of the
Union be also instructed to join the movement.
3. That no work be resumed unless the demands
of workers are accepted by the management.
4. That the "Go-slow" Strike Committee submit
a petition to the local Tangpu and the General
Labour Union for purposes of record.
It is learned that the Social Bureau
will hold a meeting at 10 a.m. to-day at which
representatives of the British-American Tobacco
Company and the workers will be present.

The China Evening News dated Oct. 16:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER CO.P.NY.

A fortnight has elapsed and the labour
trouble in the Shanghai Power Company remains
unsettled. Most of the Chinese staff members,
persuaded by the management have resumed work. Only
about 40 staff members are maintaining their original
attitude to act in concert with the 1,400 workers
who are on strike and have not been dissuaded by
the promises of the management.
It is reported that the Shanghai Power
Company Staff Members & Workers Mutual Benefit Society
and the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade
Workers Union are about to issue a joint manifesto
re the dispute.

The "Central China Daily News" reports that
at 7 p.m. yesterday, the electric supply failed in
the vicinity of Hongkew Market near Fearon Road and
Hanbury Road. The citizens became alarmed and stores
closed their doors and suspended business. The
failure was only temporary however lasting until
7.45 p.m.

1933年10月17日。

劳工。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

英美烟草三厂劳工状况。

根据社会局的指示，并在第四区卷烟业工人 union 和总工会的建议下，托伯恩路（Thorburn Road）英美烟草三厂的3000名工人于昨天上午前往工厂复工。出乎意料的是，管理层拒绝让他们复工。
随后，约300名工人代表于昨天上午9时在映象宫（Ying-Siang-Kong）参加了一次紧急会议，会上通过了以下决议：
1. 成立一个由11人组成的“怠工”罢工委员会来处理纠纷。
2. 指示非工会成员的工人也加入此次运动。
3. 除非管理层接受工人的要求，否则不恢复工作。

October 17, 1933.    Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

It is reported that the cause of the
failure was an explosion in the Transforming Room
of the old plant of the Shanghai Power Company.
As the workers of the plant were all on strike,
the repairs were delayed but were later completed

Shanghai Mercantile Press dated October 15 :

FIGHTING IN NANTAO

At 9.30 a.m. today a fight took place in
Nantao between workers of certain cloth weaving factories
and employees of the Wei Min Flash Lights and Battery
Factory, because the accountant of the latter factory
has issued an order forbidding the cloth weaving workers
in that locality to urinate near the premises of the
factory. This order aroused the anger of the workers.
About 200 of them armed with iron and wooden bars and
axes commenced to fight with workers of the battery
factory. A volunteer who was on duty went to the scene,
but he was stabbed by the cloth workers. The volunteer's
rifle was taken away by his assailants. Many others
were also injured. Upon learning of the incident the
police of the Second Division of the Public Safety Bureau
hurried to the scene, arrested ten persons and recovered
the rifle.

The Wei Min Flash Lights and Battery Factory
which is situated at 585 Ju Chen Zung Road, Nantao, is
managed by a member of the Nantao Volunteer Corps.
Some 60 male and female workers are employed in the
factory. As the factory is situated on a piece of
vacant ground, people often urinate near the gate way.
At 9.30 a.m. today, while the accountant of
the factory was pasting a notice forbidding this, he
observed a cloth worker, a resident of the Chin Sieu Li
Alleyway; Tse Zao Jao Road, urinating at the gate way
of the factory and a quarrel ensued. The workers of
the factory heard the quarrel and left their work.
The cloth weaving workers thinking that their comrade
was being ill treated by others, approached the factory
for the purpose of helping him.

It is learned that the workers of the cloth
weaving factories at Nos. 574 and 579 Chin Sieu Li
Alleyway, Tse Zao Jao Road, who are mostly natives of
Anhwei have recently organized an "Axe Gang" which
has a membership roll of several hundreds.

The injured persons have been removed to
hospital for treatment while the ten people who
were arrested have been escorted to the Bureau of
Public Safety.

10月15日的《上海商报》：

南市斗殴

今天上午9时30分，南市某些织布厂工人与维民手电筒电池厂员工之间发生斗殴，原因是后者工厂的会计发布命令，禁止该地区的织布工人在工厂附近小便。这一命令激怒了工人。约200名工人手持铁棍、木棒和斧头，开始与电池厂工人打斗。一名值勤的义勇队员赶到现场，但被织布工人刺伤。袭击者夺走了义勇队员的步枪。多人受伤。公安局第二分局警察获悉此事后迅速赶赴现场，逮捕了十人并追回了步枪。

维民手电筒电池厂位于南市居陈宗路（Ju Chen Zung Road，音译）585号，由一名南市区义勇队队员管理。工厂雇佣了约60名男女工人。由于工厂位于一块空地上，人们经常在大门口附近小便。
今天上午9时30分，当工厂会计正在张贴禁止此类行为的告示时，他观察到一名住在曹家角路（Tse Zao Jao Road，音译）金秀里（Chin Sieu Li，音译）弄堂的织布工人在工厂门口小便，随即发生争吵。工厂工人听到争吵声后离开了工作岗位。织布工人认为他们的同伴受到他人虐待，便前往工厂意图帮助他。

据悉，曹家角路金秀里弄堂574号和579号的织布厂工人大多是安徽籍，最近组织了一个“斧头帮”，成员名单达数百人。

伤者已被送往医院治疗，被捕的十人已被押送至公安局。

October 13, 1933.    Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

"Of late, newspapers report that the
"go-slow" strike in the Shanghai Power Company arose
through the frequent dismissal of workers by the
management. Owing to the firm attitude adopted by the
management, the labour situation has reached serious
dimensions. The question of the entire safety of the
community is at stake, and should any untoward incidents
occur, the citizens would be indirectly affected.
"The Council should pay attention to the
matter, otherwise the Council cannot evade responsibility
for any trouble which may arise although the blame should
be borne by the Shanghai Power Company.
"We hereby request you to order the Company
to affect an early settlement of the dispute."

The Kiangsu Fellow Provincials Association
yesterday sent the following letter to the S.M.C. :-
"Most of our members are subscribers of the
Shanghai Power Company. The present "go-slow" strike
arose through the bad treatment of workers by the Company,
and to date, the dispute which could have been easily
settled, has been spreading day by day as a result of the
obstinate attitude on the part of the Company.
"In consideration of the rights of the
subscribers, the workers are still maintaining the
distribution of electricity.
"The situation has been growing steadily
worse owing to the insincerity of the Company, and in the
event of the management failing to see reason in the
near future, the hands would be compelled to abandon the
maintenance of electricity distribution. Consequently,
untoward incidents might occur, thereby causing our members
to sustain business and other kinds of losses for which
the Company should be held to blame.
"The Council, being a supervisory organ, is
requested to place restrictions on the unreasonable delay
in a settlement by the Company so that our members may
not be affected."

劳工。

“近来，报纸报道上海电力公司发生的‘怠工’罢工，系因资方频繁解雇工人所致。由于资方采取强硬态度，劳资局势已趋于严重。整个社区的安全问题岌岌可危，若发生任何意外事件，市民将间接受到影响。
“工部局应关注此事，否则，尽管责任应由上海电力公司承担，但工部局无法推卸因可能引发的任何骚乱而产生的责任。
“兹请阁下命令该公司尽早解决此纠纷。”

江苏同乡会昨日致函工部局如下：
“本会会员多为上海电力公司的用户。此次‘怠工’罢工起因于该公司虐待工人，迄今，本可轻易解决的纠纷，因公司态度顽固而日益蔓延。
“考虑到用户的权益，工人们仍在维持电力供应。
“由于公司缺乏诚意，局势正稳步恶化，若资方在近期仍不明智行事，工人们将被迫放弃维持电力供应。因此，可能会发生意外事件，导致本会会员遭受商业及其他方面的损失，对此公司应承担责任。
“工部局作为监管机构，恳请对公司在解决纠纷上的无理拖延加以限制，以免本会会员受到影响。”

October 16, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

The 5th District Rolled Tobacco Trade
Workers Union detailed officials to submit an appeal
to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai to immediately
amend the Rules governing the administration of the
factories.
In a petition to the local Yangpu and
the Social Bureau, the Union reiterates that the
monthly expenses and allowances to the unemployed
workers should be taken from the membership fees
collected from the employed workers. In the event
of the collection of such fees being prohibited, the
Union would be dissolved. Furthermore, the collection
has been in force for many years. It is unreasonable
of the factories to interfere with the collection and
should they dismiss the workers who are collecting
the fees, untoward incidents might result. Finally,
the Union requested the authorities to submit fair
proposals immediately.

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY

It is over a fortnight since the commencement
of the strike of the workers employed at the Shanghai
Power Company.
Owing to the failure of the Management and
employees to come to terms, the situation remains serious.
The Company, however, has succeeded in inducing
a small number of the Chinese staff to resume their duties,
but as yesterday was a holiday, there were no developments
in the situation.
To combat the methods employed by the Management
to persuade the staff members to resume work, the "Shanghai
Power Company Staff Members and Workers Mutual Benefit
Society" in addition to advising some 30 staff members to
join the movement, ordered all strikers not to heed the
overtures by the Management and show a united front.
A report has it that the entire Chinese staff
will resume duty this morning, but this was denied by the
Mutual Benefit Society.

Min Pao Comment:

The dispute between the Management and employees
of the Shanghai Power Company has continued a fortnight.
Both sides are obstinate and refuse to make concessions.
Thus a deadlock has occurred in the negotiations.
Spectators cannot pass judgment on the case.
The Power Company, however, being a public utility enterprise
should sedulously guard the safety of the people. The public
should appreciate the efforts of the Shanghai Power Company
to maintain the supply of electricity in spite of difficul-
ties, but should the situation becomes worse, it is unlikely

在向当地杨浦分局和社会局提交的请愿书中，该工会重申，失业工人的月度开支和津贴应从在职工人缴纳的会费中支取。若禁止收取此类费用，工会将被解散。此外，此项收费已实行多年。工厂干涉收费是不合理的，若他们解雇负责收费的工人，可能会引发意外事件。最后，工会请求当局立即提出公正的建议。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳资局势

上海电力公司工人罢工已开始逾两周。
由于资方与员工未能达成协议，局势依然严峻。然而，公司已成功说服少数华籍职员复工，但因昨日为假日，局势未有新发展。

有报道称全体华籍职员将于今晨复工，但遭互益社否认。

POLITICAL.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:-

SIR MILES LAMPSON TO LEAVE FOR PEIPING TOMORROW

Sir Miles Lampson, British Minister to China has received an order from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Great Britain to proceed to Egypt to take up the duties of British Minister there. He left for Nanking two days ago and returned here yesterday having participated in the ceremonies of the Double Tenth Anniversary. He has booked two tickets for Peiping at the China National Aviation Cooperation. He intends to leave Shanghai for Peiping at 7 a.m. tomorrow accompanied by his secretary. At the beginning of next month he will proceed to Shanghai whence he will leave for Egypt by steamer.
The new Minister to China, Mr. Cadogan, will come to China at the end of this year.

MILITARY

Chen Pao and other local newspapers :-

LUNGWA GARRISON COMMISSION BANS RECRUITING

The Lungwa Garrison Commission has received the following telegram from General Chiang Kai Shek :-
"There will be no recruiting after October 30, until further orders."
Upon receipt of the telegram the Garrison Commission instructed Col. Wen Hung En, Chief of the Bureau of Public Safety, to issue orders accordingly.

expressed sympathy with the aims of the Shanghai Power
Company strikers.

At 9 a.m. October 14, Wu Tso-bei ( 吴 祖 培 ) and
Fong Chien ( 方 謙 ), who are Committee members of the
Shanghai Power Company Clerical Staff Employees' Strike
Committee and Chen Ching-loong ( 陈 庆 隆 ), who is the

Employees' Strike Committee held a conference in the office
of the Shanghai Power Company Employees' Lien Yih ( 联 益 )
Club, 84 Kong Ka Loong, Small East Gate, City, and reached
the following decisions :-

1. That an announcement refuting the statements in the
advertisement recently published by the Management
in local press be drafted and circulated to the
newspapers.

2. That clerks and other employees on strike be notified
to register their names with the Strike Committee and
that Chen Chin Loong ( 陈 庆 隆 ) and Koo Yung-kong
( 顾 永 康 ) examine the registers and compile statistics
of the number on strike.

3. That a warning be issued to strikers not to resume
work until they have permission from the Strike
Committee to do so.

4. That Wu Tao-bei ( 吴 祖 培 ) and Fong Chien ( 方 谦 )
be urged to negotiate with local organisations for
assistance.

10月14日上午9时，上海电力公司职员罢工委员会委员吴祖培、方谦，以及职员罢工委员会劝导组组长陈庆隆，在市内小东门孔家弄84号上海电力公司职工联益俱乐部办事处举行会议，并达成以下决定：

1. 起草一份声明，驳斥资方近期在本地报纸上刊登的广告中的言论，并分发给各报社。

2. 通知罢工的职员及其他员工向罢工委员会登记姓名，并由陈庆隆和顾永康审查登记表，统计罢工人数。

3. 向罢工者发出警告，未经罢工委员会许可，不得复工。

4. 敦促吴祖培和方谦与当地组织协商以寻求援助。

2. That pickets be urged to work more energetically in

3. That local public bodies be requested to assist the

4. That local influential persons be requested to

Teh-zung (丁德成) reported to the Strike Committee which

2. 敦促纠察队更加积极地工作，以防止破坏罢工者上岗。

3. 请求本地公共团体协助罢工者。

4. 请求本地有影响力的人士调解此纠纷。

Measures to prevent the clerical staff from

3. That a joint manifesto be issued.

C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5310
Morning Tra 16/10/33

LABOUR.

China Times and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

With reference to the strike in the
Shanghai Power Company, about 40 Chinese staff members
have resumed work on the advice of senior Chinese
staff members when they were assured by the Company
that promotions and an increase of wages would be
granted to them. With a view to enabling them to
work without danger, the Company has provided them
with food and lodgings on the premises.
According to a report submitted by an
investigator of the Shanghai Power Company Staff
Members & Workers Mutual Benefit Society, the Company
only extends kindness to those men because they fear
that untoward incidents might occur. The action amounts
to illegal detention of the staff members who are now
working in the premises.
As a matter of fact, the staff members who
have resumed work are merely negative. Yesterday
afternoon they went out of the premises under false
pretences . It is understood that
the Company would forbid them to leave the premises
if necessary.
After the declaration of a joint strike of
staff members and workers of the Shanghai Power Company,
the local Chinese Chamber of Commerce, the 4th District
Silk Spinning Trade Workers Union, the Preparatory
Committee of the China Seamen's Union, the Citizens
Federation, the Chinese Ratepayers Association and other
various fellow provincials associations and public
bodies emphasized their repudiation of the Company's
policy and gave their support to the strikers.
Yesterday the Nantao Electricity Company
Employees Mutual Benefit Society detailed four
representatives to assure the strikers that substantial
support would be given in times of necessity.
It is reported that the Chaochow Fellow
Provincials Association and some 20 other fellow
provincials Associations will hold a meeting at 2 p.m.
to-day at which measures to be adopted will be discussed.
The strikers of the Shanghai Power Company
have issued the following statement refuting the
declaration made by the Company in local newspapers
a few days ago:-
"The Company declared that they had discharged
21.6 per cent of foreign employees and 18.1 per cent
of Chinese employees in 1929. The foreign employees
were to work for three years as stipulated in an
agreement concluded according to the former Regulations
of the Electricity Department of the Shanghai Municipal
Council. Should they be discharged after two years'
service, they would be given 3 years' wages. The
foreign employees who were recently discharged are those
whose agreements have expired. Regarding the retiring

劳工。

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

关于上海电力公司的罢工，约40名华籍职员在资深华籍职员的建议下恢复了工作，公司向他们保证将给予晋升和加薪。为了使他们能够安全工作，公司在厂区内为他们提供了食宿。
据上海电力公司职员与工人互济会调查员提交的报告称，公司之所以对这些人行善，只是因为担心发生意外事件。此举相当于非法拘禁目前在厂区内工作的职员。
事实上，复工的职员只是表面应付。昨天下午，他们借故离开厂区。据悉，如有必要，公司将禁止他们离开厂区。
在上海电力公司职员与工人宣布联合罢工后，本地上海总商会、第四区缫丝业工会、中国海员工会筹备委员会、市民联合会、华人纳税会以及其他各同乡会和公共团体均强调反对公司的政策，并给予罢工者支持。
昨天，南市电气公司职员互济会派出四名代表向罢工者保证，在必要时将给予实质性支持。
据报道，潮州同乡会和其他约20个同乡会将于今天下午2时举行会议，讨论拟采取的措施。
上海电力公司罢工者发表了以下声明，驳斥公司几天前在本地报纸上发表的声明：-
“公司宣称，他们在1929年解雇了21.6%的外籍雇员和18.1%的华籍雇员。外籍雇员根据前上海工部局电气处规章签订的协议规定，工作期限为三年。若在服务两年后被解雇，将获得三年的工资。最近被解雇的外籍雇员是合同期满者。关于退休

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

THE 3RD FACTORY OF THE BRITISH AMERICAN
（批：D 5116）
In connection with the "go-slow" strike
of 2,000 workers of the British-American Tobacco
3rd Factory on Thorburn Road, the local Tangpu and
the General Labour Union, upon receipt of the report
of the 4th District Rolled Tobacco Trade Workers
Union, detailed their officials at 9 a.m. yesterday
to advise the strikers to resume work first and then
to await a settlement of the dispute.
At 5.30 a.m. yesterday, the strikers
entered the factory as usual but did not carry on
work. At 10 a.m. about 1,400 more hands of the Tin
Foil Department, the Tobacco Rolling Department and
the Packet Pasting Department joined the strike
movement.
The Social Bureau has sent out a notice to
the British-American Tobacco Company and the 4th District
Rolled Tobacco Trade Workers Union informing them that
the Bureau will hold a meeting at 10 a.m. October 17
at which representatives of the management and the
workers will be present.

MISCELLANEOUS.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

THE INSPECTION OF FACTORIES.
（批：D 2287 X）
A few days ago, newspapers reported that
the question of the inspection of factories in the
Settlement would be referred to another authority
so that the problem which has been at a standstill
because of the desire of the Shanghai Municipal
Council to seize the right to control the inspection
corps would be settled.
Interviewed by our reporter, Mr. O.K.
Yue, Chief Secretary of the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai, stated that the report was untrue and so

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.
（批：D 5310）

The Shanghai Power Company employs about 2,500 employees of whom 1,700 have gone on strike since October 2. Advised by the Shanghai Power Staff Members & Workers Mutual Benefit Society, about 40 more employees joined the movement yesterday.

It is learned that more foreigners and white Russians were engaged yesterday by the Company and distributed to undertake the work of the Chinese staff members in the General Office and the two plants.

The Company employs about 60 meter readers who also joined the strike. 40 new hands were engaged to take over this necessary work .. yesterday.

Apart from exhorting the entire body of employees to act in union, the Shanghai Power Company Staff Members & Workers Mutual Benefit Society has drawn up certain measures to meet the situation.

Chow Shao-kwei, a Chinese staff member of the Company, is an enthusiastic supporter of the strike movement. Yesterday afternoon he was injured by stones thrown by unknown persons when he was proceeding to the General Labour Union on Foh Yeu Road, Nantao, from the Mutual Benefit Society at Kong Ka Loong, Small East Gate, to secure information about the strike. The injury was slight and it is reported that he was injured by the same men who placed a bomb in the house of Sa Wen-yuen, a senior staff member of the Company, on October 1st.

With a view to supporting the strikers of the Shanghai Power Company, the various fellow provincials associations in the Municipality will hold a joint meeting on October 15 at which measures to be adopted will be discussed.

The 17th Branch District Citizens Federation has despatched a letter to the Shanghai Municipal Council and the Shanghai Power Company requesting them to devise ways and means to bring about an early settlement of the dispute, otherwise the Company should be held to blame if any incidents occur and cause heavy losses to business men.

The Sin Wan Pao reports that at 9 p.m. October 12 the various fellow provincials associations in Shanghai held a meeting in the Chaochow Fellow Provincials Association on Thibet Road at which the following resolutions were passed:-
1. That letters be despatched to the Shanghai Municipal Council and the Shanghai Power Company under the names of various fellow provincials associations.
2. That a manifesto be issued.
3. That if necessary, all subscribers of the Company refuse to pay electricity charges.

劳工。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳工局势。
（批注：D 5310）

上海电力公司雇佣约2500名雇员，其中1700人自10月2日起罢工。在上海电力公司职员与工人互济会的劝导下，昨天又有约40名雇员加入运动。

据悉，公司昨天雇佣了更多外国人和白俄，并将其分配去承担总办事处和两个工厂中华籍职员的工作。

公司雇佣了约60名抄表员，他们也加入了罢工。昨天雇佣了40名新人来接替这项必要的工作。

上海电力公司职员与工人互济会除了号召全体雇员团结行动外，还制定了某些措施以应对局势。

周少奎（Chow Shao-kwei，音译），该公司的一名华籍职员，是罢工运动的热烈支持者。昨天下午，他从位于小东门孔家弄（Kong Ka Loong，音译）的互济会前往南市区福佑路的总工会获取罢工信息时，被不明身份的人投掷的石块击伤。伤势轻微，据报道，袭击他与10月1日在公司资深职员萨文渊（Sa Wen-yuen，音译）家中放置炸弹的是同一伙人。

为支持上海电力公司的罢工者，本市各同乡会将于10月15日举行联席会议，讨论拟采取的措施。

第十七分区市民联合会已致函上海工部局和上海电力公司，要求他们设法早日解决纠纷，否则若发生任何事件并给商人造成重大损失，公司应承担责任。

《新闻报》报道，10月12日晚9时，上海各同乡会在西藏路潮州同乡会举行会议，并通过以下决议：-
1. 以各同乡会的名义致函上海工部局和上海电力公司。
2. 发表宣言。
3. 如有必要，所有公司用户拒绝缴纳电费。

October 14, 1933.    Morning Translation.

In: OUR.
（批：D 5310 / archiving）

The Ningpo Fellow Provincials Association
yesterday sent the following letter to the Shanghai
Municipal Council:-
"The Shanghai Power Company has obstinately
refused to consider the proposals which would be
beneficial to both the Company and the labourers.
Such action on the part of the Company aggravates
the workers, affects the convenience of all
subscribers, and constitutes a disregard of peace
and order in the community. The blame should rest
with the Company if any untoward incidents occur.
"We hereby request you to invite Mr. Jones,
Secretary of the Council, to mediate in co-operation
with Messrs. Yuan Lee-tung, Wong Shao-lai, Zee Hsin-loh
and representatives of the local Tangpu and other
political organs. Both the management and the
labourers should be instructed to make concessions
so that the dispute might be amicably settled."

The Sin Wan Pao yesterday received a
letter from Anderson, Meyer & Company declaring that
the Shanghai Power Company had not asked them to
lend labourers of their Electricity Department and
that the report in this effect as published in the
Sin Wan Pao on October 7 is untrue.

COMMITTEE TO OPPOSE SUPPRESSION OF
PATRIOTISM IN KWEICHOW FORMED
（批：D 5310 / X）

To support the students at Kweiyang in
the Province of Kweichow, who have been persecuted

October 14/10/33

Labour

Shanghai Power Company - Situation

Thirty meter readers and some fifteen clerks returned to duty at the offices of the Shanghai Power Company this morning, October 14, thus reducing the number of men on strike to about 1,515.

On October 11 the Management issued a notice dismissing the nine clerks who are members of the Clerical Staff Strike Committee. Clerks who absented themselves from work in order to attend the meeting on October 11, but who returned to work later have been instructed to give an explanation of their conduct. The Management is satisfied with the causes which they gave, and has advised loyal clerks living in Chinese territory to move to localities where they will be safe from intimidation, and has promised to pay any expenses which are incurred in compliance with this advice. The Company has further arranged to provide accommodation for about a hundred clerks on the head office premises until the situation improves.

It has been confidentially learned from the Shanghai Power Company Staff Employees Lien Yih (聯益) Club, Kong Ka Loong, Small East Gate, City, that the strikers are arranging with local Chinese business circles to induce Chinese consumers to refuse to pay electricity charges as a means to assist the workers on strike. It is further learned from the same source that the picketing groups formed by the Club will start to prevent strike-breaking staff employees from working by assaulting them and intimidating their families.

今晨（10月14日），三十名抄表员和约十五名职员回到上海电力公司办公室复工，从而使罢工人数减少至约1,515人。

10月11日，管理层发布通知，解雇了九名身为职员罢工委员会成员的职员。那些为参加10月11日会议而缺勤但随后返工的职员，已被要求对其行为作出解释。管理层对他们给出的理由表示满意，并建议居住在华界的忠诚职员搬至不会受到恐吓威胁的地方，并承诺支付因遵从这一建议而产生的任何费用。公司还安排在公司总部 premises 为约一百名职员提供住宿，直至局势好转。

据从小东门联益俱乐部（Shanghai Power Company Staff Employees Lien Yih (聯益) Club）孔嘉龙（Kong Ka Loong，音译）处秘密获悉，罢工者正与当地中国商界安排，诱导中国消费者拒付电费，以此作为援助罢工工人的手段。另从同一消息源获悉，由该俱乐部组成的纠察队将开始通过袭击罢工破坏者及其恐吓其家属的方式，阻止他们工作。

Labour (2)

In connection with the dismissal of G.W.C.6
Ying Ping-yoong ( 印炳荣 ) who was found asleep in the
Chinese lavatory at Riverside Power Station, it has been
learned that this man was actually paid a retiring
gratuity of $46.19 in addition to the wages due to him.

The following public bodies have addressed letters
to the Shanghai Municipal Council relative to the existing
dispute and advising that an early settlement be made so
that the public shall suffer no inconvenience :-

1. The Chinese Ratepayers Association.
2. Chekiang Fellow-countrymen's Association.
3. The 17th Branch of the Citizens' Federation.

The first named body besides requesting the S.M.C. to
arrange an early settlement makes the following allegations:-

(a) That the Shanghai Power Company obtained permission
to increase the price of power and light owing to
the increase in the price of coal, but have not
made any attempt to reduce the rates since the price
of coal became normal.

(b) That the meters supplied by the Company are so
manipulated that they register more energy than
is actually consumed.

(c) That the Company has made a practice of discharging
workmen of many years service and replaced them by
new hands at a rate of pay considerably less than
the men dismissed received.

(d) That owing to gross mismanagement the Company has
had a great deal of labour trouble whilst the S.M.E.D.
which operated the plant for over twenty years had no
trouble at all.

(e) That the Company has disregarded the agreement entered
into with the S.M.C. at the time the plant was purchased
with the result that the Chinese employees have been
deprived of all their rights, including the privilege
of participating Superannuation Fund.

劳工 (2)

关于G.W.C.6 印炳荣（Ying Ping-yoong）因在江边发电厂中式厕所内睡觉而被解雇一事，据悉此人除获得应付工资外，实际还领取了46.19美元的退休金。

以下公共团体已就现有争端致函上海工部局，建议尽早解决，以免公众遭受不便：-

1. 华人纳税会。
2. 浙江同乡会。
3. 市民联合会第十七分会。

上述第一个团体除了请求工部局安排尽早解决外，还提出以下指控：-

(a) 上海电力公司因煤炭价格上涨而获准提高电力和照明价格，但在煤炭价格恢复正常后，未尝试降低费率。

(b) 公司提供的电表被操纵，导致记录的能耗高于实际消耗量。

(c) 公司惯于解雇服务多年的工人，并以远低于被解雇工人薪金的工资雇佣新手替代。

(d) 由于管理严重不善，公司引发了大量劳工纠纷，而运营该厂二十多年的上海电机电气部（S.M.E.D.）则从未发生过纠纷。

(e) 公司无视在购买电厂时与工部局达成的协议，导致中国员工被剥夺了所有权利，包括参与养老基金的特权。

October 13, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

China Times and other local newspapers

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

In connection with the "go-slow" strike
of workers in the plants of the Shanghai Power Company,
about 100 more Chinese staff members yesterday left
the premises and joined the strike. The situation
has now reached serious dimensions.
The General Labour Union some days ago
submitted a telegraphic petition to the Central
authorities requesting them to detail officials to
deal with the dispute in co-operation with the local
Tangpu and other political organs so that the trouble
might not spread. The Union yesterday received a
telegraphic reply from the Central People's Movement
Direction Committee to the effect that instructions
had been given to the local Tangpu and other political
authorities to immediately mediate in the labour trouble
in the Shanghai Power Company. The proposal to appoint
an official to proceed to Shanghai is not yet settled.
The Shanghai Power Company Staff Members
& Workers Mutual Benefit Society yesterday submitted a
report to the local Tangpu and other political organs,
for purposes of record, on the resolutions passed at
a meeting held on October 11 in the premises of the
Youths Propaganda Group Society.
The Dried Goods Shop Owners Association,
the Money Exchange Guild, the Sugar Merchants Association,
the Vegetable Hong Owners Association, and about 20
other trade associations yesterday sent the following
joint letter to the Shanghai Municipal Council:-
"Electricity is used by all public utility
enterprises and shops. Should a settlement of the
trouble in the Shanghai Power Company be delayed,
trouble may arise and unrest may be felt among the
citizens with a subsequent loss to the commerce. The
blame should rest on the Company.
"The Council is a supreme organ established
for the benefit of citizens in the International
Settlement. It has the right to direct the Shanghai
Power Company. It should issue a strict order to the
Company to accept the lawful mediations by the Chinese
Government."
After the declaration of the strike of the
1,400 workers, work in various departments was affected.
The Company on September 30 and October 3 engaged
about 150 white Russians to undertake the work of
Chinese workers under the direction of foreigners. One
hundred more white Russians were employed on October 11
and 12 and distributed to work in the two plants.

November 1, 1933. Morning Translation.

Lt. CUR.

Sin W n Pao and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

On the advice of the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union, the distribution workers of the new plant of the Shanghai Power Company have been maintaining the distribution of electricity and have not yet joined the "go-slow" strike. But work in various other departments has already been suspended.

It is learned that the Shanghai Power Company has engaged white Russians to replace the "go-slow" strikers, but their number is not sufficient to carry on operations and in view of the fact that many subscribers are applying for the installation of electric stoves for the approaching cold weather, the management on the morning of October 30 detailed a number of Chinese and foreign engineers to call at the dwelling houses of the strikers, and force the latter to accompany them in motor cars to the plants to resume work. Yesterday morning, the management further detailed their engineers with the assistance of armed policemen and detectives to force some 30 more strikers to resume work.

It is reported that about 50 workers have been forcibly pulled to the plants. Yih Sun-chuan, Ghu Shih-soong and several others who escaped from the plants yesterday stated that as soon as the workers had been pulled to the plants, the management forced them to work. As the Company had not yet expressed its willingness to accept the demands of the strikers, the workers refused to work and maintained their "go-slow" strike.

At 3 p.m. yesterday, Lee Jen-tso, a delegate of the People's Movement Committee of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters, called at the General Labour Union to discuss the dispute with Shao Shu-bah (邵虛白), member of the Executive Committee of the Union. As his investigations into the circumstances surrounding the trouble were complete, Lee Jen-tso returned to Nanking by night express yesterday to report on the result of his investigations.

At an emergency meeting held at 8 p.m. October 30 by Chaoshow Fellow Provincials Association, the Shaoshing Fellow Provincials Association and some 20 other bodies in the Ningpo Fellow Provincials Association on Thibet Road, it was resolved to detail Cheng Tseng-cheu (鄭正秋), Soong Shih-hsiang (宋士驤), Chen Dah-fong (陳大放) and Toong Hsin-gin (董心琴) to call at the Shanghai Municipal Council on the morning of November 2 (Thursday) and demand that the Shanghai Power Company be instructed to devise ways and means of effecting an early settlement of the dispute, thereby preventing inconvenience to the public.

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司劳工局势。

根据第四区水电业工会的建议，上海电力公司新厂的配电工人一直维持电力供应，尚未加入“怠工”罢工。但其他各部门的工作已经停止。

据悉，上海电力公司已雇佣白俄人员以替代“怠工”罢工者，但其人数不足以维持运营。鉴于许多用户因天气即将转冷而申请安装电炉，管理层于10月30日上午派遣多名中外工程师前往罢工者住所，强迫后者随其乘车前往工厂复工。昨日上午，管理层进一步派遣工程师，在武装警察和侦探的协助下，强迫约30名罢工者复工。

据报道，约有50名工人被强行带往工厂。昨日从工厂逃出的伊孙传（Yih Sun-chuan，音译）、朱世松（Ghu Shih-soong，音译）等人称，工人一旦被带至工厂，管理层便强迫其工作。由于公司尚未表示愿意接受罢工者的要求，工人们拒绝工作并坚持“怠工”罢工。

昨日下午3时，国民党中央民众运动委员会代表李任之（Lee Jen-tso，音译）前往总工会，与该会执行委员邵虚白商讨纠纷事宜。因对事态情况的调查已完成，李任之于昨晚乘夜车返回南京汇报调查结果。

10月30日晚8时，潮州同乡会、绍兴同乡会及其他约20个团体在西藏路的宁波同乡会召开紧急会议，决议派遣郑正秋、宋士驤、陈大放和董心琴于11月2日（星期四）上午前往上海公共租界工部局，要求指令上海电力公司制定办法，尽早解决纠纷，以免给公众带来不便。

为使公众了解纠纷相关情况，上海总工会已编辑并印制了一本

Min Pao publishes the following brief comment :

It is an offence for a prostitute to accost
men in the streets and if she is arrested by a policeman
she is sent to court and the judge imposes a fine.
At the time when militarists were in power, they literally
forced men to become soldiers, but no objection was
raised by the people who were afraid to speak although
they hated these methods.
During the present labour dispute in the
Shanghai Power Company, the company is taking workers
from their homes and forcing them to work.
For a prostitute to accost people in the
streets, for the militarists to compel men to become
soldiers, and for the S.P.C. to compel men to work, all
these are offences against the liberty of the people.
There are laws governing punishment for these offences
and these laws should be executed.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

LABOUR SITUATION IN B.A.T. NO.3 FACTORY.

In connection with the "go-slow" strike of the
workers in the B.A.T. No.3 Factory which was caused by
the management's refusal to accept the demands submitted
by the workers, the Bureau of Social Affairs held two
meetings but owing to the absence of the representatives
of the management on both occasions, the meetings produced
no result.
The entire body of the workers in the factory
were still maintaining the "go-slow" strike and had
deputed representatives to proceed to the Pootung 5th
District Rolled Tobacco Workers Union and request the
workers in Nos. 1 and 2 factories to do likewise.
It is understood that the workers in Nos. 1 and
2 factories will join the movement as the management
concerned has not settled the demands already submitted
by the workers and has refused the request of the Union
to collect membership fees.
The dispute may become serious and an immediate
settlement is essential.

LABOUR

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

The DAH KUNG NEWS AGENCY yesterday secured the following information concerning the "go-slow" strike of workers of the SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY:-
The workers in the New and Old Plants of the SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY declared a "go-slow" strike on September 29 as a protest against the dismissal of employees without cause and the refusal of payment of the Superannuation Funds. Despite repeated sincere mediations in the dispute offered by deputies of the TANGPU and other Chinese political organs, Mr. JONES, Secretary of the S.M.C., and individuals of various local public bodies, no solution has been reached owing to the firm attitude on the part of the concern.
The management of the Company at once engaged a number of "White" Russians to take the place of the strikers and some machines in the Plants are now out of order owing to the inexperience of the Russians in handling machinery.
At 5 a.m. yesterday some ten senior staff employees of the SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY, including foreigners and Chinese engineers, accompanied by a party of detectives and policemen of the S.M.P., visited the dwellings of "go-slow" strikers on Hanbury Road, Yuhang Road, Miller Road and other streets in the vicinity of the Old Plant in nine motor cars. They pulled "go-slow" strikers into the vehicles by force and conveyed them to the Plant to work. Some 30 workers were thus forced to enter the Plant.
Upon receipt of the above news, the entire body of workers in the Old Plant became indignant and held an emergency meeting at 10 a.m. yesterday in the office of the SAUCE MERCHANTS ASSOCIATION, Foh Yeu Road, Nantao. TSU AUH LING (朱浩凌) presided and the following decision was passed:-
"That the following measures be adopted to deal with the action of the POWER COMPANY in compelling the strikers to work:-
1) To publish a statement in local newspapers on the truth of the "go-slow" strike.
2) To refuse to resume work until a satisfactory solution of the dispute is reached."
In connection with the case in which the POWER COMPANY detailed deputies to force workers to work, the entire body of the workers in the New and Old Plants have issued the following statement:-
"Unable to bear the repeated acts of oppression on the part of the SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY, we commenced a "go-slow" strike with the object of fighting for the rights of Chinese workers. One month has now elapsed and we are still observing the rules of peace and good order.

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

大公通讯社昨日获悉关于上海电力公司工人“怠工”罢工的下列消息：-
上海电力公司新、老厂工人于9月29日宣布“怠工”罢工，以抗议无故解雇员工及拒绝支付养老金。尽管塘沽及其他中国政治机构的代表、工部局秘书琼斯（JONES）先生以及各地公共团体的个人多次真诚调解，但由于公司态度强硬，未能达成解决方案。
公司管理层随即雇用了一批“白俄”取代罢工者，由于这些俄国人不熟悉机器操作，厂内部分机器目前出现故障。
昨日凌晨5时，上海电力公司约十名高级职员，包括外籍和华籍工程师，在工部局警务处一队侦探和巡捕的陪同下，乘坐九辆汽车前往老厂附近的汉伯里路（Hanbury Road）、余杭路（Yuhang Road）、密勒路（Miller Road）等街道的“怠工”罢工者住所。他们强行将“怠工”罢工者拉入车内，并将其送往工厂工作。约有30名工人因此被强迫进厂。
获悉上述消息后，老厂全体工人愤慨不已，于昨日上午10时在南市福佑路酱业会馆办公室召开紧急会议。朱浩凌（TSU AUH LING）主持会议，并通过以下决议：-
“针对电力公司强迫罢工者工作之行为，采取下列措施：-
1) 在本地报纸上发表声明，揭露“怠工”罢工的真相。
2) 在纠纷得到满意解决之前，拒绝复工。”
关于电力公司派员强迫工人工作一事，新、老厂全体工人发表如下声明：-
“因无法忍受上海电力公司一再压迫，我们为争取华工权利而开始“怠工”罢工。至今已一个月，我们仍遵守和平秩序规则。
10月30日凌晨5时，公司派遣

D5310 Shanghai Power Company - Situation

The situation in the Shanghai Power Company
shows slight improvement to-day, October 30. As the
result of the failure of the Union to pay strike-pay to
the majority of the strikers, about 150 workmen from the
Fearon Road Depot have during the past few days shown
a desire to resume work. This morning, groups of workmen
appeared in the vicinity of the Depot, but only fifteen
entered and expressed a desire to start. Observation
showed that other workmen, who had similar intentions
but were more timid, had assembled in tea shops near by.
Representatives of the management are now endeavouring to
persuade the latter that they have nothing to fear, as
the police arrangements for their protection are in
every way adequate.

Forty members of the 4th District Water and Electricity
Workers' Union at a meeting held between 7 p.m. and 9 p.m.
October 28 in their office, 15 Shou Ying Faung, Tien Doong
Road, Chapei, passed the following resolutions :-

1. That the strikers be warned to attend the office of the
Union every morning and that any who ignore the warning
be expelled from membership of the Union.

2. That efforts be made to request Tu Yueh-sung (杜月笙)
and Yung Tsang-ching (榮宗敬) to bring about an early
settlement of the dispute through mediation.

3. That all workers persist in the strike.

4. That the Chinese Authorities be asked to investigate
and suppress the activities of communists who are
trying to influence the employees of the Power Company
who are at present on strike.

At 10 a.m. October 28, one Li Zung-tse (李人龍), member

劳工（7）

D5310 上海电力公司 - 局势

今日（10月30日）上海电力公司的局势略有改善。由于工会未能向大多数罢工者支付罢工津贴，过去几天中，斐伦路堆栈约有150名工人表示希望复工。今晨，几群工人出现在堆栈附近，但只有十五人进入并表示希望开始工作。观察显示，其他有类似意图但较为胆小的工人聚集在附近的茶馆里。管理层代表正努力说服后者不必恐惧，因为保护他们的警力安排各方面均十分充足。

第四区水电工会四十名成员于10月28日晚7时至9时，在闸北天通庵路寿英坊15号该会办公室举行的会议上，通过以下决议：-

1. 警告罢工者每天早晨到工会办公室报到，凡无视警告者，开除出会籍。

2. 设法请求杜月笙（Tu Yueh-sung）和荣宗敬（Yung Tsang-ching）通过调解促成纠纷早日解决。

3. 所有工人坚持罢工。

4. 请求中国当局调查并镇压试图影响目前罢工的电力公司员工的共产党分子活动。

10月28日上午10时，国民党中央民众运动委员会成员李人龙（Li Zung-tse，原文如此，后文作 Li Zung-tso）

Unemployed Workers - Meeting

Ten Chinese who claimed to represent the unemployed
workers in the Western District held a meeting on a piece
of vacant ground on Kiaochow Road near Singapore Road,
O.O.L., between 5 p.m. and 6 p.m. October 29, and decided
to organize a Strike Committee to endeavour to induce the
operatives in the Mei Ah (美亚) Silk Weaving Factories
(561 Ferry Road and 534 Kiaochow Road; O.O.L.) and the
Hung Tsang Cotton Mill, 381 Markham Road, to declare a
strike to secure improvement of the conditions under which
they work. It was also resolved that "wall papers" be
issued denouncing the employers for oppressing the workers.

LABOUR

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:
SILK FILATURES REDUCE WAGES OF WORKERS.
The Bureau of Social Affairs yesterday convened
a meeting to discuss the dispute between local silk
filatures and their workers which arose through the
reduction of wages of the hands. No satisfactory decision
was reached.
The Bureau will hold a meeting to-day.
It was arranged yesterday that representatives
of employers and employees are to discuss the dispute at
4 p.m. to-day in the office of the Silk Filature Owners'
Association.

China Times and other local newspapers:
LABOUR SITUATION IN SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.
D 5310
One month has elapsed since the workers of the
Shanghai Power Company declared a "go-slow" strike and
no measures to settle the dispute have been formulated.
Zau Hsu Bah (邵虛白), member of the Executive
Committee of the General Labour Union, states:- "The
labour unrest in the Shanghai Power Company is still
serious and has attracted the particular attention of the
Central Government. The Ministry of Industry and the
Central People's Movement Committee recently commissioned
Pao Kuo Hwa and Li Chen Tsho to proceed to Shanghai to
conduct an investigation into the "go-slow" strike of
the workers of the Power Company. The two deputies have
now returned to the Capital to give their report. On
the basis of the report of investigations by the two
deputies, the Ministry of Industry and the People's Movement
Committee will discuss measures to deal with the trouble
in the Shanghai Power Company. It is reported that Li
Chen Tsho will pay another visit to Shanghai to-day
(October 27) in order to conduct a more detailed investigation.
He will confer with the Kuomintang and other Chinese
political organs. Meanwhile, discussions to deal with
the dispute in the Power Company are being held by Mr.
Stirling Fessenden, Secretary-General of the S.M.C., Mr.
Tu Yoeh Seng, member of the Council of the Chinese
Municipality, Mr. Bell, Chairman of the S.M.C., Mr. Yu Ya
Ching and Mr. L.T. Yuan, Chinese members of the Council.
It is also learned that the 4th District Water & Electricity
Workers Union has submitted the abridged demands of the
workers of the Power Company to these prominent persons
in order to facilitate mediation."
S

D 5310
GENERAL LABOUR UNION SUPPORTS SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY WORKERS

The General Labour Union publishes the following statement in the Shun Pao requesting the public to support the strikers of the Shanghai Power Company:-
"Twenty-nine days have already elapsed since the dispute arose in the Shanghai Power Company, which later developed into a labour strike through the oppressive act of the Company in declaring a lock out.
"Before the go-slow strike took place, our Union had spent six months in seeking ways and means to solve the labour problem of the Company, because the workers had submitted a demand to the Company which if granted would have ensured the protection of their interests. The indiscriminate dismissal of employees had aroused discontent, and the present workers were afraid of meeting the same fate and facing the misery of unemployment.
"The object of the present workers' demands is not ... directly concerned with superanuation. They are struggling to gain security in their livelihoods and interests. It is only just that this security should be gained after twenty years diligent service. The S.M.C. respected the workers' merits in this public utility business, and asked the Company to reward such merit. The former Chief Engineer and concurrently the General Manager of the Company knew full well that the Chinese workers deserving of merit and in his written statement to the Board of Directors; he emphasized Article 14 of the workers agreement which states that the security of workers positions and interests would be respected by the Company in the same manner as before. In supporting this statement, the Head Office in America had dispatched a telegram to China promising that the careers of all Chinese workers in the Shanghai Company would be protected. Thus we have definite proof that the Chinese workers have already secured the right to the protection of their interest and positions. Now, the present manager of the Company disregards both the promise of the Company in America and the statement of Mr. Aldridge, the former Chief Engineer and General Manager, and has wantonly destroyed the security of the workers' interests. In the first place, some 400 workers were deprived of their livelihood by this management. Lately, four other workers have been dismissed for opening legal negotiations with the Company. Again three workers have been discharged for discussing the question of the protection of the workers. According to these facts, it is evident that the Company should bear the responsibility of breaking its promise and disregarding the rights of the workers. The workers did not go on strike without sufficient reason, because it was only after the Chamber of Commerce, the local official and Kuomintang organ, the Chinese members of the S.M.C. and Mr. Jones of the S.M.C. had failed to find a remedy for the

D 5310
总工会支持上海电力公司工人

总工会在《申报》上发表以下声明，请求公众支持上海电力公司的罢工工人：——
“上海电力公司的纠纷发生至今已二十九日，后因该公司采取压迫性手段宣布闭厂，进而演变为劳工罢工。
在怠工罢工发生之前，本会曾花费六个月时间寻求解决该公司劳工问题的途径和方法，因为工人们向公司提出了一项要求，若获准将能确保其利益得到保护。随意解雇员工引起了不满，现有工人担心遭遇同样命运，面临失业的痛苦。
目前工人要求的目的并非……直接与退休金有关。他们正在争取生活生计和利益的安全保障。在勤勉服务二十年后获得这种安全保障是公正合理的。工部局尊重工人们在这一公用事业中的功绩，并要求公司对此类功绩给予奖励。该公司前任总工程师兼总经理完全清楚中国工人应得的功绩，并在其致董事会的书面陈述中；他强调了工人协议第14条，该条规定公司将像以前一样尊重工人的职位和利益安全。为支持这一陈述，美国总公司曾向中国发电报，承诺保护上海公司所有中国工人的职业。因此，我们有确凿证据证明中国工人已经获得了保护其利益和职位的权利。现在，该公司现任经理无视美国总公司的承诺以及前任总工程师兼总经理奥尔德里奇（Aldridge）先生的陈述，肆意破坏工人利益的安全保障。首先，约有400名工人被管理层剥夺了生计。最近，又有四名工人因与公司开启法律谈判而被解雇。另有三名工人因讨论工人保护问题而被开除。根据这些事实，显然公司应承担违背承诺和无视工人权利的责任。工人罢工并非没有充分理由，因为只有在商会、地方官员和国民党机关、工部局华董以及工部局的琼斯（Jones）先生未能找到解决

October 27, 1933.
Afternoon Translation

LABOUR.

trouble, that the workers commenced a go-slow strike
to serve as a warning to the Company. The Company
must not forget that several proposals were submitted
beforehand, neither did the workers go on strike without
first giving reasons. To state that the strikers
was instigated by a few ringleaders who hoped to obtain
profit from the movement is utterly false. Are the
workers foolish enough not to protest when their interests
are at stake? The workers have their own interests
to protect therefore the go-slow strike is a reasonable
movement. The strikers have accepted our advice to
maintain the supply of electricity for the public, and
we believe that the condition of the workers is a subject
for sympathy and that the obstinate attitude of the
Company is maintained with a view to prolonging the
strike. The Company pays no heed to public welfare
and is interested only in private gain, so it ignores the
mediations and good wishes of the representatives of
the Kuomintang and other official organs, the Chairman of the
Chamber of Commerce, the Chinese councillors of the S.M.C.,
and Mr. Jones, Secretary of the S.M.C. The rejection of
the workers demands is entirely unreasonable and the
letter addressed by the Company to the public contains
many false statements which mislead the public. Further-
more, the Company maintains an autocratic attitude and
continues to dismiss workers. This attitude of the
Company has prevented our Union from introducing the
policy of co-operation between labour and capital and has
lowered the prestige of our Union. Our endeavours to
mediate in the dispute are unable to change the attitude
of the management of the Company. We know full well
that this oppression may have serious consequences, so,
in future, if the workers indulge in acts which affect the
peace and safety of society and inconvenience the
subscribers to the Company, the responsibility of having
caused the trouble cannot be evaded by the Company.
"We know that our prestige has already been
destroyed and our efforts are exhausted, so we are forced
to repeat our cry for public assistance. We hope that
the Kuomintang and political organs, the municipal
councillors, and the enthusiastic members of the various
public organizations will quickly devise measures to
prevent incidents occasioned by the workers by circumstances
to go to extremes."

困境的办法之后，工人才开始实行怠工罢工，以此向公司发出警告。公司切勿忘记，此前已提交了几项提案，工人也并非未说明理由就罢工。声称罢工是由少数希望从运动中获利的头目煽动而成的，这完全是虚假的。当工人的利益受到威胁时，他们会愚蠢到不提出抗议吗？工人有自己的利益需要保护，因此怠工罢工是一种合理的行动。罢工者接受了我们的建议，维持对公众的电力供应，我们认为工人的处境值得同情，而公司的顽固态度是为了延长罢工。公司不顾公共福利，只关心私人利益，因此无视国民党及其他官方机构代表、商会主席、工部局华董以及工部局秘书琼斯先生的调解和善意。拒绝工人的要求是完全不合理的，公司致公众的信中包含许多误导公众的虚假陈述。此外，公司保持专制态度，继续解雇工人。公司的这种态度阻碍了本会推行劳资合作政策，并降低了本会的威望。我们调解纠纷的努力无法改变公司管理层的态度。我们深知这种压迫可能会产生严重后果，因此，今后如果工人从事影响社会和平与安全以及给公司用户带来不便的行为，造成麻烦的责任由公司承担，无法推卸。
“我们知道我们的威望已被破坏，努力已耗尽，因此被迫再次呼吁公众援助。我们希望国民党及政治机关、市政议员以及各公共组织的热心成员迅速制定措施，防止工人因 circumstances（原文不清/语境指‘受形势所迫’）走向极端而引发事件。”

1. 任何在公司服务满一年的员工，若被公司解雇，应获得相当于三个月工资及总工资5%的退休酬金（若员工被法院判定有罪，则所有福利予以没收）。

We hereby give the following explanation for
the five demands submitted by the workers:-
In the first place, we have to declare on
behalf of the workers that the dispute was not caused
by the dismissal of certain workers. The strike arose
through the desire of the workers to protect their livelihood
and rights in the future. This can be proved by reading
demand No. 4 which stipulates that seven persons out of
the 400 dismissed workers be granted reinstatement.
Secondly, with a view to helping the management,
the workers have abandoned the demand for reinstatement of
the 400 dismissed or discharged workers with the exception
of seven already mentioned. According to the demand
No.2, the workers express their willingness to observe the
rules governing the dismissal of workers by the management
for committing offences which constitute violations of the
Rules. This shows that this attitude of the workers is
reasonable.
In the third place, the three other demands were
based on the Factory Law and the circular procedures of
treatment of workers; they cannot be considered unreasonable.
In pursuance of the promise "We are anxious to have the
employees become members of our body" promulgated by the
concern in America, those employees who are considered to
have been loyal and faithful to their duties by the Company
are to be granted an increase in their superannuation fund
and are to be treated like the foreigners.

The letter of Mr. Aldridge, the former manager,
addressed to workers is appended.
"Following the purchase of the Electricity
Department of the S.M.C. by the Company, I know there will
be many workers who fear for their positions. This fear
will arise because you do not quite understand the
plan of the Board of Directors of the Special Electricity
Department and Article 14 of the agreement published by
the Board which directs that special attention will be
paid to the interests of workers and to the protection of
workers positions. All workers will continue to occupy

2. 明确陈述解雇中国员工的规则。
3. 凡在公司服务满一年的员工，每年年底应授予相当于一个月工资的年终奖金。
4. 关于被公司无故解雇或开除的400名工人，其中七人应复职。
5. 支付怠工罢工期间的工资。

我们就工人提出的五项要求作出如下解释：——
首先，我们必须代表工人声明，纠纷并非由解雇某些工人引起。罢工 arises（原文不清/语境指‘产生’）于工人希望保护其未来的生计和权利。阅读要求第4条即可证明这一点，该条规定在被解雇的400名工人中，有七人应获准复职。
其次，为了帮助管理层，工人放弃了对被解雇或开除的400名工人复职的要求，仅保留上述七人除外。根据要求第2条，工人表示愿意遵守管理层因工人犯下构成违反规则的罪行而解雇工人的相关规定。这表明工人的态度是合理的。
第三，其他三项要求基于《工厂法》和工人待遇的通例程序；不能认为是不合理的。为了履行美国方面发布的承诺“我们渴望让员工成为我们团体的一员”，那些被公司认为忠于职守的员工，其退休基金将增加，并享受与外国人同等的待遇。

附上前任经理奥尔德里奇（Aldridge）先生致工人的信。
“在公司收购工部局电气部后，我知道许多工人会担心自己的职位。这种恐惧会产生，是因为你们不太了解特别电气部董事会的计划以及董事会发布的协议第14条，该条指示将特别注意工人的利益和保护工人的职位。所有工人将继续担任其 usual（原文不清/语境指‘原有’）职位。美国电力公司的代表向我保证，不会改变工人的条件。美国电力公司已发电报向你们保证，不会做出任何改变。”

Min Pao and other local newspapers :

SILK FILATURES REDUCE WAGES OF WORKERS

Owing to the silk trade depression in Europe
and America, some of the local silk filatures have been
forced to suspend operations. It has now been resolved
by the Silk Filature Trade Association that the wages of
female workers who receive 60 cents per day be reduced
to 42 cents a day and that the seniority and allowances
received from the selling of dried silk-worms as well as
rewards for Sunday work be cancelled.
The Bureau of Social Affairs has conferred with
representatives of the Silk Filature Trade Association and
of the Silk Spinning Trade Workers Union in connection with
the matter and it has been decided to hold a meeting at
2 p.m. today at which representatives will be appointed to
deal with the matter. Representatives of both parties
have detailed to attend the meeting.

October 27, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

In connection with the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company, the People's Movement Committee of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters has detailed to Shanghai a deputy named Lee Jen-tso (李人視) to make an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the dispute.

Upon his arrival yesterday morning, Lee Jen-tso immediately called at the local Tangpu and closely inquired into the cause and development of 'the trouble.

Accompanied by officials of the Tangpu, Lee Jen-tso at 3 p.m. yesterday proceeded to the General Labour Union and discussed the situation with two committee members named Chu Hsueh-vai and Shao Ling-bah who gave a detailed report of the trouble and after presenting evidence in connection with the agreement concluded by the Shanghai Municipal Council some time ago for the protection of workers, related the facts concerning dismissal of Chinese workers and the violation of the promise made by the Company.

Later, Zee Hoong-sun, a representative of the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union, was called in and closely interrogated.

It is understood that Lee Jen-tso returned to Nanking yesterday evening and made a report to the Central authorities. He will come back to Shanghai on the evening of October 27 to continue his investigations.

It is reported that Pao Kuo-hwa, special delegate from the Ministry of Industry, returned to Nanking at noon yesterday having completed his inquiries concerning the Shanghai Power Company dispute.

Following the outbreak of the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company, local public bodies sent letters to the S.M.C. requesting official intervention.

Upon receipt of these letters, Mr. Bell, chairman of the S.M.C. opened discussions with Mr. "Hopkins", general manager of the Company, and instructed the representative of the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union to ascertain the attitude of the workers.

At 3 p.m. October 25, Mr. Fessenden, Secretary-General of the S.M.C. invited Mr. Doo Yueh-sun, member of the Council of the Chinese Municipality, to discuss measures to deal with the dispute.

It is reported that Messrs. Yue Yah-ching and Yuan Lee-tung, Chinese members of the S.MLC., have discussed the matter with Mr. Bell.

It appears that the S.M.C. is attempting to settle the dispute, but an amicable settlement will depend upon the sincerity of both parties and their willingness to make concessions.

劳工。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

鉴于上海电力公司的劳资纠纷，国民党中央总部民众运动委员会已派遣一名副手李人视（音译）前往上海，调查纠纷周围的情况。

李人视昨天上午抵达后，立即拜访了当地党部，仔细查问了“麻烦”的原因和发展过程。

在党部官员的陪同下，李人视于昨天下午3时前往总工会，与两名名为朱学范（原文拼写为Chu Hsueh-vai）和邵令巴（Shao Ling-bah，音译）的委员讨论局势，他们详细报告了麻烦情况，并在出示了工部局前一段时间为保护工人而达成的协议的相关证据后，陈述了关于解雇中国工人以及公司违反承诺的事实。

随后，第四区水电业贸易工会代表徐洪生（Zee Hoong-sun，音译）被叫入并接受严密讯问。

据悉，李人视已于昨晚返回南京并向中央当局汇报。他将于10月27日晚返回上海继续调查。

据报道，实业部特派员包国华已于昨天中午完成对上海电力公司纠纷的调查后返回南京。

在上海电力公司劳资纠纷爆发后，本地公共团体致函工部局，请求官方干预。

收到这些信件后，工部局主席贝尔先生与公司总经理“霍普金斯”先生展开讨论，并指示第四区水电业贸易工会代表查明工人的态度。

10月25日下午3时，工部局总办费森登先生邀请上海市参事会参事杜月笙先生讨论处理纠纷的措施。

据报道，工部局华董叶雅清先生和袁履东先生已与贝尔先生讨论此事。

看来工部局正试图解决纠纷，但能否达成和解取决于双方的诚意及其做出让步的意愿。

October 27, 1933.    Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

The Shanghai Power Company Staff Members
"Go-slow" Strike Committee has made the following
statement:-
"It is rumoured that the assassination
of Chen Ching-loh, a staff member of the Company,
was ordered because of his refusal to join the strike
movement. On the contrary, the deceased sympathized
with the strike movement. On October 11 when the
Shanghai Power Company Staff Members & Workers Mutual
Benefit Society held a meeting in the premises of
the Youth Propaganda Group Society, he was proposed
as a member of the "Go-slow" Strike Committee, but
owing to the number of members being limited, he
was not accepted. He then became a secret inspector
of the Picketing Corps of the Committee and his work
was much appreciated. He resumed work for the sake
of his family but not on his own accord. (his sister
often called at the premises of the Society and
upbraided him for his conduct.) We are at a loss to
know why the Company stated that he refused to join
the strike prior to his death. Such a statement is
absolutely untrue.
"In short, the Company is adopting
malicious methods to obstruct the labour movement."

Central China Daily News (Editorial):

The world is rapidly becoming bankrupt.
Consequently factories are being closed and wages reduced
daily. The livelihood of the labourers thus becomes
worse by degrees and the number of the unemployed increases
day by day. This is the cause of disputes between
employers and employees.
Amongst the labour troubles which have
occurred in this locality, the "go-slow" strike of
workers of the Shanghai Power Company ranks as serious.
Ostensibly, the labour dispute between the Power Company
and its workers arose over the dismissal of some workers
and the cancellation of former conditions of employment
by the Company. The main cause of the trouble, however,
was that the management failed to consider the hardships
of the workers and the workers had no knowledge of the
financial conditions of the firm.
To speak plainly, the Chinese employees of
the Shanghai Power Company, which was inaugurated twenty
years ago, have carried out their duties diligently
and have rendered valuable service. At the time when
the Electricity Department of the S.M.C. was taken over
by the Power Company, the S.M.C. and the Company praised
and encouraged the workers. The workers are now on
"go-slow" strike but their movement is a peaceful one
and has caused no inconvenience to the public. The
Kuomintang and other political organs and commercial
bodies have exerted every effort to mediate, while the
management of the Company has rejected every offer.
It is worthy of note that, notwithstanding the attitude

上海电力公司职员
“怠工”罢工委员会发表如下声明：-
“有谣言称，公司职员陈景洛（Chen Ching-loh，音译）被暗杀是因为他拒绝加入罢工运动。相反，死者同情罢工运动。10月11日，当上海电力公司职员与工人互助会在青年宣传团社址举行会议时，他被提名为‘怠工’罢工委员会成员，但由于名额有限，未被接受。随后他成为委员会纠察队的秘密视察员，其工作备受赞赏。他为了家庭缘故恢复工作，并非出于自愿。（他的姐姐经常到会社址责骂他的行为。）我们不知公司为何声称他在死前拒绝加入罢工。这种说法绝对不实。
“总之，公司正采用恶意手段阻碍劳工运动。”

《华中日报》（社论）：

世界正迅速走向破产。因此，工厂每日关闭，工资每日削减。工人的生活状况从而日益恶化，失业人数逐日增加。这就是雇主与雇员之间纠纷的原因。
在当地发生的劳资纠纷中，上海电力公司工人的“怠工”罢工属于严重之列。表面上看，电力公司与工人之间的劳资纠纷起因于公司解雇部分工人并取消以前的雇佣条件。然而，麻烦的主要原因是管理层未能考虑工人的困难，而工人也不了解公司的财务状况。
坦率地说，成立于二十年前的上海电力公司的中国雇员一直勤勉履行职责，提供了有价值的服务。当工部局电气处被电力公司接管时，工部局和公司都曾赞扬和鼓励工人。工人们现在正在进行“怠工”罢工，但他们的运动是和平的，未给公众造成不便。国民党及其他政治机关和商业团体已竭尽全力进行调解，而公司管理层则拒绝了每一项提议。值得注意的是，尽管公司态度

of the Company, the workers are still observing peace and

    If the Power Company is not financially sound,

Min Pao publishes the following brief comment :

    29 days have passed since the trouble at the
power company commenced. The workers have made concessions
as a result of mediations conducted by the local Tangpu
and political organs and the persuasion of the Shanghai
Municipal Council but the management maintains its
obstinate attitude. It is evident that the company
disregards public service.
    The supply of electricity is now being carried
out as usual by the company, but no one is engaged in
the repair of damages and the safety of the community
will be affected should the strike be prolonged.
    As the S.M.C. has authority to control the
Shanghai Power Company, it should take immediate and
definite steps in cooperation with the local Tangpu and
the Municipality of Greater Shanghai for the settlement of
the dispute in order to avoid further trouble. Otherwise
the people should request the Municipality of Greater
