LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY. No. D 5310 Date 26 / 10 / 33.）
（批：D5310 Coulon）
At 2 p.m. yesterday, the Shanghai General
Labour Union held a meeting at which about 100 persons
representing some 70 labour unions were present.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That the various labour unions do their utmost
to contribute funds to the "go-slow" strikers of the
Shanghai Power Company and that a petition be submitted
to the General Labour Union to draw up detailed
measures governing the distribution of the contributions.
2. That the various labour unions issue
manifestoes concerning the labour trouble in the
Shanghai Power Company.
The Shanghai General Labour Union yesterday
issued the following letter addressed to the public
bodies:-
"We have made every effort to prevent the
labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company from
spreading with a view to maintaining the electricity
supply, the peace and order in the community and the
rights of all the subscribers. Yet the dispute still
remains serious and is becoming gradually worse.
"We hereby give the following explanation
for the five demands submitted by the workers:-
"In the first place, we have to declare
on behalf of the workers that the dispute was not
caused by the dismissal of certain workers. The strike
arose through the desire of the workers to protect
their livelihood and rights in the future. This can
be proved by reading demand No. 4 which stipulates that
7 persons out of the 400 dismissed workers be granted
reinstatement.
"Secondly, with a view to helping the
management, the workers have abandoned the demand for
reinstatement of the 400 dismissed or discharged workers
with the exception of seven already mentioned. According
to the demand No. 2, the workers express their
willingness to observe the rules governing the dismissal
of workers by the management for committing offences
which constitute violations of the Rules. This shows
that this attitude of the workers is reasonable.
"In the third place, the three other demands
were based on the Factory Law and the circular procedures
of treatment of workers; they cannot be considered
unreasonable. In pursuance of the promise "We are anxious
to have the employees become members of our body"
promulgated by the concern in America, those employees
who are considered to have been loyal and faithful to
their duties by the Company are to be granted an increase
in their superannuation fund and are to be treated like
the foreigners.
"In conclusion, we have to state that we
have done our best to promote mediation to settle the
dispute. Following the strike of the workers, we advised
the workers to maintain the distribution of electricity
with a view to maintaining public safety and the rights
of the subscribers. Of late, we raised funds to assist
in providing livelihood for the workers in order that
the trouble might not reach serious dimensions and to
publish a statement to-day for the information of the
public. Hereafter, we shall not publish further statements
owing to lack of funds or it may be that we shall have no
further opportunity of publishing them.
"We hereby request the public to give its
support to this just cause. Those who desire to know the
detailed circumstances of the trouble may apply to this
Union for a copy of the "Report on the Labour Trouble in
the Shanghai Power Company" now in print which will be
delivered to them within a few days of applying."

上海电力公司劳工局势。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处登记簿。编号 D 5310 日期 33年10月26日。）
（批注：D5310 Coulon）
昨日下午2时，上海总工会举行会议，约有100人出席，代表约70个工会。
通过下列决议：-
1. 各工会应尽力为上海电力公司“怠工”罢工者捐款，并向总工会提交请愿书，制定管理捐款分配的详细措施。
2. 各工会就上海电力公司的劳资纠纷发表宣言。
上海总工会昨日向各公共团体发出如下信函：-
“我们已尽一切努力防止上海电力公司的劳资纠纷蔓延，以维持电力供应、社区和平秩序及所有用户的权益。然而，争端依然严重，且逐渐恶化。
“兹就工人提出的五项要求作如下解释：-
“首先，我们必须代表工人声明，此次纠纷并非由解雇某些工人引起。罢工 arose（起因于）工人希望保护其未来的生计和权利。阅读第4项要求即可证明这一点，该项规定在400名被解雇工人中恢复7人的职务。
“其次，为了帮助管理层，工人已放弃恢复400名被解雇或离职工人职务的要求，仅保留前述七人除外。根据第2项要求，工人表示愿意遵守管理层因工人犯有违反规章之过错而将其解雇的规定。这表明工人的态度是合理的。
“第三，其余三项要求基于《工厂法》及工人待遇的常规程序；不能被视为不合理。遵照该公司在美国发布的承诺‘我们渴望让员工成为我们团体的一员’，那些被公司认为忠于职守的员工，其养老金基金将予以增加，并享受与外国人同等的待遇。
“最后，我们必须声明，我们已竭尽全力推动调解以解决争端。继工人罢工后，我们建议工人维持电力供应，以维护公共安全和用户权益。近来，我们筹集资金以协助维持工人生计，以免事态扩大至严重程度，并于今日发表声明以供公众知晓。此后，由于缺乏资金，我们将不再发表进一步声明，或者可能再也没有机会发表此类声明。
“兹请求公众支持这一正义事业。欲了解纠纷详细情况者，可向本会索取正在印刷中的《上海电力公司劳资纠纷报告》，申请后数日内即可送达。”

October 25, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

With reference to the labour trouble in
the Shanghai Power Company, Pao Kuo-hwa, the special
deputy of the Ministry of Industry, has sent a
telegraphic report to the Ministry on his investigations
into the dispute. He will return to Nanking as soon
as his mission has been carried out.

At the request of various public bodies,
the Shanghai Municipal Council has undertaken the
mediation. At 3 p.m. yesterday, Mr. Fessenden,
Secretary-General of the Council, invited Mr. Doo
Yueh-sin, member of the Council of the Chinese
Municipality, to discuss ways and means to settle
the trouble.

It is reported that the General Labour
Union will call a meeting of various labour unions
at 2 p.m. to-day in its premises on Foh You Road,
Nantao, at which definite measures to render assistance
to the workers will be discussed.

Shun Pao:

The Shanghai Electrical Goods Trade
Association yesterday sent the following letter to
the Shanghai Power Company:-
The labour dispute in your Company has lasted
thirty days. This is indeed most unfortunate and
we regret to hear of it. All our members are paying
close attention to this matter. Many members of our
Association have received complaints from their
customers about delays in the installation of electric
lights and making connections. This has caused great
inconvenience to our business. We have to request
you to settle the dispute peacefully as soon as possible.
As our business is closely related with
that of your Company, we write this to advise you and
hope you will not misunderstand our attitude.

A Correction.

The Social Bureau sent the following letter
to the "Chen Pao" on October 24:-
The report published by your paper to-day
about the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company
is not correct.
This Bureau is an official organ dealing
with labour troubles in this city. We held a meeting
on October 23 with representatives of workers of the
Shanghai Power Company. Only Pao Kuo-hwa, representing
the Ministry of Industry, and the representatives of
the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang attended.
No delegates of any other bodies were present.
Please make a correction.

关于上海电力公司的劳资纠纷，实业部特派员鲍国华已向部里发送电报，汇报其对纠纷的调查情况。一旦任务完成，他将返回南京。

应各公共团体的请求，上海公共租界工部局已着手进行调解。昨日下午3时，工部局总办费森登（Fessenden）先生邀请华界市政府委员杜月笙（Doo Yueh-sin）先生，讨论解决纠纷的方法。

据悉，总工会将于今日下午2时在其南市福佑路址召开各工会会议，讨论援助工人的具体措施。

《申报》：

上海电气商品同业公会昨日致函上海电力公司如下：-
贵公司的劳资纠纷已持续三十天。这确实非常不幸，我们对此深感遗憾。我们会所有成员都在密切关注此事。本会许多会员收到客户关于电灯安装和接线延误的投诉。这给我们的业务造成了极大不便。我们恳请贵公司尽快和平解决纠纷。
由于我们的业务与贵公司的业务密切相关，特致函劝告，希望不要误解我们的态度。

贵报今日刊登的关于上海电力公司劳资纠纷的报道不实。
本局是处理本市劳资纠纷的官方机构。我们于10月23日与上海电力公司工人代表举行了会议。仅有代表实业部的鲍国华和上海特别区国民党代表出席。没有其他团体的代表在场。

October 24, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

D5310 LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

With the object of bringing about an early settlement of the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company, the Social Bureau yesterday afternoon summoned the representatives of the workers and questioned them closely into the causes of the strike, the measures adopted by the Company for the payment of pensions and the minimum demands of the workers. At the close of the inquiry, the Bureau instructed the representatives to submit the grounds of their demands with supporting evidence.

It is reported that the Shanghai Municipal Council yesterday held a meeting at which Zee Hoong-sun, a representative of the workers, was present and was interrogated about the attitude of the workers.
The report as published in newspapers to the effect that both the Shanghai Municipal Council and the Social Bureau had held special meetings yesterday afternoon is untrue.

It is understood that in view of the serious labour situation in the Shanghai Power Company, the Ministry of Industry has detailed to Shanghai Pao Kuo-hwa, chief of the 4th Section of the Labour Department, to make an investigation into the dispute.
Two committee members of the General Labour Union were detailed yesterday to call on Pao Kuo-hwa to make a detailed report on the circumstances of the strike. Ways and means to deal with the dispute were discussed.
Further discussions will be held to-day.
At 2 p.m. yesterday, Pao Kuo-hwa held a meeting at the Social Bureau at which representatives of the Bureau, the local Tangpu, the General Labour Union and the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union were present.
After enquiring into the causes and circumstances of the labour trouble, Pao Kuo-hwa instructed the representative of the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union to submit a written report together with the demands of the workers.

LABOUR.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

LABOUR TROUBLE IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

More than one month has elapsed, and the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company still remains unsettled. In view of the fact that the dispute may affect the peace and order in the community, Mr. Fessenden, Secretary-General of the Shanghai Municipal Council, invited Mr. Doo Yueh-sun, member of the Council of the Chinese Municipality, to discuss measures for bringing about an early settlement of the dispute.

At 11 a.m. yesterday, Mr. Doo Yueh-sun called on Mr. Fessenden and the result of their discussion was stated to be very satisfactory.

It is reported that Mr. Fessenden will now submit proposals to the Company so that this serious dispute may be settled.

The Shanghai General Labour Union secured contributions and distributed them on November 4 and 5 for the relief of the "go-slow" strikers.

page_data.en:
November 5, 1933. Mornir Translation.
LABOUR
Min Pao and other local newspapers:
LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY
One month and five days have passed since the commencement of the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company and there is still no hope of settling the dispute owing to the stubborn attitude of the company and its refusal to accept the proposals from various quarters.
Yesterday the company commenced to recruit new hands but only a few persons applied for positions.
The Central People's Movement Direction Committee has dispatched a letter of congratulation to the strikers for having maintained good order during the strike.
Since the workers have declared a "go-slow" strike, great inconvenience has been caused to subscribers owing to the suspension of certain operations in the plant. The company has detailed men to force workers to resume. These workers still maintained a "go-slow" strike after entering the company and have not all withdrawn from the premises. Yesterday the company started to recruit new hands.
According to information secured by a reporter of the Dah Kung News Agency only a few persons applied for work as most Chinese labourers sympathize with the "go-slow" strikes and are unwilling to aid in the collapse of the strike.
Yesterday, the 4th District Waterworks and Electricity Trade Union received the following letter dated November 3 from the Central People's Movement Direction Committee :
"More than one month has passed since the commencement of the dispute between your union and the Shanghai Power Company.
"According to the report made by our agent, the entire body of workers was compelled to declare a strike and their activities have all been maintained in a peaceful manner. This proves that the movement has been conducted under the systematic guidance of your union.
"Please inform the entire body of your workers to maintain order until you obtain just settlement."
page_data.zh:
1933年11月5日。晨间译稿。
劳工
《民报》及其他本地报纸：
上海电力公司的劳工局势
上海电力公司劳资纠纷爆发至今已过去一个月零五天，由于公司态度顽固并拒绝接受各方提议，纠纷仍无解决的希望。
昨日公司开始招募新工人，但仅有少数人申请职位。
中央民众运动指导委员会致信罢工者，祝贺他们在罢工期间维持了良好的秩序。
自从工人宣布“怠工”罢工以来，由于工厂部分业务停顿，给用户带来了极大不便。公司已派遣人员强迫工人复工。这些工人进入公司后仍保持“怠工”状态，并未全部撤离厂区。昨日公司开始招募新工人。
据大公通讯社记者获得的消息，仅有少数人申请工作，因为大多数中国劳工同情“怠工”罢工，不愿协助导致罢工失败。
昨日，第四区水电业工会收到中央民众运动指导委员会一封日期为11月3日的来信，内容如下：
“贵工会与上海电力公司之间的纠纷爆发已逾一月。
据我方代理人报告，全体工人被迫宣布罢工，且其活动均保持和平方式进行。这证明该运动是在贵工会的系统指导下进行的。
请通知全体工人，在获得公正解决之前，务必维持秩序。”

November 4, 3.

Labour (2)

Shanghai Power Company - Situation

The situation in the various departments of the
Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning.

Of the 300 men who presented themselves on November 3
at Riverside Power Station seeking employment in the
places of those on strike, 82 were chosen and their
particulars taken after which they were (given) each a chit,
and told to return on Tuesday, November 7. Thirteen
men applied for work at Fearon Road Depot on November 3,
the same procedure being followed as at Riverside.

This morning, November 4, 400 men, very few if any
of them being old employees of the Company, are at
Riverside Power Station looking for work and up to 9 a.m.
40 men had been chosen.

To date, the Company has taken on some 300 White
Russians who have to an appreciable degree taken the
places of the Chinese on strike. Several of them are
skilled and have the complete reliance of their employers.

At the head office the management have obtained
the services of a few foreign girls to operate billing-
machines which were originally operated by Chinese now
on strike. It is the intention of the management
to keep on these girls as a skeleton staff in case
of strikes of the clerical staff in the future.

今晨，上海电力公司各部门的局势保持不变。

11月3日，有300人前往江边发电厂求职，以填补罢工者的空缺，其中82人被选中并登记了个人资料，随后每人发给一张纸条，并被告知于11月7日星期二返回。11月3日，有十三人向斐伦路堆栈申请工作，程序与江边发电厂相同。

今晨（11月4日），有400人在江边发电厂求职，其中极少（如果有的话）是公司的老员工。截至上午9时，已有40人被选中。

截至目前，公司已雇佣了约300名白俄，他们在很大程度上取代了罢工的中国工人。其中几人技术熟练，并完全获得了雇主的信任。

在总公司，管理层雇佣了几名外国女孩来操作计费机，这些机器原本由现已罢工的中国员工操作。管理层的意图是保留这些女孩作为骨干职员，以防将来文职人员发生罢工。

朱浩生主持会议并发表演讲，敦促上海电力公司工人坚持罢工。他还报告称，将在已确定的要求基础上，增加以下涉及该公司临时工的要求：

2. 如果资方拒绝接受这一要求，当资方解雇临时工时，应向其发放相当于三个月工资的遣散费。

第二位发言者是总工会委员朱學範（Chu Hsueh-fan），他报告说，总工会收到上海电力公司的一封信，信中称期望在不久的将来合理解决此次纠纷。他勉励罢工工人团结起来争取最终胜利，并主张对

工贼采取严厉措施。朱还表示，总工会将协助罢工工人对付这些工贼。他最后宣布，总工会已从当地党部、公共团体以及杜月笙处筹集到10,000.00元，这笔款项将于11月5日上午10时至中午12时在市中心总工会办公室分发给斐伦路发电站的罢工工人和临时工，并于11月6日同一时间分发给江边工人。

随后，代表当地党部的罗敬之（Loh Ching-dz，音译）上台发言，他对会议出席人数众多表示高兴。他指出，上海电力公司的罢工象征着为国家劳工的荣耀而反对帝国主义资本家的斗争。该党部代表最后勉励工人坚持斗争，并在纠纷解决之前保持和平与秩序。

随后讨论并通过了以下决议：

1. 所有罢工工人坚持罢工。

2. 派遣四名代表前往南京，向南京政府请求援助。

3. 采取严厉措施对付破坏罢工者以及新招募的工人，以防止他们进入公司受雇。会议还决定，如果此类工贼居住在发电站范围内，则对其家属采取同样措施。

page_data.en:
November 4, 3.

Labour (5)

Chu Hsueh-fan representing the General Labour Union
again took the platform and stated that the Strike
Committee of the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers'
Union should investigate the reason of the foremen failing
to attend the meeting and that drastic measures be taken
against those who were not present. The meeting was
then concluded with the shouting of the following slogans :
1. Swear not to resume work unless our demands are
accepted !
2. Long live the Chinese Kuomintang !
3. Long live the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers'
Union !

The following slogans were exhibited in the body
of the theatre :-
1. Down with Imperialists !
2. Our struggle is for justice !
3. Down with labour traitors and running dogs !
4. Labour traitors who break the strike are to be
severely dealt with !

During the proceedings, copies of a leaflet entitled
"Manifesto of the Meeting" and purporting to emanate
from the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers' Union
were distributed among the attendance. The document
stated that the management was very much at a loss
following the recent damage to machines of the Power
Stations and were employing policemen to coerce workers
to resume work. The management was accused of having
the intention of breaking the union and destroying
the power of Chinese labour. The leaflet further
stated that the workers would continue to struggle on the
page_data.zh:
11月3日。

劳工（5）

代表总工会的朱學範再次上台发言，指出第四区水电工会罢工委员会应调查领班未出席会议的原因，并对缺席者采取严厉措施。会议最后在呼喊以下口号声中结束：
1. 除非我们的要求被接受，否则誓不复工！
2. 中国国民党万岁！
3. 第四区水电工会万岁！

剧场内展示了以下标语：
1. 打倒帝国主义者！
2. 我们的斗争是为了正义！
3. 打倒工贼和走狗！
4. 严惩破坏罢工的工贼！

会议期间，向与会者分发了一份题为《大会宣言》的传单副本，该传单声称出自第四区水电工会。文件称，由于最近发电站机器受损，资方感到非常困惑，并雇用警察胁迫工人复工。资方被指控意图破坏工会并摧毁中国劳工的力量。传单进一步指出，工人将继续按照

0
November 8, 3.

Labour (●)

same lines as hitherto adopted. It also contained
the five demands made by the strikers and the following
slogans :-

"Let the whole body of workers unite and wage a
"legal struggle under the direction of the Chinese
"Kuomintang and Governing Authorities ! Continue
"the struggle in a peaceful way for our modest
"demands ! The sending out of cars by the
"management and compelling workers to enter the
"Power Stations shows that the management is
"in a state of fear ! We swear not to start
"work unless our demands are accepted by the Company !
"Unity is our most useful weapon; our unity can
"cause the death of Imperialists !" Let us unite
"to the bitter end and we will be sure of
"the final victory !"

During the meeting a young Chinese of the student
type who was unknown to the strikers was assaulted by
the pickets of the strikers and driven out of the meeting
place.

At 2.30 p.m. November 3, a representative of the
Shanghai Municipality Drug Hong Workers' Union, 329
Chao Kya Road, Great East Gate, called at the 5th
District Water & Electricity Workers' Union, Shen Ying
Faung, Tien Doeng Road, Chapei, and handed over $20.00
as a contribution from the Drug Hong Workers' Union in
aid of the Shanghai Power Company strikers.

The Strike Committee of the Shanghai Power Company
workers claim that they have so far not brought out the
operating staff purely out of consideration for the
employees and workers in staple trades such as cotton
manufacturers, etc.

11月8日。

劳工（●）

迄今采用的相同方式进行斗争。其中还列出了罢工工人提出的五项要求以及以下标语：

“全体工人在中国国民党和当局指导下团结起来，进行‘合法’斗争！为我们适度的‘要求’以和平方式继续斗争！资方派出车辆并强迫工人进入‘发电站’，表明资方处于恐惧状态！我们发誓，除非公司接受我们的要求，否则绝不‘开工’！团结是我们最有力的武器；我们的团结可以‘导致帝国主义者的灭亡’！让我们团结到底，我们必将获得‘最终胜利’！”

会议期间，一名学生模样的年轻华人因不为罢工工人所识，遭到罢工纠察队的殴打并被赶出会场。

11月3日下午2时30分，上海特别市药宏工会（地址：大东门兆嘉路329号）的一名代表前往闸北天通庵路沈英坊（Shen Ying Faung，音译）第五区水电工会，递交了药宏工会捐助上海电力公司罢工工人的20.00元。

上海电力公司工人罢工委员会声称，截至目前，他们尚未让运营人员罢工，纯粹是出于对棉纺厂等主要行业雇员和工人的考虑，

page_data.en:
November 4, 3.

Labour (U)
whose livelihood depends on an uninterrupted supply of power.
The representatives of the strikers have place on this
particular point when soliciting funds from the Cotton Mill
Workers' Union and other people.

The management of the Shanghai Power Company have been
approached during the past two weeks by representatives of
large firms of cotton manufacturers in Shanghai as to the
possibility of there being a shortage of power in the event
of the operating staff being called out on strike by the Union.
In each case the callers were informed that the Company has
taken every precaution to maintain the supply of power to
consumers whether private or public and that the service will
be maintained unless something unforeseen happens. The
Company are confident that the stoppage of the operating
staff will in no wise cripple the supply of power nor even
cause them to curtail its supply.

Hsu Shing Loh, General Manager of the National Commercial
Bank, L.T. Yuen, Chinese advisor to the S.M.C. and Wong Shiao
Lai, Chairman of the Chamber of Commerce, together with
numerous other prominent Chinese have formed a committee and
have approached the management of the Shanghai Power
Company with regard to an early settlement of the existing
dispute; Hsu Shing Loh and L. T. Yuen in an interview with
Mr. Hopkins, President of the Company, stated that they could
get the men back to work if the Company would promise
to negotiate a settlement at an early date.
page_data.zh:
11月3日。

劳工（U）
这些行业的生计依赖于不间断的电力供应。罢工代表在向棉纺业工会及其他人士募捐时，特别强调了这一点。

在过去两周内，上海大型棉纺厂商的代表曾就工会号召运营人员罢工可能导致电力短缺的可能性，接洽上海电力公司管理层。在每次接洽中，来访者均被告知，公司已采取一切预防措施，以维持对私人和公共用户的电力供应，除非发生不可预见的情况，否则服务将得以维持。公司确信，运营人员的停工绝不会削弱电力供应，甚至不会导致其减少供应。

国家商业银行总经理徐星洛（Hsu Shing Loh，音译）、工部局华务顾问袁履登（L.T. Yuen）以及商会主席王晓籁（Wong Shiao Lai，音译）连同其他许多知名华人组成一个委员会，并就尽早解决现有纠纷一事接洽上海电力公司管理层；徐星洛和袁履登在与公司董事长霍普金斯先生（Mr. Hopkins）会晤时表示，如果公司承诺早日谈判解决纠纷，他们可以让工人复工。

November 4, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

With reference to the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company, the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union at 10 a.m. yesterday held a general meeting in the premises of the Kung Wu (共舞) Cinema Theatre at Fong Pang Jao, West Gate, at which about 1,800 persons, including representatives of the General Labour Union and the local Tangpu, were present.

Chu Hou-sun (朱後孫), who presided over the meeting, made the following report:-
"Following the outbreak of the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company, the Chinese members of the Shanghai Municipal Council were requested to open negotiations with the management. But owing to disloyalty on the part of a certain number of workers, the 2,000 hands were tricked into abandoning the right to obtain the superannuation funds. The management was unwilling to settle the dispute immediately and schemed to induce a minority of the strikers to resume. Any worker who does not maintain a firm attitude will find no method of regress when he is discharged by the management. The present "go-slow" strike has been instituted to warn those imperialists and reveal the unity of the workers. All workers are expected to maintain their firm attitude until their object is attained."

Loh Ching-shih (陸京士) of the local Tangpu made the following statement:-
"The Tangpu is quite aware of the demands of the workers. Over one month has elapsed, yet none of the strikers returned to duty of their own accord. Some had been forced to resume work, but this action did not influence the other workers. This spirit of unity is highly admired. The management has refused to accept your demands. Workers are of course not in a position to resist by force; they can only declare a strike as a sign of their intention to resist oppression. Following the outbreak of this labour trouble, the Tangpu has paid careful attention to the situation. The management is of the opinion that the strikers will resume on their own accord when they are unable to obtain their livelihood. Therefore, the strikers should be firm in their attitude and outwit the imperialists."

Chu Hsueh-van (朱學范) of the General Labour Union then delivered the following speech:-
"One month and four days has passed since the declaration of the strike of workers on September 29. The management is endeavouring to arrange a settlement of the dispute and has submitted its request to responsible officials of the General Labour Union. But we will not agree to its request until adequate measures of security have been drawn up for us.
"According to a letter from the Shanghai Municipal Council, the despatch of the General Labour Union has been

1933年11月4日。晨间译文。

劳工。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司劳工局势。

关于上海电力公司的劳工纠纷，第四区水电业工会于昨日上午10时在西门方浜角共舞电影院旧址举行全体会议，约有1,800人出席，其中包括总工会和当地党部的代表。

主持会议的朱後孫（Chu Hou-sun）作了如下报告：
“上海电力公司劳工纠纷爆发后，曾请求上海市议会华员议员与管理层进行谈判。但由于部分工人不忠，2,000名工人被骗放弃了获取养老金基金的权利。管理层不愿立即解决纠纷，并策划诱使少数罢工者复工。任何不能保持坚定态度的工人，在被管理层解雇时将无路可退。目前的‘怠工’罢工旨在警告那些帝国主义者，并展现工人的团结。期望所有工人保持坚定态度，直至达到目的。”

当地党部的陆京士（Loh Ching-shih）作了如下声明：
“党部完全了解工人的要求。一个多月过去了，没有罢工者自愿返岗。有些人被迫复工，但这一行动并未影响其他工人。这种团结精神令人钦佩。管理层拒绝接受你们的要求。工人当然无力以武力抵抗；他们只能宣布罢工，作为抵抗压迫意向的标志。劳工纠纷爆发后，党部密切关注局势。管理层认为，罢工者在无法维持生计时会自愿复工。因此，罢工者应保持态度坚定，智胜帝国主义者。”

随后，总工会的朱學範（Chu Hsueh-van）发表了如下演讲：
“自9月29日宣布工人罢工以来，已过去一个月零四天。管理层正努力安排解决纠纷，并向总工会负责人提出了请求。但在为我们制定充分的安全保障措施之前，我们不会同意其请求。
“根据上海市议会的一封信，总工会的派遣已被

November 4, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

submitted to the Shanghai Power Company and a reason-
able settlement of the dispute may be arrived at. The
investigations made by officials of the People's
Movement Committee of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters
and the Ministry of Industry reveal that our activities
are lawful.
"Owing to the fact that no measures for a
settlement can be devised, Mr. Fessenden, Secretary-
General of the S.M.C., has invited Mr. Doo Yueh-sun
(杜月笙), a prominent person, to mediate.
"We have secured a loan of an adequate amount
to be distributed for the relief of the workers; the
hands of the old plant are to be issued with relief
pay on Sunday morning and those of the new plant on
Monday morning, so that their livelihood during the
period of the strike may be maintained."
Consequently, the following resolutions were
passed:-
1. That no work be resumed until the object is
attained.
2. That traitors and "running dogs" be severely
punished.
3. That Chu Hou-sun (朱洪琛), Chiang Tsen-min (蒋正明),
Chen Yeu-fah (陈友发) and Chao Tuh-chuan (曹德全)
be detailed to submit an appeal to the Central Tangpu,
the National Government, the Executive Yuan and the
Ministry of Industry.
It is reported that at about 6 a.m. yesterday,
four or five more workers were forced to resume work by
the foreign staff members of the new plant.
The demands of the workers are as follows:-
1. That any employee having completed one year's
service upon being discharged by the Company should be
given a retiring gratuity equivalent to three months'
pay and a superannuation of % of the total wages received
during the period of his employment (all benefits to be
forfeited if the employee is convicted of a crime by the
Court).
2. That the Rules governing the dismissal of Chinese
employees be clearly stated.
3. That a yearly bonus equivalent to one month's
pay be granted at every year-end to those employees
having one year's service with the Company.
4. That with regard to the 400 hands who were dismissed
without cause or discharged by the Company, seven be
reinstated.
5. That wages for the period of the "go-slow" strike
be paid.

Pao Tuh-foh (包德福), one of the strikers of
the Shanghai Power Company, has made the following
statement to our reporter:-
"The workers of the Shanghai Power Company
declared a "go-slow" strike a month ago. Due to the
obstinate attitude of the management and their repeated
page_data.zh:

劳工事务。

已提交给上海电力公司，纠纷有望达成合理解决。经国民党中央总部民众运动委员会及实业部官员调查，显示我方活动合法。
“由于无法制定解决措施，工部局总办费森登（Fessenden）先生已邀请知名人士杜月笙先生进行调解。
“我们已获得一笔足额贷款，用于发放工人救济金；老厂工人将于周日上午领取救济金，新厂工人将于周一上午领取，以维持罢工期间的生活。”
因此，通过以下决议：-
1. 在目标达成之前，不得复工。
2. 严惩叛徒和“走狗”。
3. 指派朱洪琛、蒋正明、陈友发和曹德全向中央党部、国民政府、行政院和实业部提交请愿书。
据报道，昨天早上6点左右，又有四到五名工人被新厂的外籍职员强迫复工。
工人的要求如下：-
1. 凡在公司服务满一年后被解雇的员工，应给予相当于三个月工资的退职金，以及相当于受雇期间所得工资总额一定百分比的养老金（如员工被法院判定有罪，则所有福利予以没收）。
2. 明确陈述解雇中国员工的规则。
3. 凡在公司服务满一年的员工，每年年底应发给相当于一个月工资的年终奖金。
4. 关于被公司无故解雇或开除的400名工人，其中七人应复职。
5. 支付“怠工”罢工期间的工资。

上海电力公司罢工者之一包德福（音译）向记者发表如下声明：
“上海电力公司工人于一个月前宣布‘怠工’罢工。由于管理层态度顽固，并一再拒绝

rejection of proposals offered by the Kuomintang and

劳工事务。

（批注：D. 5210 Cantin）
国民党及其他政治机构提出的建议，导致无法找到解决纠纷的措施。该公司现已发布招聘新工人的通知。在问题解决之前，第四区水电业工会决心阻止招聘新工人，并将防止前罢工者返回工作岗位。公司声称那些被迫复工的工人仍在工作的说法完全不实。”

The situation in the various departments of the.

115310 上海电力公司 - 1933年11月3日局势。
今晨，上海电力公司各部门的局势保持不变。由于管理层在其各处所张贴了关于招聘新工人的通知，今天上午有三百名求职者（即罢工者）来到江边发电厂计时处应聘。目前正在审查这些人的资格，那些被认为适合其所申请职位的人将被要求于11月7日星期二再次前来。
据报道，煽动者曾于11月2日试图诱使江边发电厂的运营人员罢工，以声援车间和配电部门的工人。

page_data.en:
Chen Pao and other local newspapers: 3/11/33.

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

Notwithstanding repeated proposals by the
"go-slow" strikers of the Shanghai Power Company to
make concessions, the management is still unwilling
to accept the demands by the hands. The 4th District
Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union will hold
a general meeting of the entire body of members at 9 a.m.
to-day at the Kung Wu Theatre (共和大戲院), West Gate,
for the purpose of discussing definite measures to deal
with the labour trouble in the Power Company.
The Union will at the same time issue a
manifesto reading as follows:-
"Over one month has elapsed since the employees
of the Shanghai Power Company were compelled to declare
a "go-slow" strike. The management has stubbornly rejected
the efforts of people in various local circles to mediate
in the dispute. The management is now alarmed at the
damage done to machinery in the plants and is utilizing
detectives and policemen to force strikers to work.
The object in this is to break the unity of the workers.
"Peaceful struggles lasting for a month have
not induced the stubborn concern to heed the interests
of the workers. We will henceforth continue our struggles
to gain a final victory."
page_data.zh:
《申报》及其他本地报纸：1933年11月3日。

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

尽管上海电力公司“怠工”罢工者反复提出让步建议，管理层仍不愿接受工人的要求。第四区水电业工会将于今日上午9时在西门共和大戏院召开全体会员大会，目的是讨论处理电力公司劳资纠纷的具体措施。
工会同时将发布一份宣言，内容如下：-
“上海电力公司员工被迫宣布‘怠工’罢工已逾一月。管理层顽固拒绝各界人士调解纠纷的努力。管理层现在对工厂机器受损感到恐慌，并利用侦探和警察强迫罢工者工作。此举旨在破坏工人的团结。
“持续一个月的和平斗争未能促使这家顽固的公司重视工人的利益。我们将继续斗争，直至取得最终胜利。”

China Times:
In connection with the dispute between the Shang-
hai Power Company and their employees, the Chinese Ratepayers
Association addressed a letter on the 20th of October to the
Shanghai Municipal Council, the substance of which reads as
follows:-
"This Association is in receipt of a letter dated
Oct.14 from the 20th Branch Office of the Shanghai Citizens
Federation and the Foochow Road Street Union stating the
following:- 'Since the outbreak of the labour trouble at the
Shanghai Power Company, the residents of Shanghai have
all been living in a state of anxiety. The attitude
adopted by the power company towards the problem is
similar to that adopted by the capitalists in American
of whom President Roosevelt said "They care only for
their own interests, and disregard the lives of others."
'The trouble is now tending to become more serious
everyday in consequence of the management devoting it-
self to the policy of amassing wealth. The company
disregards the advice of Chinese Councillors of the
S.M.C. and the Chairman of the Chamber of Commerce,
so no wonder our poor labourers count for nothing.
'The letter you sent to the S.M.C. demanding the
supervision of the enterprise is just and expresses
the sentiments of the public of this city.
'The correspondence and documents published by the
Power Company in the evening papers of yesterday's issue
and in the morning papers assert not only that the
labourers are in the wrong but also that the manifesto
issued by the Greater Shanghai Chamber of Commerce and
the letters from your Association are not correct and
are only published to confuse the public. The Shanghai
Power Company perceives the faults of others but not
its own.
'For your information, we beg to correct the state-
ments made by the Power Company.
1) Regarding the rate for electric supply, it is sti-
pulated in the franchise for the supply of electricity
that the schedule drawn up by the S.M.C.Electricity De-
partment shall be the maximum rates and that these rates
shall be reduced according to circumstances. The reason
the Power Company suggested for increasing the rate
with effect from Jan.1 of last year is the higher cost
of coal, but now that the price for Japanese coal has been
reduced to one half of the cost prevailing at the
time of the increase in rates, why did not the company
reduce their rates in proportion to the cost of the coal?
The statement that the increase in rates is only 0.036%
on the old schedule is not true, for the rate is increased
from $0.11 to $0.12, which is an increase of 0.099%.
This illustration of trickery on the part of the company
determines what value can be put on the rest of their
statements. They company said that the wages for the
Chinese staff have been increased 0.06%. As a matter

劳工
《字林西报》（China Times）：
关于上海电力公司与其员工之间的纠纷，上海华人纳税会于10月20日致函上海公共租界工部局，主要内容如下：-
“本会收到上海市民联合会第二十办事处及福州路街道联合会10月14日来信，陈述如下：‘自从上海电力公司发生劳资纠纷以来，上海居民一直处于焦虑状态。电力公司对此问题采取的态度，类似于罗斯福总统所说的美国资本家的态度，即‘他们只关心自己的利益，而不顾他人的生命’。
‘由于管理层致力于聚敛财富的政策，纠纷日益严重。该公司无视工部局华董和商会主席的建议，难怪我们可怜的劳工无足轻重。
‘贵会致函工部局要求对该企业进行监管，这是公正的，也表达了本市公众的情感。
‘电力公司在昨晚的晚报和今晨的报纸上刊登的信函和文件，不仅声称劳工有误，还声称上海总商会发布的宣言以及贵会的信函不正确，发布这些只是为了混淆公众视听。上海电力公司只看到别人的过错，却看不到自己的过错。
‘特此更正电力公司的陈述，供贵方参考。
1) 关于供电费率，供电特许经营权规定，由工部局电气处制定的价目表应为最高费率，且这些费率应根据情况降低。电力公司建议从去年1月1日起提高费率的理由是煤炭成本较高，但现在日本煤炭的价格已降至费率提高时价格的一半，为何公司不按煤炭成本比例降低费率？声称费率仅比旧价目表增加0.036%的说法不属实，因为费率从$0.11增加到$0.12，增幅为0.099%。公司这种欺诈性的举例说明，决定了其其余陈述的价值。公司称中国员工的工资增加了0.06%。事实上，

of fact, rates and wages and salaries cannot be compared. For instance, if the increase in rate was 0.0206% and the resultant profit $10,000,000, the additional income would be $360,000, while the increase in salaries and wages would be $20,600 taking the total amount of the pay roll at $100,000.
2) Regarding this item, no examination is required, for the employment of a great number of white Russians is the best evidence to refute the statement of the company. The salary for their foreign employees is $100,000 a month and the pay for Chinese employees is only $10,000 or so.
3) Regarding superannuation funds, if no issue is granted to employees dismissed by the company or to those who resign of their own accord, the provision of superannuation funds, no matter how generous the amounts are, is futile.
4) The company declare that their meters are very accurate, but it is to be noted that the assertion is only made by the company. Credence can only be established by having these meters inspected by a public inspection committee in a similar way as coins and bank notes are inspected by the Government Mint and the banks.
'In short, the statements made by the company cannot be belived until after they are corroborated by a permanent inspection committee.
'As the interests of the general public are involved, we beg to ask you from the standpoint of ratepayers to continue urging the Shanghai Municipal Council to intervene in order that President Roosevelt's dictum will not hold in Shanghai.'

费率与工资薪金不可相提并论。例如，如果费率增加0.0206%，由此产生的利润为$10,000,000，则额外收入为$360,000，而如果工资薪金总额为$100,000，则工资薪金的增加额为$20,600。
2) 关于此项，无需审查，因为雇佣大量白俄人是反驳公司陈述的最佳证据。其外籍员工的月薪为$100,000，而中国员工的薪水仅为$10,000左右。
3) 关于养老金基金，如果被公司解雇的员工或自行辞职的员工得不到任何发放，那么无论金额多么慷慨，提供养老金基金都是徒劳的。
4) 公司宣称其电表非常准确，但值得注意的是，这一断言仅由公司单方面作出。只有通过类似政府造币厂和银行检查硬币及钞票的方式，由公共检查委员会对这些电表进行检查，才能确立可信度。
‘总之，在得到永久检查委员会的证实之前，公司的陈述不可信。
‘鉴于涉及公共利益，我们从纳税人的角度恳请贵方继续敦促上海公共租界工部局介入，以免罗斯福总统的论断在上海应验。’

Shanghai Power Company - Situation

The situation at Riverside Power Station remains
unchanged this morning. Sixteen meter-men from Fearon
Road Depot, who resumed on Monday, October 30, left the
premises last evening but gave no intimation as to
their intentions.

The notices prepared by the management in connection
with the employment of new hands to take the place of
strikers, to which reference was made on the report on
November 1, were posted at the works on Fearon Road
at 6 p.m. yesterday and will probably be put up at Riverside
Power Station to-day.

Zung Ching Loh (□ □ □), staff employee of the
Company, who was shot and wounded in Chinese territory
on October 20, continues to make progress towards recovery.

The Propaganda Department of the "tai-kung" Strike
Committee of the 4th District Water & Electricity
Workers' Union (formed by the Shanghai Power Company
workers) issued on the forenoon of November 1 copies of
an "urgent notice" to its members. The notice sets
forth the following resolutions which, it is alleged,
were passed at a meeting of foremen and workers of the
Fearon Road Power Station on the afternoon of October 31 :

1. That a general meeting of workers of the Fearon Road
and Riverside Power Stations be convened (date and
venue not yet decided upon).

2. That the workers, who were forced by the management to
work in the Power Stations, be persuaded to leave the
station premises.

November 2, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

It is reported that 78 strikers of the
Shanghai Power Company have been forced to resume work.
According to a certain staff member of the
Domestic Service Department of the Shanghai Power
Company, the management has decided to engage a large
number of new hands to assist in the operation of the
plants.
With a view to bringing about an early
settlement of the dispute, the various local fellow
provincials associations will detail 4 representatives
to submit an appeal to the Shanghai Municipal Council
at 10 a.m. yesterday requesting its intervention in
the unlawful activities of the Shanghai Power Company.
Fearing that the dispute may spread,
Messrs. Yue Yah-Ching and Yuan Lee-tung, Chinese members
of the Shanghai Municipal Council, and
Mr. Doo Yueh-sun, member of the Council of the Chinese
Municipality, have drawn up proposals to be submitted
within a few days.
The "Min Pao" reports that about 20 strikers
who were forced to resume work yesterday by the Chinese
and foreign engineers of the Company have escaped
from the plants and made a report to the 4th District
Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union on the
activities of the management.
Alleging that the Company is not sincere in
conducting negotiations and that forcing workers to
resume work constitutes an obstruction to unity among
the workers, the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity
Trade Workers Union will hold a general meeting at
9 a.m. to-morrow (November 3) in the premises of the
Kung Woo (共和) Cinema Theatre at Fong Pang Jao (方浜桥),
West Gate, at which measures to be adopted will be
discussed. A petition has been submitted to the General
Labour Union, the local Tangpu and other political organs
to detail officials to preside at the function.

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司劳工局势。

据报道，上海电力公司有78名罢工者被迫复工。
据上海电力公司家务部某职员称，管理层已决定雇佣大量新员工以协助工厂运营。
为促使纠纷早日解决，各本地同乡会将派遣4名代表，于昨日上午10时向上海公共租界工部局提交请愿书，请求其干预上海电力公司的非法活动。
因担心纠纷蔓延，上海公共租界工部局华董岳亚青（Yue Yah-Ching，音译）和袁立东（Yuan Lee-tung，音译），以及华界市政府委员杜月笙（Doo Yueh-sun，音译）已起草提案，拟于数日内提交。
《民报》报道称，约20名昨日被公司中外工程师强迫复工的罢工者已从工厂逃出，并向第四区水电业工会报告了管理层的行动。
第四区水电业工会指控公司缺乏谈判诚意，且强迫工人复工构成对工人团结的阻碍，该工会将于明日（11月3日）上午9时在西门方浜桥（Fong Pang Jao，音译）共和电影院址举行大会，讨论将采取的措施。已向总工会、本地党部及其他政治机关提交请愿书，请求派遣官员主持此次会议。

October 23, 1933.    Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

A joint meeting was held on the evening
of October 21 by the various fellow provincials
associations in the premises of the Ningpo Fellow
Provincials Association on Thibet Road. Yih Zing-kao
(葉翔皋), representative of the General Labour Union,
was present.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That a manifesto be issued.
2. That letters be sent to all mediators requesting
them to submit proposals immediately.
3. That officials be despatched to console the
waterworks employees and electricity trade workers.
4. That letters be addressed to the First and the
Second Shanghai Special Districts Citizens Federations
asking them for assistance.
5. That subscription books be provided by the
General Labour Union and sent to various fellow
provincials associations and that contributions to
relieve the condition of the workers be collected.
6. That a further meeting be held at 8 p.m.
November 4.
The various fellow provincials associations
have issued the following manifesto:-
"The electric supply is an important public
utility and therefore, the electricity enterprises in
other countries throughout the world are conducted by
the respective governments.
"It is only four years since the Electricity
Department of the Shanghai Municipal Council was taken
over by the Shanghai Power Company, but owing to the
inexperience of the latter concern in administering a
public utility enterprise, disputes between the management
and the workers have frequently arisen.
"Of late, the dismissal of workers and the
refusal of the payment of pensions by the management
have caused discontent among the workers.
"In the present crisis, the workers have
expressed their willingness to make concessions yet the
management, disregarding the rights of all subscribers,
refuses to settle the dispute.
"Many members of our associations are
subscribers of the Shanghai Power Company and should the
distribution of electricity be stopped one day, all the
subscribers would be greatly affected.
"We have held meetings to discuss measures
to cope with the matter and we resolved to give our
support to the workers if necessary. We hereby request
all public bodies to submit proposals with a view
to settling the dispute and maintaining peace and order
in the community."

劳工。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司劳工局势。

10月21日晚，各同乡会在西藏路宁波同乡会址举行联席会议。总工会代表叶翔皋（Yih Zing-kao）出席。
通过以下决议：
1. 发表宣言。
2. 致函所有调解人，请求他们立即提交提案。
3. 派遣官员慰问水电职工。
4. 致函上海第一、第二特别区市民联合会，请求协助。
5. 由总工会提供募捐簿，分送各同乡会，募集捐款以救济工人困境。
6. 于11月4日晚8时再次举行会议。
各同乡会发表如下宣言：
“电力供应是重要的公用事业，因此，世界各国之电力企业均由各自政府经营。
“上海公共租界工部局电气处移交上海电力公司经营仅四年，但由于后者在经营公用事业方面经验不足，管理层与工人之间纠纷频发。
“近期，管理层解雇工人并拒绝支付养老金，引起工人不满。
“在当前危机中，工人表示愿意做出让步，但管理层无视所有用户的权利，拒绝解决纠纷。
“我们会许多会员均为上海电力公司的用户，若停电一日，所有用户将深受影响。
“我们已召开会议讨论应对措施，并决议在必要时支持工人。特此请求各公共团体提交提案，以解决纠纷并维持社区和平与秩序。”

October 22, 1933.
Morning Translation

LABOUR

The various Provincial Associations sent the
following letter to the Chinese members of the S.M.C.:-
"Owing to the conduct of the management there
have been many labour disputes in the Shanghai Power
Company during the past year. The recent strike is the
most serious one. The situation is becoming serious.
If the strike continues, untoward incidents may be
expected. For this reason, we request you to mediate
in the dispute so that the interest of the public may
not be endangered and the anxiety of the Chinese workers
of the Company may be relieved."

The following is a letter addressed to the
1st and 2nd Special Districts Citizens Federations:-
"Nearly 20 days have past since the strike of
the Shanghai Power Company commenced, and no measures
for the settlement of the dispute have been devised.
Our Associations fears that, if this dispute continues
and when the supply of current is affected, the peace
and safety of the public will be in danger.
"As your Federations are the leading organizations
of the local citizens, we request you to hold a conference
with the various other public bodies to draft out
measures to cope with the situation, so that untoward
incidents may be prevented. Our Association will do
it's part in rendering you every assistance."

The following is a letter addressed to the
4th District Waterworks and Electricity Workers Unions:-
"Your Union has been at variance with the
management of the Shanghai Power Company for about 20
days. The dispute has not been settled owing to the
obstinate attitude adopted by the management. However,
your workers have maintained the supply of electric
current, which shows that you have considered the
interests of the public. We are quite satisfied with
your action. Besides requesting the Shanghai First
and Second Special Districts Citizens Federations to
discuss measures for the settlement of the dispute, we
have requested the Chinese members of the S.M.C. to
continue their efforts at mediation. We hope you will
continue the maintenance of the supply of electricity
to the public."

劳工

各同乡会致上海公共租界工部局华董如下信函：
“由于管理层的行径，上海电力公司在过去一年中发生多起劳资纠纷。最近的罢工是最严重的一次。局势正变得严峻。若罢工持续，预计会发生不幸事件。为此，我们请求你们调解此纠纷，以免公众利益受损，并缓解该公司中国工人的焦虑。”

以下是致第一和第二特别区市民联合会的信函：
“上海电力公司罢工已近20天，尚未制定出解决纠纷的措施。我会担心，若此纠纷持续且电流供应受到影响，公众的和平与安全将面临危险。
“鉴于贵联合会为本地市民的领导组织，我们请求你们与其他各公共团体举行会议，起草应对措施，以防不幸事件发生。我会将尽力提供一切协助。”

以下是致第四区水电工会的信函：
“贵工会与上海电力公司管理层的争执已持续约20天。由于管理层态度顽固，纠纷尚未解决。然而，贵方工人维持了电流供应，这表明你们考虑到了公众利益。我们对你们的行动深感满意。除请求上海第一、第二特别区市民联合会讨论解决纠纷的措施外，我们还请求上海公共租界工部局华董继续 efforts 进行调解。希望你们继续维持对公众的电力供应。”

Foh Lun Silk Filature - lookout

The Management of the Foh Lun (福倫) Silk
Filature, 558 Tien Pao (天寶) Road, Chapei, declared
a lockout on October 11 in consequence of the refusal
of its employees to resume work. The workers numbering
about 450 went on strike on October 8 in order to
emphasize their opposition to a decision of the filature
owners to reduce their wages. The Management has now
asked the local Kuomintang and the Bureau of Social
Affairs to endeavour to find a solution of the trouble.

Shanghai Power Company - Situation

The situation at the Shanghai Power Company has
not changed during the past twenty-four hours.

Junior clerks of the Shanghai Power Company to the
number of about thirty held a meeting in the Shanghai
Power Company Office Employees' Lien Yih Club, 84 Kang Ka
Loong, City, between 5.15 p.m. and 6 p.m. October 12 and
discussed the measures to be adopted in dealing with
persons who have so far failed to join the strike. It
was decided to organize a "Persuading Group" of ten members.
The duty of this group is to get into touch with employees
still working by telephone and to endeavour to persuade
them to join the strike. It was further agreed that the
leadership of the Persuading Group would be entrusted to
Chen Ching-loong (陳慶龍), who would submit reports on its
duties for the benefit of the Strike Committee.

上海电力公司 - 局势

过去二十四小时内，上海电力公司的局势未有变化。

上海电力公司约三十名初级职员于10月12日下午5时15分至6时之间，在市内康家弄（Kang Ka Loong，音译）84号上海电力公司职员联益俱乐部举行会议，讨论对迄今未参加罢工的人员采取的措施。决定组织一个十人“劝告组”。该组的职责是通过电话与仍在工作的员工联系，并努力说服他们加入罢工。会议还同意将劝告组的领导工作委托给陈庆龙（Chen Ching-loong），由其向罢工委员会汇报工作情况。

At 2 p.m. October 12, Wu Tso-bei (吳祖培), member
of the Strike Committee of the Employees of the Shanghai
Power Company called at the local Kuomintang where he
interviewed Tai You-hen (戴有恆), representative of
the Kuomintang and Chu Ching-tao (朱錦濤), representative
of the Bureau of Social Affairs and submitted the demands
of the employees which the Strike Committee had drawn up
during the meeting held on October 11. He left at
3 p.m. after having been told that the matter would
receive attention.

At 5 p.m. October 12, five Chinese of the labouring
class called at 50 Rue Marcel Tillot, and asked for a
personal interview with a worker named Ching Shueh-tso
(程學措), of the Shanghai Power Company who resides
there. On being told that Ching was out, the callers
stated that they had come to warn him to remain away
from work the following day. They added that the warning
had come from over 1,500 employees of the Company on
strike, and that drastic action would be taken if it was
not observed. They hinted that the plans they contemplated
would probably result in shooting.

It is noteworthy that Ching received a letter on
October 8, urging him to join the strike, and that the
letter purported to emanate from the Strike Committee.

10月12日下午5时，五名劳工阶层的华人来到马塞尔·蒂洛路（Rue Marcel Tillot）50号，要求与该处居住的上海电力公司一名叫程學措（Ching Shueh-tso）的工人进行私下会面。当被告知程不在家时，来访者称他们是来警告他第二天不要上班。他们补充说，这一警告来自该公司1,500多名罢工员工，如果不遵守，将采取严厉行动。他们暗示，他们计划的行动可能会导致枪击事件。

值得注意的是，程在10月8日收到一封信，敦促他加入罢工，该信声称出自罢工委员会。

The General Labour Union received an express
letter at noon October 12 from the People's Movement
Direction Committee of the Central Kuomintang saying
that its application to have a special delegate appointed
to mediate in the dispute between the workers and
management of the Shanghai Power Company had been noted.
The letter further stated that the Kuomintang Headquarters
of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai had been instructed
to take the matter up. This information was later confirmed
by Chiang Wai-soo (张韦苏), Chief Secretary of the local
Kuomintang who told Chu Hsueh-fan (朱学范), committee
member of the General Labour Union, that the situation is
being carefully watched with a view to advantage being
taken of any opportunity for mediation which arises.

The "Tai-kung Strike Committee" of the 4th District
Water and Electricity Workers' Union, 15 Shou Ying Faung,
Tiendoong Road, Chapei, issued a leaflet on October 12
entitled "Current News" which contains three sentences
as follows :-

1. All the clerical staff are participating in the
Movement.

2. A Telegram has been received from the People's
Movement Committee that the local Chinese
Authorities have been instructed to deal with
the strike (in the Shanghai Power Company).

3. Brain and Manual workers should persevere in the
dispute until victory is gained.

With regard to the second item the telegram mentioned
was received by the 4th District Water and Electricity
Workers' Union at 6 p.m. October 12.

10月12日中午，总工会收到国民党中央民众运动指导委员会的一封快信，称其关于指派特别代表调解上海电力公司劳资纠纷的申请已获知悉。信中还指出，已指示大上海市国民党市党部处理此事。这一消息后来得到当地国民党秘书长张韦苏（Chiang Wai-soo）的证实，他告诉总工会委员朱学范（Chu Hsueh-fan），当局正密切注视局势，以便利用出现的任何调解机会。

位于闸北天通庵路寿英坊15号的第四区水电工会“大公罢工委员会”于10月12日发布了一份题为《时事新闻》的传单，内容包含以下三句话：

1. 全体职员均参与此次运动。

2. 接民众运动委员会电报，称已指令中国地方当局处理（上海电力公司的）罢工事宜。

3. 脑力劳动者与体力劳动者应坚持斗争，直至取得胜利。

关于第二项，所述电报由第四区水电工会于10月12日下午6时收到。

page_data.en:
October 13, 3.

Labour (4)

In connection with the claims of the strikers
that the three dismissed employees, Sih Ah-pao (薛阿宝),
Tai Jen-keng (戴仁根 ) and Ying Ping-yoong (印炳荣 )
had been unfairly dealt with by the Company it is learnt
that responsible Chinese officials are of the opinion that
these discharged hands do not deserve consideration.

As for the complaint of the workers that the
Management have ruthlessly reduced the staff, it is
pointed out that when the S.M.E.D. passed into the hands
of the Company a certain amount of expansion work was in
progress. As this work was gradually completed, the
services of the men engaged on it ceased to be necessary.

The allegations of the strikers that the lower
grade employees at the Power Stations are poorly paid
have, on investigation, been shown to be exaggerated,
as these hands are paid as well and in many cases
better than workers engaged in similar capacities
elsewhere in Shanghai.

劳工（4）

关于罢工者声称被解雇的三名员工薛阿宝（Sih Ah-pao）、戴仁根（Tai Jen-keng）和印炳荣（Ying Ping-yoong）受到公司不公对待一事，据悉，负责的中国官员认为这些被解雇的工人不值得同情。

至于工人抱怨管理层无情裁员一事，需指出的是，当上海电力公司（S.M.E.D.）移交给该公司管理时，某些扩建工程正在进行中。随着这些工程逐渐完工，受雇从事此项工作的人员便不再需要。

经调查，罢工者关于发电厂低级员工薪资微薄的指控被证明是夸大其词，因为这些工人的薪资至少不低于，且在许多情况下高于上海其他地方从事类似工作的工人。

October 12, 1933.
Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

With reference to the "go-slow" strike
of the 1,500 workers of the old and the new plants of
the Shanghai Power Company, about 150 staff members
of various departments joined the movement on October 9
and one hundred more on October 11. It is learned
that only 200 Chinese staff members, and the three
shifts of workers, the wire-cutting workers and the
foreign staff members, totalling about 650 persons,
are remaining at work as usual.
About 200 strikers attended a meeting held
at 8 a.m. yesterday in the premises of the Youths
Propaganda Group Society, Small West Gate, Nantao, by
the "Shanghai Power Company Staff Members & Workers
Mutual Society".
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That a "Staff Members 'Go-slow' Strike Committee"
of 9 persons be formed.
2. That a propaganda section, a maintenance
section and a picketing section be organised.
3. That those Chinese staff members who have not
yet left their duties be notified by the General Labour
Union to join the movement.
4. That discipline in the movement be maintained.
5. That a letter addressed to the workers be
issued.
6. That the Company be requested to submit to the
demands being drawn up.
The Society has submitted the following
demands to the Shanghai Power Company:-
1. That regardless of the reason for an employee's
discharge, a superannuation of 5% of the total wages
received during the period of his employment be paid
(those employees who are convicted of crimes by the
Court are precluded from sharing these benefits); that
any employee who is discharged without cause be given
a retiring gratuity equivalent to 3 months' pay.
2. That the Rules governing the dismissal of
employees be formally promulgated (they are to be
approved by the control organs.)
3. That an annual bonus equivalent to one month's
pay be paid to any employee who has completed one
year's service with the Company.
4. That an employee be granted a two-week
leave every year.
5. That an increase of wages and class promotions
be granted according to the measures of the Shanghai
Municipal Council.

劳工。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

关于上海电力公司新旧两厂1,500名工人的“怠工”罢工，据悉各部门约有150名职员于10月9日加入运动，另有100人于10月11日加入。据了解，只有约200名中国职员、三班倒工人、剪线工以及外籍职员，共计约650人，仍照常工作。
约200名罢工者参加了由“上海电力公司职员与工人互助社”于昨日上午8时在南市小西门青年宣讲团社址举行的会议。
会议通过以下决议：
1. 成立一个由9人组成的“职员怠工罢工委员会”。
2. 组织宣传部、维持部和纠察部。
3. 由总工会通知尚未离职的中国职员加入运动。
4. 维持运动中的纪律。
5. 发布一封致工人的信函。
6. 要求公司接受正在拟定的各项诉求。
该社团已向上海电力公司提交以下诉求：
1. 无论雇员被解雇的原因如何，均应支付其受雇期间所得工资总额5%的退休金（经法院定罪的员工不得享受此福利）；任何无故被解雇的员工应获得相当于3个月工资的遣散费。
2. 正式颁布管理员工解雇的规则（须经监管机构批准）。
3. 向在公司服务满一年的任何员工支付相当于一个月工资的年终奖金。
4. 每年给予员工两周假期。
5. 按照上海公共租界工部局的措施增加工资和提升职级。

Union in directing the movement and that the Executive

functioning for the time being. He further declared

clerks and other office staff of the Head Office of the
Company, while Kao Yeu-ming (高友明) would look after

The meeting place was covered with posters bearing
inscriptions, such as :

"Expel the running dogs !"

"Down with the trouble makers !"

"Brain workers and manual workers should unite !"

"Sacrifice is the mother of success !"

There were about sixty members of the Office staff
present at the meeting.

The General Labour Union and local Kuomintang whisks

of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.

C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5310
Date 11 / 10 / 33

APPENDIX

An appeal to local various circles by the Shanghai
Municipality General Labour Union in connection with
the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company

D5310 Since the taking over of the Electricity Department
from the S.M.C. the Shanghai Power Company, an American
concern, taking advantage of the monopoly it enjoys, has
violated the agreement under which the Company was formed,
and has ignored its obligations to the public by increasing
the cost of electricity and dismissing some 400 workers of
long service. Regulations governing service which were
originally introduced by the S.M.C. to encourage the workers
and the terms of the agreement governing the change in
control of the department were ignored by the management.
The benefits to which industry entitles the workers have
almost disappeared. At the beginning the workers tolerated
these grievances but later felt obliged to make representations
to the management. As the workers' silence and representation
were not sufficient to convince the management, negotiations
were started, and Chinese members of the S.M.C. were approached
to assist. The negotiations ended in failure and the delegates
nominated by the workers were dismissed. The assistance of
representatives of the Kuomintang and Governing Authorities,
namely Messrs. Tai You Hing and Chu Ching Tao (□ □ □) as well
as Mr. Jones, Secretary of the S.M.C. were enlisted, but their
efforts failed to yield results. As other means failed, the
workers declared a "Tai-kung" strike. This strike did not
affect the supply of electricity to the public. The manage-
ment paid no heed to the movement, apart from adopting more
drastic measures. The measures included the shutting of the
station gates and refusal to admit the workers to the premises.
Taking advantage of the workers' concern for the welfare of
the public, the management brought about the declaration of
the present strike. The management seems to pay no heed to
the fact that unreasonable acts will enrage the community.
This Union is seriously concerned about the public welfare and
has been doing its best to advise and direct the workers
to further this aim. However, sooner or later, the Union
will lose its prestige. As soon as prestige is lost, it
is feared that the public will suffer inconvenience, and the
responsibility for this lies with the Company. This Union
realizes the oppression on the part of the management and
the consequent discontent of the workers and believes that
their action will bring about a change. As the result will concern
the public, the Union is purposely setting forth the facts
surrounding the labour trouble and hopes that the consumers
will make use of the right to supervise the public utility
enterprises and enforce justice by making the selfish and
obstinate management wake up and settle the dispute immediately.
If this is done the enterprise can be operated on a sound and
sane basis.

附录

上海市总工会就上海电力公司劳资纠纷向本地各界发出的呼吁书

D5310 自电气处从工部局移交以来，美商上海电力公司利用其享有的垄断地位，违反了公司成立时的协议，并通过提高电价和解雇约400名长期服务的工人，无视其对公众的义务。管理层无视了最初由工部局为鼓励工人而制定的服务规章，以及关于部门控制权变更的协议条款。工业赋予工人的福利几乎消失殆尽。起初，工人们容忍了这些不满，但后来觉得有必要向管理层提出交涉。由于工人的沉默和交涉不足以使管理层信服，遂开始谈判，并寻求工部局华董协助。谈判以失败告终，工人提名的代表被解雇。工会又求助于国民党及政府当局的代表，即戴玉兴先生和朱庆涛先生（□ □ □），以及工部局秘书琼斯先生，但他们的努力未能取得成果。由于其他手段均告失败，工人宣布举行“怠工”罢工。此次罢工并未影响对公众的电力供应。管理层除了采取更严厉的措施外，对该运动置之不理。这些措施包括关闭电站大门，拒绝工人进入厂区。管理层利用工人对公众福利的关切，导致了当前罢工的爆发。管理层似乎无视这样一个事实：不合理的行径会激怒社会大众。本工会严重关切公众福利，并一直尽力建议和指导工人以实现这一目标。然而，迟早本工会将失去威信。一旦威信丧失，恐怕公众将遭受不便，而对此负有责任的是公司。本工会认识到管理层的压迫以及由此引起的工人不满，并相信他们的行动将带来改变。由于结果将关乎公众，本工会特意陈述劳资纠纷周围的事实，希望消费者利用监督公用事业企业的权利，伸张正义，促使自私且顽固的管理层醒悟并立即解决争端。若能做到这一点，该企业便能在健全和理性的基础上运营。

page_data.en:
Appendix (2)

(1) Evidence of Unreasonable Management.
From the time the S.I.E.D. was established until it was handed over to the Shanghai Power Company a period of twenty years elapsed. These years, with the exception of a period following the "May 30 Tragedy", passed without incident. The Shanghai Power Company took control of the enterprise four years ago, and since then more than ten labour disputes have occurred. Though these disputes were not so serious as the present one, all of them were settled through the assistance of the Union. The present strike is also caused through the fault of the management. Had the management reasonably settled the dispute when mediation was being conducted by Yuan Li-tung (袁履登) and Singloh Hsu (徐新六), Chinese members of the S.I.C. and Wong Shiao-lan (王曉籟), Chairman of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, the present grave situation would not have arisen. The management, not only refused to negotiate with the labour representatives or listen to the mediation of the Chinese notables, but it dismissed the labour representatives. This is how the present impasse was brought about. It should be remembered that there was little change among the workers when the S.I.C. was controlling the electricity plant. To-day, the period of peace is past, and everything goes wrong, showing clearly that the management is to blame.

(2) Disregard of employees service conditions and rights.
During the control of the electricity supply by the S.I.C. every worker who completed twenty years service was entitled to receive a gratuity equal to 5% of his wages. This is a modern means of encouraging workers to peacefully and conscientiously perform their duties, by which the S.I.C. gained good results without trouble during their twenty years of management. After the enterprise had been transferred to the present Company labour disputes instantly broke out owing largely to the dismissal of workers for trivial causes. The Company imposes unreasonable conditions upon its employees, and acts as if they could be justified. The question of the issue of the 5% gratuity is the cause of all the trouble. The General Labour Union admits that the revised regulations governing the issue of the gratuity made by the Company are better than old ones. On the other hand, the Company is dismissing employees who, in the majority, have served for more than ten years. These workers were refused their shares of the gratuity on certain charges intentionally made by the Company. It is beyond doubt that the Company discharges old hands and refuses to pay their gratuities, and replaces them by new men at cheaper wages. High wages and gratuities are the rights of workers; it is unjust to deprive them of their rights. During May, 1932, some 128 workers were discharged and the Company employed new hands in their place, a fact beyond refutation. The Union does not oppose proper measures adopted by any company to reduce expenses owing to trade depression, but the consumption of electricity increases day by day, and the Company's income increases in proportion. The Company moreover has increased its charges. It is evident that the circumstances of the Company do not justify the reduction of the staff. On the contrary, the Company should provide better conditions for its employees. For instance, the foreign employees are permitted to have annual short leave ranging from two weeks to a month in addition to long leave. The Chinese workers do not participate in these advantages. Furthermore, the foreign staff are entitled to study free of charge. The Company places in the bank the equivalent of 10% of their monthly wages and gives them a high rate of interest.
page_data.zh:
附录 (2)

(1) 管理层不合理的证据。
从上海工部局电气处成立到移交给上海电力公司，历时二十年。这期间，除“五卅惨案”后的一段时间外，均平安无事。上海电力公司于四年前接管该企业，此后发生了十多次劳资纠纷。虽然这些纠纷不如本次严重，但都是通过工会的协助得以解决的。本次罢工也是由管理层的过错造成的。如果管理层在工部局华董袁履登和徐新六，以及上海总商会主席王晓籁进行调解时合理解决纠纷，就不会出现目前的严峻局面。管理层不仅拒绝与劳工代表谈判或听取中国名流的调解，还解雇了劳工代表。这就是造成目前僵局的原因。应当记住，在工部局控制电厂期间，工人队伍几乎没有变动。如今，和平时期已过，事事出错，清楚地表明管理层应受指责。

(2) 无视雇员的服务条件和权利。
在工部局控制电力供应期间，每位服务满二十年的工人有权获得相当于其工资5%的酬金。这是一种鼓励工人和平、认真履行职责的现代手段，工部局在二十年的管理中借此取得了良好的成效，未生波折。在企业移交给现公司后，劳资纠纷立即爆发，这在很大程度上是由于因琐事解雇工人所致。公司强加给雇员不合理的条件，并表现得好像这些条件是正当的。发放5%酬金的问题是所有麻烦的根源。总工会承认，公司修订后的酬金发放规章优于旧规章。另一方面，公司正在解雇多数服务超过十年的员工。公司以故意捏造的罪名拒绝向这些工人发放其应得的酬金份额。毫无疑问，公司解雇老员工并拒绝支付其酬金，转而以较低的工资雇佣新人。高工资和酬金是工人的权利；剥夺他们的权利是不公正的。1932年5月，约128名工人被解雇，公司雇佣新人顶替，这是无可辩驳的事实。工会并不反对任何公司为应对贸易萧条而采取的适当减支措施，但电力消耗日益增加，公司的收入也成比例增加。此外，公司还提高了收费标准。显然，公司的情况并不证明裁减人员是合理的。相反，公司应为其雇员提供更好的条件。例如，外籍雇员除长假外，还享有为期两周至一个月的年度短假。中国工人无法享受这些优待。此外，外籍职员有权免费进修。公司将相当于他们月薪10%的金额存入银行，并给予高利率。

page_data.en:
Appendix (3)

while the Chinese are only granted a gratuity of 5%. Take
another instance, the total monthly wage bill for the foreign
staff numbering about 200, exclusive of the Manager, is
$150,000.00 or $200,000.00 as compared with $90,000.00 for
2,500 Chinese employees. The Chinese staff is already
badly off and now the Company is trying to deprive them of
the little that is left. From all points of view, this action
on the part of the Company is unjustifiable.
The aforementioned facts prove that the Company dismissed
old and experienced workers and employed in their place cheaper
new hands, with a view to increasing profits. As a consequence,
the service rendered by the Company to the consumers of
electricity becomes inferior, and the interests of the community
are affected. Fearing that undesirable incidents may occur in
consequence of the stubborn refusal of the Company to accede
to the reasonable and righteous demands of the workers, the Union
is doing everything it can to persuade part of the workers to
refrain from striking in order that the consumers may be supplied
with electricity regularly, and is advising the workers to revise
their demands making the settlement of the dispute an easier
matter. The demands are as follows :-
1. That workers who have been working with the Company more than
a year be given a retiring gratuity equivalent to three months'
wages in addition to a superannuation fund of 5% of their
wages on leaving the Company, while those who left through
dismissal be cut off with the superannuation fund only.
(workers who are dismissed for committing a crime and have
been sentenced by court for their unlawful actions are not
entitled to the privileges mentioned in this demand).
2. That the public be appraised of all dismissals in the future.
3. That the Company pay the workers who have over one year's
service an annual bonus of one month's wages at the end of
each year.
4. That of the 400 workers who have been dismissed, the four
men including Nyi Wen-fu (倪文甫) and the three men
including Tai Jen-Heng (戴仁恒), be reinstated.
5. That wages for the period of "Tai-kung" strike be issued
to all workers.
According to this Union, the foregoing conditions are
quite reasonable and should not present any difficulties to the
Management,. Further, if Messrs Yuan, Hsu and Wong, and
representatives of Party and Political Authorities as well as
Mr. Jones, Secretary of the S.M.C. consider amendment of the
demands necessary, the order will be gladly carried out. This
Union is also ready to consider any views or suggestions which
may be put forwarded by local public bodies in connection with
the present movement and the foregoing demands. In short, this
Union, in order to maintain the public interest and preserve
peace and good order of the Community, is doing its best to
dissuade the workers from resorting to any measures which may
cause inconvenience to the public.

(Signed & Chopped) The Shanghai General Labour
Union.
October 8, 22nd year.
page_data.zh:
附录 (3)

而华人雇员仅获发5%的酬金。再举一例，外籍职员（不包括经理）约200人，每月工资总额约为150,000.00美元或200,000.00美元，相比之下，2,500名华人员工的工资总额仅为90,000.00美元。华人员工本已生活困窘，如今公司却试图剥夺他们所剩无几的微薄利益。从各方面来看，公司的这一行为都是毫无道理的。

上述事实证明，公司为增加利润，解雇了年老且经验丰富的工人，并以薪资较低的新手取而代之。结果是，公司向电力消费者提供的服务变得低劣，社区利益受到影响。工会担心，由于公司顽固拒绝接受工人合理且正当的要求，可能会引发不良事件，因此正竭尽全力劝说部分工人避免罢工，以确保向消费者正常供电，并建议工人修改其要求，使纠纷更易于解决。具体要求如下：

1. 凡在公司工作一年以上的工人，离职时除获得相当于三个月工资的退职酬金外，还应获得相当于其工资5%的养老金；而被解雇者则仅发给养老金。（因犯罪并被法院判决违法行动的工人，无权享受本条所述之特权）。
2. 今后所有解雇情况应向公众公布。
3. 公司应在每年年底向服务满一年的工人发放相当于一个月工资的年终奖金。
4. 在被解雇的400名工人中，恢复包括倪文甫在内的四人以及包括戴仁恒在内的三人的职务。
5. 向所有工人发放“怠工”罢工期间的工资。

据本工会称，上述条件相当合理，管理层不应感到有任何困难。此外，如果袁先生、徐先生和王先生，以及党和政治当局的代表，以及工部局秘书琼斯先生认为有必要修改这些要求，我们将乐意执行。本工会也愿意考虑地方公共团体就当前运动及上述要求提出的任何意见或建议。总之，本工会为维护公共利益及保持社区的和平与良好秩序，正尽力劝阻工人采取任何可能给公众带来不便的措施。

（签名并盖章）上海总工会。
二十二年十月八日。

October 10, 1933.    Morning Translation

LABOUR

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

In support of the "go-slow" strike declared
by the entire body of workers at the new and old plants
of the Shanghai Power Company, the Staff Employees Mutual
Benefit Club of the Company issued circular notices for
their members to join the strike from yesterday.
Enquiries made by a reporter of the Dah Kung
News Agency yesterday morning disclosed that the staff
employees at the Head Office of the Company on Nanking
Road were working as usual, while those at the new plant,
and the old plant had joined the strike.
A responsible officer of the Mutual Benefit
Club told the reporter that the non-uniformity in the
movements of the staff employees yesterday morning was
due to the fact that a number of notices were not received
by the staff on account of changes in addresses; however
the entire body of staff employees has decided to protest
against the improper attitude of the Company towards
Chinese employees. The Directing Committee of the
Club will hold a meeting to discuss ways and means to
unify the movements and may, if necessary, declare a
strike.

At 9 p.m. yesterday a bomb was hurled into
the home of Sz Chiu Yoong (史久雍), an employee of the
Shanghai Power Company, at No.33 Tung Yoh Dong Ka(東育堂街),
Nantao. Fortunately the bomb did not explode and was
later removed by officers of the Second Division of the
Public Safety Bureau.

1933年10月10日。 上午译件

劳工

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

为支持上海电力公司新老厂房全体工人宣布的“怠工”罢工，该公司职员互助会向其成员发出通告，号召他们从昨天起参加罢工。
大公通讯社记者昨晨查询得知，该公司南京路总办事处的职员照常工作，而新厂和老厂的职员已加入罢工。
互助会的一位负责人告诉记者，昨晨职员行动不统一是因为部分职员因地址变更未收到通知；然而，全体职员已决定抗议公司对华人员工的不当态度。互助会指导委员会将召开会议讨论统一行动的方法，如有必要，可能宣布罢工。

昨晚9时，一枚炸弹被扔进上海电力公司员工史久雍位于南市东育堂街33号的家中。幸而炸弹未爆炸，后由公安局第二分局警官移除。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5310
October 10.
Date 10/10/33

Labour

Shanghai Power Company - Situation

D. 5210

The situation at Riverside Power Station remains
unchanged this morning, October 10, the number of men
on strike being about 1,496.

Observation made in front of the Riverside Power
Station at about 6.30 a.m. October 10 shows that most
of the "shift" workers who were due to go off at that
time, took away their personal belongings. A Chinese
of the labouring type was overheard telling these workers
that it would be in order for them to work to-day,
October 10, in view of efforts which were being made by
a certain important Government official to bring the
strike to an end by mediation.

It is reported that the General Labour Union has
advised the workers to resume under the following
conditions :-

1. That employees who leave the Company after one year's
service be paid a gratuity equivalent to 3 months' wages.

2. That the five percent retiring gratuity be paid to all
workers when they leave the Company's employ.

3. That written regulations be posted in the various
workshops so that the workers may know the conditions
under which they are employed.

D. 5210

今晨（10月10日）江边发电站的局势未变，罢工人数约为1,496人。

10月10日上午6时30分左右在江边发电站前进行的观察显示，大多数原定此时下班的“轮班”工人带走了个人物品。有人听到一名劳工模样的华人告诉这些工人，鉴于某位重要政府官员正努力通过调解结束罢工，他们在今天（10月10日）上班是合适的。

据报道，总工会已建议工人在以下条件下复工：

1. 在公司服务一年后离职的员工，应支付相当于3个月工资的酬金。

2. 所有工人离职时应支付百分之五的退职酬金。

3. 在各车间张贴书面规章，以便工人了解其受雇条件。

4. 恢复6月份被解雇的四人和9月份被辞退的三人的职务。

10月9日下午5时至6时40分之间，上海电力公司文书职员在公司南京路总办事处举行会议，讨论一份流传的指示他们宣布“怠工”罢工的通告。该通告谎称由小东门康家弄职员联益社发出。会议决定调查通告来源，并于10月11日（星期三）晚上8时再次召开会议，以决定采取何种行动（如果有）。

According to Fang Chien (方謙), a committee member

据联益会委员方谦称，华人文职人员不愿与商人和劳工结盟，但可能最终为了自身利益而自行宣布“怠工”罢工。另据悉，由于包括1933年5月被辞退的两人在内的多名职员被解雇，职员中存在不满情绪。

Afternoon Translation
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. R. REGISTRY. No. D 5310 Date 9 / 10 / 33）

L.CUR.

China Times published the following comment on Oct. 8:

BEWARE OF TRAITORS.

In July this year, the Shanghai Power Company dismissed a certain foreman and the dismissal caused a "go-slow" strike of workers who resumed work immediately on the advice of Mr. Heald, Assistant Secretary-General of the Company. But at that time, the hands submitted two demands:- (1) that in the case of a worker who resigns on his own accord or is dismissed by the management, a pension of 5% of the total wages received during the period of his employment be refunded; (2) that the compensation for workers who are injured while on duty, or in the case of death from injuries, the compensation paid to relatives be increased from $200 to $2,000.

Several attempts at negotiation were instituted but without result. Four more workers were later dismissed by the Company and the feeling against the unfair attitude of the management increased. It was not long before Mr. Yuan Lee-tung, Chinese member of the Shanghai Municipal Council, submitted proposals, but owing to the wide difference of opinion between the management and the labourers, not only were his proposals refused, but the situation became more acute.

Recently, the Company dismissed three more workers and a second "go-slow" strike began on the morning of September 29. The majority of workers at both the new and the old plants joined the movement and the situation is now serious.

The power Company is one of the largest enterprises in Shanghai and the public depends upon its efficient operation. In the event of the "go-slow" strike affecting the workers of the distribution departments of the Company, Shanghai would become a city without light. Therefore, the local Tangpu and other political organs are paying great attention to the matter, but any attempt at mediation is frustrated by the obstinate attitude adopted by both the management and the employees.

Frankly speaking, it seems that the management should bear in mind the hardships encountered in the lives of the labourers, and should endeavour to accept the demands of the employees, whilst the labourers should also remember that the work in which they are engaged is essential to the prosperity of the community. They should also remember that destructive agents are at work, hiding under the cloak of labour, whose sole object is to foment trouble and cripple industry and by so doing acquire wealth and power for themselves, while both employers and employees suffer irreparable injuries, and the prosperity of the community is affected.

Beware of these traitors lest they turn the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company to their own profit.

L.CUR.

《时报》于10月8日发表如下评论：

警惕奸徒。

今年七月，上海电力公司解雇了一名领班，此举导致工人举行“怠工”罢工，后在公司副秘书赫尔德（Heald）先生的劝告下立即复工。但当时，工人们提出了两项要求：（1）凡自动辞职或被管理层解雇的工人，应退还其受雇期间所得工资总额的5%作为养老金；（2）增加对工伤工人的赔偿，或在因伤致死的情况下，支付给家属的赔偿金从200美元增至2,000美元。

双方进行了数次谈判，但均无结果。随后公司又解雇了四名工人，人们对管理层不公态度的不满情绪日益加剧。不久，上海市参事会华籍参事袁履登（Yuan Lee-tung）先生提出建议，但由于管理层与劳工之间意见分歧巨大，不仅其建议被拒绝，局势反而更加严峻。

近期，公司又解雇了三名工人，第二次“怠工”罢工于9月29日上午开始。新老两厂的大多数工人加入了这一运动，目前局势严重。

电力公司是上海最大的企业之一，公众依赖其高效运作。如果“怠工”罢工影响到公司的配电部门工人，上海将成为一座没有光明的城市。因此，当地党部及其他政治机关对此事高度关注，但由于资方和雇员双方态度顽固，任何调解尝试均告失败。

坦率地说，管理层似乎应铭记劳工生活中的艰辛，并努力接受雇员的要求；而劳工也应记住，他们从事的工作对社区的繁荣至关重要。他们还应记住，破坏分子正披着劳工的外衣暗中活动，其唯一目的是煽动骚乱、摧残工业，从而为自己谋取财富和权力，致使雇主和雇员双方遭受不可弥补的伤害，并影响社区的繁荣。

警惕这些奸徒，以免他们利用上海电力公司的劳资纠纷牟取私利。

October 9, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

China Times and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

In connection with the "go-slow" strike
of 2,000 workers in the old and the new plants of
the Shanghai Power Company, about 400 members of the
staff will join the movement from this morning.
The "4th District Waterworks & Electricity
Trade Workers Union" and the "Shanghai Power Company
Employees & Workers Mutual Benefit Society" have
issued a joint manifesto to support the labour
situation.

Meeting of the General Labour Union.

The General Labour Union gave an enter-
tainment yesterday evening to about 60 leaders of
various public bodies, including Wong Shao-lai, of
the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce, Ling Kong-
han of the Bankers Association, Dao Loh-ging of the
Chinese Ratepayers Association, Chang Ts-lie of the
Nanking Road Street Union, Loh Pah-hoong of the Nantao
Tramway Company, Liu Hoong-sung, an industrial magnate,
Jong Tien-pang and Wu Han-ts of the newspaper circles,
etc. Chu Hsueh-vai who presided, reported that at
the beginning of the trouble, local Tangpu and other
political organs and Mr. Jones, Secretary of the
Shanghai Municipal Council, had attempted to mediate;
but without result, owing to the firm attitude adopted
by the Company. Since the taking over of the premises
by the Shanghai Power Company, about 400 hands have
been dismissed. It is recalled that the power Company
when controlled by the S.M.C. seldom dismissed its
employees, but general dismissals for trivial offences
are now the order of the day. Recently, the dismissal
of three hands without sufficient cause, incited the
other employees to strike. Owing to the obstinate
attitude of the management, the strike has reached its
present magnitude. The workers are willing to make
concessions in order to prevent the trouble from
increasing, and causing serious inconvenience to the
public. The leaders are expected to submit proposals
which will be accepted by the General Labour Union
and will be the means of ending the dispute at an early
date.

Ling Kong-han of the Bankers Association
in submitting his views about the present labour
dispute stated that the public must first ascertain the
"sincerity" of the management in conducting negotiations.
If the management is at fault, Chinese directors and
shareholders should withdraw their interests from the
Shanghai Power Company in order to safeguard the rights
of Chinese labourers.

《时报》及本地其他报纸：

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

关于上海电力公司新老两厂2,000名工人的“怠工”罢工，约400名职员将从今天上午起加入该运动。
“第四区水电业工会”和“上海电力公司员役互助社”已发表联合宣言，支持此次劳工行动。

总工会会议。

总工会昨晚宴请了约60位各公共团体领袖，包括上海总商会的黄绍莱（Wong Shao-lai）、银行公会的凌孔汉（Ling Kong-han）、华人纳税人的陶洛京（Dao Loh-ging）、南京路街联会的张慈烈（Chang Ts-lie）、南市电车公司的罗伯洪（Loh Pah-hoong）、实业巨子刘鸿生（Liu Hoong-sung）、报界的钟天放（Jong Tien-pang）和吴汉茨（Wu Han-ts）等。主席朱学范（Chu Hsueh-vai）报告称，在纠纷初期，当地党部及其他政治机关以及工部局秘书琼斯（Jones）先生曾试图调解；但因公司态度强硬，未获结果。自上海电力公司接管以来，已有约400名工人被解雇。回想工部局控制电力公司时期，很少解雇员工，但现在因轻微过失而普遍解雇员工已成常态。最近，无故解雇三名工人，激怒了其他雇员导致罢工。由于管理层态度顽固，罢工规模已达目前程度。工人们愿意做出让步，以防止事态扩大并给公众带来严重不便。预计领袖们将提出各项建议，这些建议将被总工会接受，并成为早日结束争端的手段。

银行公会的凌孔汉（Ling Kong-han）在就当前劳资纠纷发表意见时表示，公众必须首先查明管理层在进行谈判时的“诚意”。如果管理层有过错，中国董事和股东应从上海电力公司撤出利益，以保障中国劳工的权利。

LABOUR.

（批：D. 5210
(Caulkin)）

A long report on the labour trouble in
the Shanghai Power Company has been issued by the
General Labour Union.
The workers have submitted the following
demands:-
1. That any employee having completed one year's
service upon being discharged by the Company should
be given a retiring gratuity equivalent to 3 months'
pay and 5% of his total wages (all benefits to be
forfeited if the employee is convicted of a crime by
the Court).
2. That the Rules governing the dismissal of
Chinese employees be clearly stated.
3. That a yearly bonus equivalent to one month's
pay be granted at every year-end to those employees
having one year's service with the Company.
4. That with regard to the 400 hands who were
dismissed without cause or discharged by the Company,
seven be reinstated.
5. That wages for the period of the "go-slow"
strike be paid.
According to the representatives of this
Union, the above demands are reasonable. With a view
to respecting the rights of the public, this Union
requires only a legal settlement of the dispute and will
endeavour to persuade the employees not to take the
law into their own hands.
