Labour (6)

boatmen replied that they would agree to do so if
means for their sustenance were provided from a strike
fund.

Seven committee members of the General Labour
Union held a meeting in their office, 117 Foh Yeu Road,
City, between 2.30 and 4 p.m. October 7, when Chu Hsueh
Van (朱学范 ) presided. The following resolutions
were discussed and passed :-

1. That local labour unions be notified to give
financial assistance to workers of the Shanghai
Power Company who are on strike.

2. That a sum of $50.00 be drawn out of the Union
treasury and be donated to the Strike Committee
of the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers'
Union (formed by Shanghai Power Company workers),
and that the Postal Workers' Union, 230 Range Road,
the 1st District Water and Electricity Workers' Union,
Bantao, 4th District Cigarette Workers' Union, 8 San
Loh Li, Baikal Road, Uniform Tailors' Union, Chapei,
and the 10th District Cotton Spinning Workers' Union,
Jessfield Village, be requested to each contribute a
sum of $50.00 to the Strike Committee in question at
once.

3. That a manifesto be issued informing the public
of the details of Shanghai Power Company's oppression
of its workers.

4. That representatives of people in various walks of
life in Shanghai be entertained in the Dah Si Yang
Restaurant, 323 Foochow Road, at 1 p.m. October 8
with a view to informing the public of the
circumstances surrounding the strike and soliciting
the assistance of the local community.

5. That the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers'
Union be asked to send representatives to the above
mentioned meeting to make a report on the strike.

（批：D 5310 / Caulkin）
page_data.zh:
10月9日，3点。

劳工 (6)

拖船工人回答说，如果从罢工基金中提供生活费用，他们同意支持。

10月7日下午2时30分至4时，总工会七名委员在市中心福州路117号的办公室举行会议，由朱学范（Chu Hsueh Van）主持。讨论并通过了以下决议：

1. 通知各地方工会向上海电力公司罢工工人提供经济援助。

2. 从工会金库中提取50.00美元，捐赠给第四区水电业工会（由上海电力公司工人组成）的罢工委员会，并要求位于兰路230号的邮务工会、半淞园（Bantao，原文如此，应为南市相关区域）第一区水电业工会、贝加尔路（Baikal Road，音译）三乐里8号的第四区卷烟业工会、闸北制服裁缝工会、以及极司菲尔村（Jessfield Village）第十区棉纺业工会，立即各向该罢工委员会捐款50.00美元。

3. 发表宣言，向公众通报上海电力公司压迫工人的详情。

4. 于10月8日下午1时在福州路323号的大西洋餐厅（Dah Si Yang Restaurant，音译）宴请上海各界代表，旨在向公众通报罢工情况并争取当地社区的支持。

5. 请第四区水电业工会派代表参加上述会议，汇报罢工情况。

（批：D 5310 / Caulkin）

page_data.en:
October 9, 3.

Labour (7)

At 3 p.m. October 7, four workers including Nyi
en-fu (倪文富) and Pao Tuh-foh (包德福) called on the
committee members of the General Labour Union, 117 Foh
Yeu Road, City, when a conference was held. It was
decided that a letter be addressed to the Shanghai Power
Company Staff Employees' (Office Clerks) Lien Yih Society,
Kong Ka Loong, Small East Gate, asking it to express an
opinion on the present strike and to give assistance to
the strikers.

Two members of the Strike Committee of the 4th District
Electricity Workers' Union visited on the afternoon of
October 7, Wu Ch'u Bei (吴礼培), Chief of the Staff Employees
of the Company, at No.4 Yun Ching Li, Fu Ming Road, Nantao,
and requested him and his men to render the strikers
assistance and adopt the same movement. Mr. Wu informed
them that he would solicit views from all the staff members
in connection with their request, whereupon they departed.

On October 7, the 2nd District Water & Electricity
Workers' Union (French Concession) sent a letter to the
th District Water & Electricity Workers' Union. The
despatch urged that the struggle be continued to the bitter
end and added that the Union (2nd District) is willing
to do everything possible to make the movement a success.
page_data.zh:
10月9日，3。

劳工（7）

10月7日下午3时，倪文富（Nyi en-fu）和包德福（Pao Tuh-foh）等四名工人前往位于城内福州路117号的总工会，拜访正在开会的工会委员。会议决定致函位于小东门孔家弄的上海电力公司职员（办事员）联益社，请其就当前罢工发表意见，并向罢工者提供援助。

10月7日下午，第四区水电工会罢工委员会的两名成员前往南市富民路云庆里4号，拜访该公司职员主任吴礼培（Wu Ch'u Bei），请求他及其手下人员援助罢工者并采取同样的行动。吴先生告知他们，他将就他们的请求征求全体职员的意见，随后他们离去。

10月7日，第二区水电工会（法租界）致函第三区水电工会。该函敦促将斗争进行到底，并补充说第二区工会愿意尽一切可能使此次运动取得成功。

page_data.en:
October 9, 3.

Labour (8)

Copies of a notice entitled "News" dated October 7,
1933, were issued by the 4th District Water & Electricity
Workers' Union on October 7. It reads substantially
as follows:-

"The Strike Committee has devised measures to cope
"with the present situation which are to be kept secret.
"Full information will be issued within the next few days,
"when the measure decided upon will be put into effect.
" All labour friends are urged to wait patiently.
"Myi Wen-fu and others were dismissed sometime ago by the
"management without reason. In consequence of the
"giving
"wholehearted support that the Union is giving to the
"movement, the management declared that the trouble had
"resulted from agitation by unemployed workers. It hoped
"to deceive the public by these statements. According to
"Labour Union Law of the Central (Government), fellow
"workers, although unemployed, remain members of the Union
"until they take up other employment. In view of
"the negotiation over their dismissal by the management
being still in progress, they cannot be regarded as
"unemployed. Consequently as they have not yet lost
"their standing as members and they are of course
"eligible to lead the workers. It is hoped that
"workers will not be misled by the Company."
page_data.zh:
10月9日，3。

劳工（8）

1933年10月7日，第四区水电工会发行了题为《消息》的通告副本，日期为1933年10月7日。其主要内容如下：-

“罢工委员会已制定应对当前局势的措施，这些措施将保密。
“未来几天内将发布完整信息，届时既定的措施将付诸实施。
“呼吁所有劳工朋友耐心等待。
“倪文富（Myi Wen-fu）等人此前被管理层无故解雇。鉴于
“工会全心全意支持此次运动，管理层宣称此次纠纷
“是由失业工人煽动所致。它希望
“通过这些声明来欺骗公众。根据中央（政府）的
“《工会法》，工友们即使失业，在找到其他工作之前
“仍然是工会会员。鉴于
“关于他们被管理层解雇的谈判仍在进行中，他们不能被视为
“失业。因此，既然他们尚未失去
“会员资格，他们当然有资格领导工人。希望
“工人们不要被公司误导。”

page_data.en:
October 9, 3.

Labour (9)

Copies of two leaflets purporting to emanate from
the Chinese Territorial Protection League bearing on the
strike of the Shanghai Power Company were found in the
vicinity of Pingliang Road Market on the early morning of
October 8. The following is a summarized translation of
these handbills :-

1. This leaflet is dated October 5, 1933, and sets forth
the following demands :-

a) That a gratuity equal to 5% of the wages of a worker
from the date of joining the service to the day of
leaving, be paid to a worker irrespective of whether
he is dismissed or resigns.

b) That dismissal of workers be opposed and that those
who have been dismissed be reinstated forthwith.

c) That opposition be raised to the White Russians
working in the Power Stations.

d) That the workers be paid for the period of the
strike.

The literature advocates the following means to gain
victory in the labour struggle :

a) That the workers in the generating departments and
on the "three-shift" of the Riverside and Fearon
Road Stations be advised to go on strike.

b) That a general meeting of strikers be convened and
a strike committee be formed.

c) That armed picketing groups be organized to drive
White Russians out of the Stations.

d) That the electricity supply be stopped in order to
obtain victory in the strike.
page_data.zh:
10月9日，3。

劳工（9）

10月8日凌晨，在平凉路市场附近发现了两份声称出自中华国土保护会、涉及上海电力公司罢工的传单。以下是这些传单的摘要译文：-

1. 这份传单日期为1933年10月5日，提出了以下要求：-

a) 无论工人是被解雇还是辞职，都应向其支付一笔相当于从入职之日起至离职之日止工资总额5%的酬金。

b) 反对解雇工人，并立即复职已被解雇者。

c) 反对在白俄人在发电厂工作。

d) 向工人支付罢工期间的工资。

该文献主张通过以下手段在劳工斗争中取得胜利：

a) 建议发电部门以及杨树浦路和斐伦路（Fearon Road）电站“三班倒”的工人举行罢工。

b) 召开罢工者大会，成立罢工委员会。

c) 组织武装纠察队，将白俄人赶出电站。

d) 停止电力供应，以取得罢工胜利。

page_data.en:
October 9, 3.

Labour (10)

2. This handbill is entitled "A manifesto to the Power
Company workers on Ways to Gain a victory in the
present strike". It is dated October 4, 1933 and
purports to have been issued by the Eastern District
Branch of the Chinese Territorial Protection League.
It eulogizes the strikers for bravely struggling against
the American Imperialist Capitalist and accelerating the
Anti-Imperialist movement. It casts blame on the S.M.C.,
the local Kuomintang and the Bureau of Social Affairs
on the pretext that they assisted the capitalists
ignored the interests of the labourers, and deceived
the workers by pretending to be anxious to act as
mediators. It explains to the workers that the
American Imperialists are adamant just because they
believe they will be able to maintain the electricity
supply with the aid of "white" Russians. Consequently
the only way in which the stubborn attitude of the
capitalists can be brought to an end is by driving
the White Russians out of the stations, and urging
the Strike Committee to form armed pickets to
undertake this task.
page_data.zh:
10月9日，3。

劳工（10）

2. 这份传单题为《告电力公司工人书：论如何在当前罢工中取得胜利》。日期为1933年10月4日，声称由中华国土保护会东区分会发布。它赞扬罢工者勇敢对抗美帝国主义资本家，并加速了反帝运动。它指责工部局、当地国民党和社会局，借口是他们协助资本家，忽视劳工利益，并假装急于充当调解人来欺骗工人。它向工人解释，美帝国主义者之所以态度强硬，正是因为他们相信能在“白”俄人的帮助下维持电力供应。因此，结束资本家顽固态度的唯一办法是将白俄人赶出电站，并敦促罢工委员会组建武装纠察队来执行这项任务。

page_data.en:
October 9, 3.

Labour (11)

A handbill asking various labour unions in Nantao
for assistance has been issued by the Strike Committee
of the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers' Union
and copies of it have been widely distributed. This
handbill reads :

"The employees of the Shanghai Power Company are
"being oppressed by the Imperialistic capitalists.
"The management is continually dismissing workers. In
"spite of mediation conducted by Yuan Li-tung, Yu Yah-
"ching and Hsu Sing-loh, Chinese members of the S.M.C.
"and Wong Shiao-lai, Chairman of the Chinese Chamber of
"Commerce, the management persists in its stubborn attitude.
"Recently three workers including Tai Jen-eng ( )
"were dismissed on the pretext of laziness without being
"paid the superannuation to which they were entitled
"under the regulations formed when the Company was the
"Electricity Department of the S.M.C. Consequently this
"Union and the employees could endure such conditions
"no longer and declared a "tai-kung" strike to struggle
"against the Imperialistic Capitalists. We expect
"you to show sympathy and render us moral and material
"assistance.
".................... Union.

Strike Committee of the 4th
District Water & Electricity
Workers' Union."
page_data.zh:
10月9日，3。

劳工（11）

第四区水电工会罢工委员会发布了一份请求南市各工会提供援助的传单，并广泛分发。该传单写道：

“上海电力公司的雇员正受到帝国主义资本家的压迫。
“管理层不断解雇工人。尽管有工部局华董袁履登（Yuan Li-tung）、余雅清（Yu Yah-ching）、徐星洛（Hsu Sing-loh）以及上海总商会会长王晓籁（Wong Shiao-lai）进行调解，管理层仍坚持其顽固态度。
“最近，包括戴仁恩（Tai Jen-eng）（原文不清）在内的三名工人以懒惰为借口被解雇，且未支付根据公司作为工部局电气处时期制定的规章他们应得的退休金。因此，本工会和雇员再也无法忍受这种状况，宣布举行‘怠工’罢工，以对抗帝国主义资本家。我们期望
“你们表示同情，并在精神和物质上给予我们援助。
“.................... 工会。

第四区
水电工会
罢工委员会。”

page_data.en:
October 9, 3.

Labour (12)

General Labour Union - efforts to win public sympathy
to strikers of the Shanghai Power Company

At 6.40 p.m. October 8, the General Labour Union
entertained 56 prominent Chinese including Ling Kang-hou
(林康候), Chief Secretary of the Chinese Bankers'
Association, Oo Chi-hao (鄔志豪), representing the
Fenghua Fellow Countrymen's Association, Chang Ts-lien
(張子廉) representing the 1st Special District Citizens'
Federation and Tao Loh-chin (陶樂勤), Chinese Secretary
to the Chinese Ratepayers' Association, to dinner in the
Dah Si Yang restaurant, 323 Foochow Road. Chu Hsueh-
fan (朱學範) representing the General Labour Union, who
presided, stated that, since the Americans became the
owners of the Shanghai Power Company, they have disregarded
the interests of the public by increasing the cost of
electricity and dismissing Chinese employees, of whom
about 400 had already been let out. The regulations
governing terms of service which were originally
introduced by the S.M.C. for benefit of the workers were
abolished. In order to maintain the service for the benefit
of the community, the workers tolerated the oppression
for a time. However, they eventually sent a few delegates
to ask the management to treat them better. The
management met this request by dismissing the employees
by whom it was presented. Consequently the workers of
the Shanghai Power Company declared a "tai-kung" strike
and are now appealing to the public for assistance.
page_data.zh:
10月9日，3。

劳工（12）

总工会——争取公众对上海电力公司罢工者的同情

10月8日下午6时40分，总工会在福州路323号的大西洋餐厅宴请了56位知名华人，其中包括中国银行公会秘书长林康候（Ling Kang-hou）、代表奉化同乡会的邬志豪（Oo Chi-hao）、代表第一特区市民联合会的张子廉（Chang Ts-lien）以及华人纳税会华籍秘书陶乐勤（Tao Loh-chin）。代表总工会主持会议的朱学范（Chu Hsueh-fan）表示，自从美国人成为上海电力公司的所有者以来，他们通过提高电费和解雇中国雇员（其中约400人已被辞退）而无视公众利益。最初由工部局为造福工人而引入的服务条款规章已被废除。为了维持服务于社区的利益，工人们暂时容忍了压迫。然而，他们最终派遣了几名代表要求管理层改善待遇。管理层对此请求的回应是解雇了提出请求的员工。因此，上海电力公司的工人宣布举行“怠工”罢工，目前正在呼吁公众提供援助。

page_data.en:
October 9, 3.

Labour (13)

Subsequently Ling Kang-hou (林康侯) addressed the
attendance stating that owing to political chaos prevailing
in China, the Government of this country had met with
failure in all diplomatic dealings with Foreign Powers.
It was not therefore surprising to learn that the management
of the Shanghai Power Company had adopted an obstinate
attitude towards the Chinese workers and ignored the
efforts at mediation made by the Chinese Authorities.
He urged that further efforts be made to effect a peaceful
settlement and if the Company still refuses to compromise,
all Chinese directors of the Company should resign their
positions and Chinese shareholders should dispose of their
stock at once. Co Chi-hao (郭志豪), the next speaker,
doubted if Chinese directors and shareholders of the
Company would adopt this suggestion. Chang Tsz-lien
(張子廉), made the following proposals :-
1. That all residents be notified to purchase candles and
lamps for use in emergencies.
2. That the old regulations existing when the S.M.C.
owned the S.P.C. governing the treatment of workers
be restored.
3. That all organizations unite together and support the
strike of Shanghai Power Company workers.
Several other speakers gave short addresses in a similar
strain. The function terminated at 8.30 p.m.

During the proceedings, copies of the following
broadsheets were distributed to the attendance :-
page_data.zh:
10月9日，3。

劳工（13）

随后，林康候（Ling Kang-hou）向与会者发表讲话，指出由于中国政局混乱，本国政府在与列强的所有外交交涉中均遭失败。因此，得知上海电力公司管理层对中国工人采取顽固态度并无视中国当局的调解努力，并不令人惊讶。他敦促进一步努力以实现和平解决，如果公司仍拒绝妥协，所有中方董事应辞去职务，中国股东应立即抛售股票。下一位发言者郭志豪（Co Chi-hao）怀疑公司的中方董事和股东是否会采纳这一建议。张子廉（Chang Tsz-lien）提出了以下建议：
1. 通知所有居民购买蜡烛和灯具以备紧急之需。
2. 恢复工部局拥有上海电力公司时期存在的关于工人待遇的旧规章。
3. 所有团体联合起来，支持上海电力公司工人的罢工。
其他几位发言者也作了类似基调的简短讲话。活动于晚上8时30分结束。

活动期间，向与会者分发了以下传单的副本：-

page_data.en:
October 9, 3.

Labour (14)

1. "Joint Manifesto by the Shanghai Municipality 4th
District Water & Electricity Workers' Union and the
Shanghai Power Company Employees' Lien Yih Club"
which denounces the management for oppressing the
workers and announces that the clerical staff will
join the movement to-day (October 9?)

2. An appeal issued by the General Labour Union in
connection with the labour trouble in the Power Company.

Hand Grenade Thrown into Home of Employee of Shanghai
Power Company

At 8 p.m. October 8 some one broke the window of
( 碧雲路 )
a Chinese dwelling house at 33 Poo Yueh Tang Ka, City,
where one named Sz Kiu-yang ( 史久雲 ), Chinese senior
clerk in the Accounting Department of the Shanghai
Power Company resides, and threw a hand grenade inside.
The missile failed to explode and was later removed by
the Chinese Police. A piece of paper found in the
house beside the hand grenade contained ████
word "Warning".
page_data.zh:
10月9日，3。

劳工（14）

1. “上海市第四区水电工会与上海电力公司职员联益社联合宣言”，谴责管理层压迫工人，并宣布文职员工将于今日（10月9日？）加入运动

2. 总工会就电力公司劳资纠纷发出的呼吁。

手榴弹投入上海电力公司雇员家中

10月8日晚8时，有人打破了城内碧云路（Poo Yueh Tang Ka）33号一处华人住宅的窗户，该住宅居住着上海电力公司会计部高级华籍职员史久雲（Sz Kiu-yang），并向屋内投掷了一枚手榴弹。该爆炸物未爆炸，后由中国警察移除。在屋内手榴弹旁发现的一张纸上含有 ████ 字样“警告”。

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
7-10-33
Shen Pao and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

In connection with the dispute between the
Shanghai Power Company and the workers, Mr. Heald, the
General Manager, stated that with a view to averting
a breakdown in the Shanghai Power Company, white
Russians had been taken on to replace the strikers.
The Company has now decided to engage the white Russians
for a long period in the event of the workers adopting
a long-period strike.
At 6 p.m. October 6, detectives of Central
Police Station of the International Settlement and
officials of the 2nd Station of the 5th District Police
of the Public Safety Bureau called at the "4th District
Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union" to make
investigation.

At a meeting held yesterday by the Standing
Committee of the General Labour Union, the following
resolutions were passed:-
1. That the following measures be adopted to support
the workers of the Shanghai Power Company:-
a) To issue a circular ordering various labour unions
to give their financial assistance.
b) To order the "Postal Workers Union", the "4th District
Rolled Tobacco Trade Workers Union", and three other
labour unions to contribute each a sum of $50. .
c) To issue a letter addressed to the public.
2. That 4 persons be appointed to be responsible
for the preparations in entertaining various public
bodies to-morrow.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
1933年10月7日
《申报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司劳工局势。

关于上海电力公司与工人之间的纠纷，总经理希尔德（Heald）先生表示，为了避免上海电力公司瘫痪，已雇佣白俄人替代罢工者。如果工人采取长期罢工，公司现已决定长期雇佣白俄人。
10月6日下午6时，国际租界中央捕房侦探及公安局第五区第二分局官员前往“第四区水电业工会”进行调查。

在总工会常务委员会昨日举行的会议上，通过了以下决议：-
1. 采取以下措施支持上海电力公司工人：-
a) 发布通令，要求各工会提供财政援助。
b) 命令“邮务工会”、“第四区卷烟业工会”及其他三个工会各捐款50元。
c) 发布致公众的信函。
2. 任命4人负责筹备明日招待各界团体的事宜。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5310
Date 7 / 10 / 33

NOTICE TO EMPLOYEES OF THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY

D5310

There have been so many untruthful statements made in some of the Shanghai papers that it has become necessary that the Company states frankly the facts so that in no case will any employee be misled by false statements.

According to articles appearing in some of the Shanghai papers the following untrue statement was made to a gathering of newspaper reporters by men leading the strikers of the Shanghai Power Company:

"The pension for workmen, which at the S.M.C. time were paid at the rate of 5%, are now reduced from 1 to 2 per cent. Furthermore, these reduced pensions are subject to cancellation by the Company at its discretion, for it may refuse to pay the pension fund to a dismissed workman on the pretext that the man was discharged on fault of his own."

The foregoing statement is either a deliberate falsehood for the purpose of misleading the public and causing trouble or else the so-called leaders of the strikers are entirely ignorant of the facts. In view of the false impression created the Company feels that it is necessary that it deny the statement.

The facts are as follows: When the Company was operated as a part of the S.M.C. they paid a gratuity of 5% of the annual wages times the number of years worked to employees who left the Company for any reason whatever only after 20 years service. Nothing was paid to employees leaving the Company before they had served 20 years. This payment was made in addition to wages and its only purpose was to serve as an inducement for employees to stay with the Company. It was agreed that the foregoing arrangement should be continued by the Company. The facts of the foregoing statement can be confirmed by those who desire the truth, by investigation of the records of the Shanghai Municipal Council.

The Company and the Council have since extended the foregoing gratuity regulations. Under the Company's scheme any employee leaving the Company for any reason whatever after 15 years of service receives 5% of his annual wages times the number of years worked, and further under the Company when an employee is discharged for no fault of his own and who has worked for the Company less than 15 years is paid a gratuity in proportion to the number of years worked. Under no other circumstances is a gratuity paid. Prior to 15 years service, employees discharged for misconduct, loafing on the job, sleeping on the job, or leaving the Company's service of their own volition, are not entitled to a gratuity and have never been entitled to a gratuity either under the Company or the S.M.C.

The Company has in no case violated the foregoing regulations and invites investigation by any responsible persons who wish to know the truth. Statements made to the contrary are deliberate falsehoods made either for the purpose of causing trouble or by leaders whose ignorance hardly justifies them handling labour problems.

Regarding the men about which untruthful statements have been made, we wish to state the facts of these cases as follows:

Employee CL-11, name Sih Ah Pao, on the 13th of September asked for sick leave. He was examined by the Chinese doctor and while the case was doubtful the doctor advised giving him 2 days leave. On September 15th this man returned to work and was pronounced all right. After that day he disappeared and did not show up for work. On September 25th at 11:00 in the morning he came to Riverside Time Office and stated that he was quitting the Company's service and wanted his wages.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 5310
日期 33年10月7日

致上海电力公司全体雇员之通告

D5310

鉴于上海部分报刊刊登了大量不实言论，本公司认为有必要坦率陈述事实，以免任何雇员受虚假陈述之误导。

据上海部分报刊文章称，上海电力公司罢工领导人在一次记者招待会上发表了如下不实言论：

“工人的养老金，在工部局（S.M.C.）管理时期按5%的比例支付，现在已削减至1%到2%。此外，这些削减后的养老金可由公司酌情取消，因为公司可以以工人因自身过错被解雇为借口，拒绝向被解雇的工人支付养老基金。”

上述言论要么是旨在误导公众、制造事端的蓄意谎言，要么是所谓的罢工领导人完全不了解事实真相。鉴于由此造成的错误印象，本公司认为有必要对该言论予以否认。

事实如下：当本公司作为工部局（S.M.C.）的一部分运营时，对于服务满20年后因任何原因离开公司的雇员，公司会支付一笔酬金，金额为年薪的5%乘以服务年限。对于服务未满20年即离开公司的雇员，不支付任何款项。这笔款项是在工资之外支付的，其唯一目的是作为一种激励手段，促使雇员留在公司。双方已约定，公司将继续执行上述安排。凡欲知真相者，可通过查阅上海工部局的档案记录来证实上述事实。

此后，公司与工部局延长了上述酬金规定。根据公司的方案，任何服务满15年后因任何原因离开公司的雇员，均可获得年薪5%乘以服务年限的酬金；此外，根据公司规定，若雇员非因自身过错而被解雇，且在公司服务不满15年，则按服务年限比例支付酬金。除上述情况外，不支付任何酬金。在服务未满15年的情况下，因行为不端、怠工、在岗睡觉或自愿离职而被解雇的雇员，无权获得酬金，且无论是在公司管理时期还是工部局（S.M.C.）管理时期，他们从未有权获得此类酬金。

公司在任何情况下均未违反上述规定，并欢迎任何希望了解真相的负责任人士进行调查。与此相反的说法均为蓄意谎言，其目的要么是制造事端，要么是由于领导人无知，而这种无知使他们几乎不具备处理劳工问题的能力。

关于那些被发表不实言论所涉及的员工，我们愿陈述这些案件的事实如下：

雇员 CL-11，姓名 Sih Ah Pao（音译），于9月13日请病假。经华籍医生检查，虽然病情存疑，但医生建议给予其两天假期。9月15日，此人返回工作岗位，并被认定身体无恙。此后他便失踪，未再上班。9月25日上午11时，他来到江边计时办公室，声称要辞去在公司的工作，并要求结算工资。

- 2 -

He refused to take his pay when the gratuity was not included.
Under the Company's regulations he was not entitled to a gratui-
ty for two reasons - first because he was absent without cause
from work without notifying the Company, secondly because
he was voluntarily quitting the Company and was not being
discharged without cause. The Company cannot successfully
operate its business with employees who come to work when they
feel like it or do not notify the Company. Their work must
be taken care of until they return.
Employee GWC-23, name Te Dzung Hun, was found loafing
away from the place he was supposed to be working. This took
place about two weeks before he was discharged, and he was
warned that he could not be kept if he continued such
practice. Two weeks later the man was found loafing again
away from work and could offer no excuse for doing so.
Upon inquiry as to why he was doing it he became abusive
and insolent. For this he was discharged and under these
circumstances he was not entitled to a gratuity according
to the Company's regulation as he was discharged for a cause,
that is, neglect of work.
Employee G.W.C.-6, name Tseu Bing Kung, was found asleep
during working hours at a place away from where he was supposed
to be working. The Company cannot be expected to pay men
who leave their work and hide in some place to sleep.
He was discharged and under the circumstances was obviously
not entitled to a gratuity.
In all of the foregoing cases the men had a bad record
and the Company had tried in every way to get along with them.
When statements are made contrary to the foregoing they
are deliberate malicious falsehoods made for the purpose of
creating trouble and misleading you and the public.
For your information, this strike was called without
warning to the Company and without prior statement as to any
reason for striking. No representatives of our employees
have called upon executives of the Company nor has the
Company as yet been informed as to any reason for their action.
It should be noted that some of the men most enthusiastic
in having the employees of the Company strike are not now
employed by the Company and do not risk anything by causing
trouble. They do not take the risk of the employees who not
only lose their wages during the time they are striking, but
possibly lose their jobs.
It is important that you know the facts as by knowing
the facts your good sense and judgment will guide you rightly.

S. S. Heald,
Vice President & General Manager.

October 5, 1933.

（左侧手写批注：D5310 / Canton）

- 2 -

当酬金未包含在内时，他拒绝领取工资。
根据公司规定，他无权获得酬金，原因有二：首先，他在未通知公司的情况下无故缺勤；其次，他是自愿辞职，而非被无故解雇。如果雇员随心所欲地来上班或不通知公司，公司将无法成功开展业务。在他们回来之前，必须有人照顾他们的工作。

雇员 GWC-23，姓名 Te Dzung Hun（音译），被发现不在指定工作地点而在别处怠工。这发生在他被解雇前约两周，当时他曾受到警告，如果继续这种行为，公司将不予留用。两周后，该人再次被发现不在工作岗位而怠工，且对此无法提供任何理由。当被问及为何如此行事时，他变得辱骂他人且傲慢无礼。因此他被解雇，在这种情况下，根据公司规定，他因有故（即疏忽职守）被解雇，无权获得酬金。

雇员 G.W.C.-6，姓名 Tseu Bing Kung（音译），在工作时间内被发现睡在远离其指定工作地点的地方。不能指望公司为那些离开工作岗位并躲在某处睡觉的人支付薪水。他被解雇，在这种情况下，显然无权获得酬金。

在上述所有案件中，这些人的记录不良，公司已尽一切努力与他们相处。当出现与上述情况相反的言论时，这些都是旨在制造麻烦并误导你们及公众的蓄意恶意谎言。

供你们参考，此次罢工是在未向公司发出警告且未事先说明任何罢工理由的情况下发起的。我们的雇员代表未曾拜访公司高管，公司也尚未获悉他们采取此行动的任何理由。

值得注意的是，一些最热衷于煽动公司员工罢工的男子目前并非公司雇员，他们在制造事端方面不承担任何风险。他们不像雇员那样承担风险，雇员不仅在罢工期间失去工资，还可能失去工作。

重要的是你们要了解事实，因为了解事实后，你们的常识和判断力将引导你们做出正确的决定。

S. S. Heald，
副总裁兼总经理。

1933年10月5日。

（左侧手写批注：D5310 / Canton）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5310
Date 7 / 10 / 33

October 7, 1933,    Morning Translation

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

In an interview yesterday with our reporter, Mr. Heald, the General Manager of the Shanghai Power Company, made the following statements:-
"The workers of the new plant of the Shanghai Power Company on Doong Ting Road went on a "go-slow" strike on the morning of September 29. On October 2, the hands of the old plant at Fearon Road walked out, and the temporary workers of the new plant and the foremen of the old plant joined the movement on October 5. The total number of workers on strike is estimated at 1,400 and only the distribution workers and the staff members of both the new and old plants, numbering about 1,100, are still employed.
"The recent strike of workers of the two plants was instigated by certain persons. The report that the Company called in the police to prevent the workers from entering the plants is absurd. It is a matter of regret that many law-abiding workers could not carry on their duties owing to intimidation by undesirable elements.
"In the event of the 3 shifts of workers joining the strike, the Company would engage new hands to undertake the distribution of power. As to the strikers, the Company agrees to reinstate them, if they desire to resume. The wire-cutting workers returned to work of their own accord."

It is reported that the "4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union" will call a conference of foremen at 3 p.m. October 8 at which measures to be adopted will be discussed.

In a manifesto, the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce alleges that the Shanghai Power Company has rejected lawful mediations by the Chinese official organs, thereby prolonging the dispute. The Chamber regrets that the Company has not considered the importance of co-operation between employers and employees in a public enterprise such as, the Power Company.

编号 D 5310
日期 33年10月7日

1933年10月7日，上午译文

劳工。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

在昨日接受本报记者采访时，上海电力公司总经理 Heald 先生发表了如下声明：
“上海电力公司位于洞庭路的新厂工人于9月29日上午进行了‘慢工’罢工。10月2日，斐伦路老厂的工人罢工，新厂的临时工和老厂的领班于10月5日加入了这一运动。估计罢工工人总数为1,400人，只有新老两厂的配电工人和职员，共计约1,100人，仍在职。
“两厂工人最近的罢工是由某些人煽动的。关于公司召警阻止工人进入厂房的报道是荒谬的。令人遗憾的是，许多守法工人因受不良分子的恐吓而无法履行职责。
“如果三班工人均加入罢工，公司将雇佣新人来承担电力分配工作。至于罢工者，如果他们希望复工，公司同意恢复他们的职位。剪线工人已自愿返岗。”

据报道，“第四区水电业工会”将于10月8日下午3时召开领班会议，讨论拟采取的措施。

上海总商会在一份宣言中指控上海电力公司拒绝中国官方机构的合法调解，从而延长了争端。商会对公司未考虑到在像电力公司这样的公共企业中劳资合作的重要性表示遗憾。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5310
October 7, 10/3/33
Date

Labour (4)

Shanghai Power Company - situation - intimidation
by strikers

The situation at Riverside Power Station remains
unchanged this morning, some 1491 workers continue on
strike.

Two workers attached to Fearon Road Station were
seized on Yangtsepoo Road on October 6 by a number of
strike pickets on the pretext that they were strike
breakers. The captives were taken to the 4th District
Water and Electricity Workers' Union, 15 Shou Ying Fang,
Tiendoong Road, Chapei, where they were released with
a caution after having been photographed.

The Shanghai Power Company distributed a circular
entitled "Notice to Employees of the Shanghai Power
Company" on October 6. A full copy of this notice is
attached to this report as an Appendix.

Some 10 members of the Strike Committee
of the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers'
Union held a secret meeting in their office, 15 Shou
Ying Faung, Tiendoong Road, Chapei, between 6.30 and
8 p.m. October 6 when the following measures dealing
with the strike were discussed and passed :-

1. That should further mediation, which will be conducted
by the Chinese Authorities with the Company, result
in failure, the whole body of workers of both the
Fearon Road and the Riverside Power Stations forcibly
enter their respective workshops and declare a
"hunger" strike therein.

2. That in connection with this, Zi Hung Sung (徐洪生)
and Chiang Tsung Ming (蒋正明) be appointed leaders
of the workers of the Fearon Road Station and Yang Zan
Keng (杨赞根) and Tsu Ah Foh (朱阿福), leaders of
those of the Riverside Power Station.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 5310
10/3/33
日期 10月7日

劳工 (4)

上海电力公司 - 局势 - 罢工者的恐吓

今晨江边发电站的局势保持不变，约1491名工人继续罢工。

10月6日，两名隶属于斐伦路发电站的工人在杨树浦路上被一群罢工纠察队以破坏罢工者为借口扣押。俘虏被带到闸北天通庵路寿英坊15号的第四区水电业工会，在被拍照并受到警告后被释放。

上海电力公司于10月6日分发了一份题为“致上海电力公司全体雇员之通告”的传单。该通告的完整副本作为附录附在本报告后。

10月6日晚6时30分至8时之间，第四区水电业工会罢工委员会的约10名成员在闸北天通庵路寿英坊15号的办公室举行秘密会议，讨论并通过了以下应对罢工的措施：

1. 如果由中国当局与公司进行的进一步调解失败，斐伦路和江边发电站的全体工人将强行进入各自的车间，并在其中宣布进行“绝食”罢工。

2. 为此，任命 Zi Hung Sung（徐洪生）和 Chiang Tsung Ming（蒋正明）为斐伦路发电站工人的领导人，任命 Yang Zan Keng（杨赞根）和 Tsu Ah Foh（朱阿福）为江边发电站工人的领导人。

October 7, 3.

Labour (5)

3. That part of the members of the Picketing Groups and Secret Investigation Groups remain outside the Stations to supervise the movement, and transmit messages to the workers on hunger strike in the Stations through the Telephone Switch Rooms.

4. That should the Police interfere with the workers, representatives be appointed to call on the responsible officers of the various local authorities and inform them that the workers intend to stay in the workshops until a settlement has been arranged.

5. That should the Police refuse to entertain the aforementioned request and attempt to eject the workers by force, the whole of the latter proceed to the Police Station and demand a settlement from the Police Authorities.

As a result of negotiations conducted by Nyi Wen Fu (倪文甫), ex-worker of the Shanghai Power Company, and Tsu Hao Sung (朱豪松), worker of the same concern, with the Chung Hwa Seamen's General Labour Union, the tow boat crews of the Shanghai Power Company who number some 103 have promised to join the strike on condition that they be given a substantial strike fund.

Seven committee members of the Chung Hwa Seamen's General Labour Union at a meeting held in their office, No.33 Oong Ka Ts Loong, Nantao, on the afternoon of October 6 reached the following decisions :-

1. That the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers' Union should contribute to the strike fund of the tow boat crews should they want their support.

2. That the same Union be asked to report to this body the strike condition after the tow boat crews have taken part joined the movement.

At 11.15 a.m. October 6, three representatives of the General Labour Union, 117 Feh You Road, City, called at the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and requested

3. 部分纠察队和秘密调查组成员留在电站外监督运动，并通过电话交换室向电站内绝食罢工的工人传递消息。

4. 如果警察干涉工人，应指派代表拜访各地方当局的责任官员，告知他们工人打算留在车间内，直到达成解决方案为止。

5. 如果警察拒绝受理上述请求并试图强行驱逐工人，全体工人将前往警察局，要求警察当局解决问题。

经过上海电力公司前雇员 Ni Wen Fu（倪文甫）和该公司雇员 Tsu Hao Sung（朱豪松）与中华海员总工会的谈判，上海电力公司的拖船船员（约103人）承诺在获得 substantial（原文不清，意为“可观的”或“充足的”）罢工基金的前提下加入罢工。

中华海员总工会的七名委员于10月6日下午在其位于南市翁家弄33号的办公室举行的会议上作出如下决定：

1. 如果拖船船员需要支持，第四区水电业工会应向拖船船员的罢工基金捐款。

2. 要求该工会在拖船船员加入运动后，向本会报告罢工情况。

10月6日上午11时15分，位于市内福州路117号的总工会的三名代表拜访了大上海市政府，并请求

that the organ devise effective measures to bring to
an end the present strike in the Shanghai Power Company.
They were received by O.K. Yu, Secretary to the

该机构制定有效措施，以结束上海电力公司目前的罢工。
他们受到市政府秘书余（O.K. Yu，音译）的接见，余告知他们，所涉事项正在调查中。他还指示来访者遵守和平与秩序。

10月6日下午5时至7时之间，位于兰路（Range Road）230号的邮务俱乐部十名成员在办公室举行的会议上决议，敦促全国邮务员工支持上海电力公司罢工工人，并筹集资金予以支持。

C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5310
October 6 / 10³·33）

Labour

Shanghai Power Company - Situation - Alleged
abduction of workers

（批：D. 5310.）

The situation at Riverside Power Station remains almost
unchanged ~~this morning with one exception~~. Four Chinese
employed on emergency disconnections have resumed work.
They presented themselves for work on October 5, stating
that they were resuming with the knowledge and approval
of the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers' Union
who considered that their work was of vital importance
to the public.

In addition 62 chauffeurs hitherto shown as being
on strike are working normally thus reducing the number
of men on strike to 1,491 and increasing the number still
working to 1,156.

Three workers attached to Fearon Road Station were
caught on Yangtszepoo Road on October 4 by a number of
strike pickets. They were first taken to a photographic
studio where they were photographed and thence to the
offices of the Union where it is reported they were
assaulted and later released.

On October 5, several local labour unions including
the Postal Workers' Club and the Chung Hwa Seamen's
Federation, 33 Oong Ka Ts Loong, City, despatched a joint
letter to the strikers expressing sympathy with them.

In view of a possibility that the workers, now
operating the plant at Riverside Power Station, may join
the strike, the management has taken special precautions.

Full statistics of employees affected and not
affected by the strike at each Station or branch of the
Company are attached to this Summary as "Appendix "A".

劳工

上海电力公司 - 局势 - 据称绑架工人事件

（批：D. 5310。）

杨树浦发电站（Riverside Power Station）的局势今晨几乎未变~~除以下例外~~。四名受雇进行紧急断电作业的中国籍员工已复工。他们于10月5日到岗，表示其复工是在第四区水电工会知情并批准的情况下进行的，该工会认为他们的工作对公众至关重要。

此外，此前列为罢工的62名司机现已正常工作，从而使罢工人数减少至1,491人，仍在工作的员工人数增加至1,156人。

10月4日，斐伦路（Fearon Road）电站的三名工人在杨树浦路（Yangtszepoo Road）被多名罢工纠察队员抓获。他们先被带到一家照相馆拍照，随后被带到工会办公室，据报在那里遭到殴打，之后获释。

10月5日，包括邮务俱乐部和中华海员联合会（地址：市区翁家弄33号）在内的几个当地工会向罢工者发出联合信函，表示同情。

鉴于目前在杨树浦发电站运营工厂的工人可能加入罢工，管理层已采取特别预防措施。

受和不受罢工影响的各电站或分公司员工的完整统计数据作为“附录A”附于本摘要之后。

October 6, 1933.    Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

（批：D.5310）

Based on the resolutions passed at a meeting held on October 4, the entire body of foremen, numbering about 60, and some 200 temporary workers of the old plant of the Shanghai Power Company joined the "go-slow" strike yesterday morning. It is reported that only the distribution workers are operating at present.

Interviewed yesterday by a reporter of the Dah Kung News Agency, a responsible person of the "Shanghai Power Company Employees & Workers Mutual Society" made the following statement:-

"When the Shanghai Power Company was controlled by the Shanghai Municipal Council, an employee was entitled to 5% of the wages he had received during the period of his employment after having completed 20 years' service. The Council did not dismiss employees for trivial offences and generally treated them fairly.

"Under the present regime, the Shanghai Power Company has frequently dismissed workers and refused the payment of pensions on the pretext that the dismissals were due to the faults of the employees. The condition of the Chinese employees has grown steadily worse, wages have decreased and dismissals have become more frequent particularly amongst the staff members of the Electricity Testing Department and new staff members have been employed at a lower wage. Proposals have been repeatedly submitted to the Company but have been ignored.

"In August this year, five long-service men were dismissed without cause. Furthermore, the meter readers, owing to the approach of the cold weather, requested the Company to provide them with uniform overcoats but this request was refused. Thus, oppression by the officials is felt in all departments of the Company.

"The workers have been compelled to go on a "go-slow" strike. The staff members are sympathetic towards the workers and will not become the tools of the Company."

Interviewed at the General Office of the Company on Kiangsi Road yesterday, Mr. Heald, the General Manager, stated that the situation had reached a deadlock. The Company will not accept the offer of mediation by a third party, but only direct negotiations between the management and the workers will be tolerated. This is stipulated in the Regulations governing the administration of the Shanghai Power Company.

A responsible person of the "4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union" stated that the strikers would not resume work until their

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

（批：D.5310）

根据10月4日会议通过的决议，上海电力公司旧厂约60名领班和约200名临时工于昨日上午加入了“怠工”罢工。据报道，目前只有配电工人在运作。

“上海电力公司职工互助社”的一位负责人昨日接受大公新闻社记者采访时发表如下声明：-

“当上海电力公司由上海公共租界工部局控制时，员工在服务满20年后，有权获得其任职期间所得工资的5%。工部局不会因轻微过失解雇员工，并且通常公平对待他们。

“在现行体制下，上海电力公司频繁解雇工人，并以解雇是由于员工过错为借口拒绝支付养老金。中国籍员工的状况日益恶化，工资下降，解雇变得更加频繁，特别是在电气测试部门的员工中，新员工则以较低的工资受雇。多次向公司提交提案，但均被忽视。

“今年8月，五名资深员工无故被解雇。此外，由于天气转冷，抄表员请求公司提供制服大衣，但该请求被拒绝。因此，公司各部门都感受到了官方的压迫。

“工人们被迫进行‘怠工’罢工。职员们同情工人，不会成为公司的工具。”

希尔德（Heald，音译）总经理昨日在公司江西路总办事处接受采访时表示，局势已陷入僵局。公司将不接受第三方调解，只允许管理层与工人直接谈判。这是《上海电力公司管理章程》中规定的。

October 5, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

China Times and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

With a view to strengthening the position of the workers, the foremen of both the new and the old plants of the Shanghai Power Company have resolved to join the movement of the "go-slow" strike.

At a meeting held at 10 a.m. yesterday, by the foremen at the General Labour Union, the following resolutions were passed:-
1. That the temporary workers join the "go-slow" strike from October 5.
2. That in view of the fact that the foremen of the new plant have voluntarily left the premises, the foremen of the old plant walk out from October 5.

Fearing that an outbreak of fire after all the hands had joined the "go-slow" strike might considerably affect the community, the public bodies yesterday endeavoured to arrange with the "Go-slow" Strike Committee for assistance, as a result of which, the latter agreed to order four wire-cutting workers and brass-smiths to resume work for the time being.

Lest this action might be misunderstood by the strikers, the Committee at 5 p.m. yesterday called in representatives of workers and informed them that the wire-cutting workers were resuming work at the request of the public bodies, and with a view to maintaining peace and order in the community, it is not an indication that the strikers are yielding to the demands of the Company and the four wire-cutting workers can be instructed to stop operations at any time if necessary.

The new plant of the Shanghai Power Company owns 2 coal steamers and several lighters on which about 100 seamen and coal workers are employed. They have not yet joined the strike owing to the fact that they are controlled by the Seamen's Union.

The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union has requested the assistance of the Seamen's Union.

The Seamen's Union yesterday detailed a representative to inform the Trade Workers Union that they are preparing to meet the situation and that the seamen would be ready to join the strike movement at the suitable time.

Interviewed yesterday by a reporter of the Shun Shih News Agency, responsible persons of the General Labour Union and the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union stated that the workers would never submit, but would make every sacrifice to attain their object. For the sake of peace and order in the community, the hands have tolerated the resumption of work by the wire-cutting workers and have allowed the 3 shifts of workers to continue operations for the distribution of power.

1933年10月5日。上午译文。

劳工。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

为了加强工人的地位，上海电力公司新厂和旧厂的领班已决议加入“怠工”罢工运动。

在昨日上午10时由领班们在总工会举行的会议上，通过了以下决议：-
1. 临时工从10月5日起加入“怠工”罢工。
2. 鉴于新厂领班已自愿离开工厂，旧厂领班从10月5日起罢工离厂。

由于担心在所有工人加入“怠工”罢工后发生火灾可能会严重影响社区，公共团体昨日努力与“怠工”罢工委员会安排协助事宜，结果后者同意命令四名剪线工和铜匠暂时复工。

为了防止这一行动被罢工者误解，委员会于昨日下午5时召见工人代表，告知他们剪线工是应公共团体的请求复工，旨在维护社区的和平与秩序，这并不表明罢工者向公司的要求屈服，如有必要，可随时指示这四名剪线工停止作业。

上海电力公司新厂拥有2艘运煤蒸汽船和几艘驳船，雇佣了约100名海员和煤炭工人。由于他们受海员工会控制，尚未加入罢工。

第四区水电业工会已请求海员工会协助。

海员工会昨日指派一名代表通知业工会，他们正在准备应对局势，海员将在适当时机准备加入罢工运动。

顺时新闻社记者昨日采访总工会和第四区水电业工会的负责人时，他们表示工人绝不会屈服，但会为达成目标做出任何牺牲。为了社区的和平与秩序，工人们容忍了剪线工复工，并允许三班工人继续运作以分配电力。

October 5, 1933. Morning Translation

LABOUR

According to responsible officials of the
local Tangpu and the Social Bureau, no mediation could
take place owing to the firm attitude adopted by the
management. It is a matter of regret that they could
not devise measures to deal with the dispute, but
could only await alterations in the labour situation.
They would then attempt to conduct mediations again.
At 4 p.m. yesterday, the General Labour
Union held an emergency meeting of members of the
Executive Committee, and the Supervisory Committee, at
which the following resolutions were passed:-
1. That in view of the serious labour situation
at the Shanghai Power Company, the following measures
be adopted:-
a) A telegraphic petition be submitted to the Central
authorities and the local Tangpu and other political
organs be requested to deal with the dispute
immediately.
b) The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade
Workers Union be instructed not to stop the
distribution of power unless they are compelled to
do so.
c) Pecuniary help to be given.
d) A date be fixed to entertain various public bodies.
2. That five comrades be detailed to arrange
measures for increasing the finances of the 4th District
Waterworks & Electricity Trade Workers Union.

Mr. Heald On the Strike

The Nanking Road and Kiangsi Road entrances
of the Shanghai Power Company were closely guarded by
Foreign and Chinese policemen yesterday. Interviewed
by a reporter of the Shun Shi News Agency, Mr. Heald,
manager of the Company, made the following statement:-
"Formerly, when the power plant was under
the control of the S.M.C., a labour contract existed
in the terms of which a pension of 5% of the annual
wage was given to retiring workers who had remained in
the service for over 20 years. Since the purchase of
the plant by the Shanghai Power Company, this agreement
had been amended that workers who had been employed in
the Company for over 15 years be given a gratuity of
5% of their annual wage upon retirement. Those who
had less than 15 years service in the Company were also
given the gratuity when they retired from the Company
for any reason other than dismissal for misconduct.
There were no guarantees of other gratuities. The
recent dismissal of three workers was due to their
own slackness. Two of them were dismissed after the
Company had thrice warned them against laziness. One
of them did not return to the service after two days'
sick leave, and tendered his resignation to the
Company on September 25. The Company agreed to grant
him a further leave of one month, and to pay his
medical expenses until he recovered, but he refused and

劳工事务

据当地党部和社会局的负责官员称，由于资方态度强硬，无法进行调解。令人遗憾的是，他们未能制定出解决纠纷的措施，只能等待劳工局势发生变化。届时他们将尝试再次进行调解。昨日下午4时，上海总工会召开执行委员会和监察委员会成员紧急会议，通过以下决议：-
1. 鉴于上海电力公司劳工局势严重，采取以下措施：-
a) 向中央当局提交电请愿书，并请求当地党部及其他政治机关立即处理该纠纷。
b) 指示第四区水电业工会，除非被迫，否则不得停止供电。
c) 提供金钱援助。
d) 确定日期招待各公共团体。
2. 指派五名同志安排增加第四区水电业工会资金的措施。

希尔德（Heald）先生谈罢工

昨日，上海电力公司的南京路和江西路入口处由外籍和华人警察严密把守。该公司经理希尔德先生在接受《申报》记者采访时发表如下声明：-
“以前，当发电厂由工部局控制时，存在一份劳动合同，规定在服务超过20年的退休工人可获得相当于年薪5%的养老金。自上海电力公司收购该厂以来，该协议已修订为：在公司服务超过15年的工人退休时，可获得相当于年薪5%的酬金。那些在公司服务不足15年的人，若因非行为不端被解雇以外的任何原因离开公司，退休时也可获得该酬金。没有其他酬金的保证。最近解雇三名工人是由于他们自身懈怠。其中两人在公司三次警告其懒惰后被解雇。其中一人在两天病假后未返回工作岗位，并于9月25日向公司提出辞职。公司同意再给他一个月假期，并支付其医疗费用直至康复，但他拒绝了，并

page_data.en:
October 5, 3.

Labour

Shanghai Power Company - Situation

The situation at Riverside Power Station and various
depots remains unchanged this morning, the total number
of workers on strike being some 1,557.

At 2.15 p.m. October 4, Nyi Wen-foo (倪文富), ex-worker,
and Pao Tuh-foh (包德福), Chen Yeu-fah (陳友發) and Chu
Hao-sung (朱浩淞), workers of the Riverside Power Station,
in company with representatives of the General Labour
Union, visited the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and
appealed for assistance in bringing about a settlement
of the dispute under report. They also visited the
offices of the local Kuomintang, West Gate. At each
place they were informed that further negotiations would
be undertaken on their behalf.

Six committee members of the General Labour Union
held a meeting in their office, 117 Feh You Road, City,
between 1.30 and 3 p.m. October 4 and passed the following
resolutions :-

1. That members be assigned to assist the Power Company
strikers in inducing the Chinese Authorities to render
help.

2. That local labour unions be notified to render their
moral and financial assistance to the strikers of
the Shanghai Power Company.

3. That the Central Kuomintang be requested to assign
members to Shanghai to mediate in the labour dispute
now existent in the Shanghai Power Company.

4. That the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers'
Union (formed by S.P.C. workers) be instructed to
refrain from causing the stoppage of electricity
supply however serious the situation.

5. That arrangements be made to raise funds for the
support of the strikers.

10月5日，3日。

劳工

上海电力公司 - 局势

今晨江边发电站及各分站的局势保持不变，罢工工人总数约为1,557人。

10月4日下午2时15分，前工人倪文富（Nyi Wen-foo），以及江边发电站工人包德福（Pao Tuh-foh）、陈友发（Chen Yeu-fah）和朱浩淞（Chu Hao-sung），在总工会代表的陪同下，访问了大上海市政府，恳请协助解决上述纠纷。他们还访问了西门当地的国民党党部办事处。在每个地方，他们都被告知将代表他们进行进一步谈判。

10月4日下午1时30分至3时之间，总工会六名委员在市内斐佑路117号办公室举行会议，并通过以下决议：-

1. 指派成员协助电力公司罢工工人，促使中国当局提供帮助。

2. 通知当地各工会向上海电力公司罢工工人提供道义和财政援助。

3. 请求国民党中央指派人员来沪，调解目前存在于上海电力公司的劳资纠纷。

4. 指示第四区水电工人工会（由上海电力公司工人组成），无论局势多么严重，均不得造成电力供应中断。

5. 安排筹集资金以支持罢工工人。

October 5, 3.

Labour (2)

Under the auspices of the 4th District Water &
Electricity Workers' Union, some 40 foremen in the employ
of the Shanghai Power Company met in the General Labour
Union, 117 Foh Yeu Road, City, between 9.15 and 10.45 a.m.
October 4. Nyi Wen-foo (倪文富), ex-worker of the
Shanghai Power Company, who presided, addressed the
attendance, urging the foremen to assist the strikers.
A similar speech was made by Yih Ziang-kao (葉翔皋),
committee member of the General Labour Union, who advocated
that labour should unite to break down the stubborn attitude
of the Shanghai Power Company. The following resolutions
were discussed and passed :-

1. That the foremen declare a strike of their own accord
in sympathy with the workers already on strike.

2. That the foremen refrain from engaging new hands to
work in the Company so long as the strike lasts.

3. That the foremen instruct the contract men to refrain
from working in the Company during the present strike
and that force be employed against the strike breakers.

4. That Nyi Wen-foo (倪文富) and Pao Tuh-fah (包德福) be
detailed to call on the authorities of the General
Labour Union for assistance.

Loh Ching-da (陸京士), committee member of the
local Kuomintang, Chu Ching-tao (朱錦濤) of the
Bureau of Social Affairs, and four other staff members
of the local Tangpu held a conference in the local
Kuomintang Headquarters, Ling Ying Road, West Gate, between
1.10 and 2 p.m. October 4 and discussed the labour
dispute now in existence in the Shanghai Power Company.
The following decisions were reached:-
page_data.zh:
10月5日，3日。

劳工 (2)

10月4日上午9时15分至10时45分之间，在第四区水电工人工会的主持下，约40名受雇于上海电力公司的领班在市内斐佑路117号总工会开会。上海电力公司前工人倪文富（Nyi Wen-foo）主持会议并发表讲话，敦促领班们协助罢工工人。总工会委员叶翔皋（Yih Ziang-kao）也发表了类似演讲，主张劳工应团结起来打破上海电力公司的顽固态度。讨论并通过了以下决议：-

1. 领班们自愿宣布罢工，以声援已经罢工的工人。

2. 只要罢工持续，领班们不得招募新员工在公司工作。

3. 领班们指示合同工在目前罢工期间不在公司工作，并对破坏罢工者使用武力。

4. 指派倪文富（Nyi Wen-foo）和包德福（Pao Tuh-fah）拜访总工会当局寻求援助。

当地国民党委员陆京士（Loh Ching-da）、社会局的朱锦涛（Chu Ching-tao）以及当地党部的其他四名工作人员，于10月4日下午1时10分至2时之间在西门灵英路当地国民党总部举行会议，讨论了目前存在于上海电力公司的劳资纠纷。达成以下决定：-

page_data.en:
October 5, 3.

Labour (3)

1. That the local Kuomintang and the Bureau of Social Affairs each assign a representative to confer with Mr. O.K. Yuo, Secretary of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, regarding the dispute.

2. That the rumour current to the effect that certain reactionary elements are endeavouring to instigate the workers of the Power and Water plants in the French Concession and Chinese controlled territory to declare a strike in sympathy with the Shanghai Power Company workers, be investigated by the local Kuomintang and the movement suppressed.

3. That Tai Yu-heng (戴有恒) and Chu Ching-tao (朱锦涛), who have been assigned by the local Kuomintang and the Bureau of Social Affairs respectively to mediate in the dispute, be instructed to continue to advise the management of the Power Company to settle the matter at an early date.

page_data.en:
October 4, 1933.    Morning Translation

LABOUR

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

The 2,000 workers of the power stations at Yangtszepoo and Fearon Road, who declared a "go-slow" strike as a protest against the dismissal of workers and the refusal of the Company to pay gratuities upon retirement, were still out yesterday. Nothing untoward took place.

Mr. Jones, Secretary of the S.M.C., discussed the strike with the manager of the Company. The attitude of the Company still remained firm and yesterday morning a notice was posted at the entrance instructing those who had already left their work to call for their pay. This notice was ignored by the strikers.

The "4th District Waterworks and Electricity Workers Union" at 9 a.m. yesterday detailed six delegates to appeal to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai for assistance. They were received by an official of the Second Department who promised to request the Social Bureau to mediate in the dispute, and advised the workers to wait patiently for the settlement. The delegates were satisfied and retired.

At 10 a.m. yesterday the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang and the Social Bureau appointed two officers to call on the General Manager of the Shanghai Power Company at the head office on Kiangsi Road. The Company regarded the strike of workers as unreasonable and expressed the view that the demands of the workers could not be accepted.

The "Shanghai Power Company Employees and Workers Mutual Society" is sympathetic towards the present strike of the workers. Yesterday the Society appointed delegates to arrange with the "Go-slow" Strike Committee, and decided to lend its aid to the strike movement in the near future.

The Company fears that the dispute might affect the 3 shifts of workers at present operating for the distribution of the power. Although 50 white Russians are now employed, they have not the experience of the Chinese employees; and their number is insufficient to cope with the work. In ordinary times, when a fire breaks out, the Company details Chinese workers to cut the wires. Now these workers are joining the strike. Fearing an outbreak of fire, the Company yesterday sent men to make arrangements with the workers demanding that the wire-cutting workers immediately resume work. The request was accepted by the workers for the safety of the public.

The entire body of 200 foremen of the new and old power plants will hold a meeting at 9 a.m. to-day in the office of the General Labour Union, Chinese City, to discuss ways and means to deal with the present dispute.

（批：D 2510.）
page_data.zh:
1933年10月4日。    晨间译件

劳工

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

杨树浦和斐伦路发电站的2,000名工人，为抗议解雇工人及公司拒绝支付退休酬金而宣布“怠工”罢工，昨日仍继续罢工。未发生任何意外事件。

工部局秘书琼斯（Jones）先生与公司经理讨论了罢工问题。公司的态度依然强硬，昨日上午在入口处张贴告示，指示已离职人员领取工资。罢工者无视此告示。

“第四区水电工人工会”于昨日上午9时指派六名代表向大上海市政府求助。第二科的一名官员接待了他们，承诺请求社会局调解纠纷，并建议工人耐心等待解决。代表们感到满意并离去。

昨日上午10时，上海特区党部和社会局指派两名官员前往江西路总公司拜访上海电力公司总经理。公司认为工人的罢工是不合理的，并表示不能接受工人的要求。

“上海电力公司职员工人互助社”对目前工人的罢工表示同情。昨日，该社指派代表与“怠工”罢工委员会接洽，并决定在不久的将来援助罢工运动。

公司担心纠纷可能会影响目前负责配电的三班工人。虽然目前雇佣了50名白俄，但他们缺乏中国员工的经验；且人数不足以应付工作。平时发生火灾时，公司会指派中国工人切断电线。现在这些工人也加入了罢工。出于对火灾爆发的担忧，公司昨日派人安排，要求负责切线的工人立即复工。为了公共安全，工人接受了这一请求。

新老电厂的全部200名领班将于今日上午9时在市内总工会办公室举行会议，讨论应对当前纠纷的方法。

（批注：D 2510。）

October 4, 1933.
Morning Translation

LABOUR

In view of the fact that the strike of workers
of the Shanghai Power Company concerns the peace and order
of the district, the General Labour Union will convene an
urgent meeting of the Executive Committee at 2 p.m. to-day
to discuss the matter.
Yesterday the "4th District Waterworks and

page_data.zh:
1933年10月4日。
晨间译件

劳工

鉴于上海电力公司工人的罢工关系到该地区的和平与秩序，总工会将于今日下午2时召开执行委员会紧急会议讨论此事。
昨日，“第四区水电工人工会”发表声明，驳斥公司关于在“怠工”罢工前未收到工人任何请求的说法。

page_data.en:
October 4, 3.

Labour (3)
Shanghai Power Company - Situation

The total number of employees of the Shanghai Power
Company on strike this morning is about 1,557 including
fitters, linesmen, shop and workshop men and store coolies.
This increase over the figure 1,196 given in the Intelligence
Report of October 3, is accounted for by the inclusion of all
miscellaneous workmen, the previous statistics having been
confined to fitters and linesmen only. Some 1,090 employees
including Station shift men, clerks, tow boat crews etc. are
not affected by the strike. Full statistics of employees
affected and not affected by the strike at each Station or
branch of the Co. are attached to this Summary as "Appendix A".

The pay for the strikers was sent to Riverside Station
yesterday morning, but so far none of the men have reported
to draw their share of it.

Representatives of the Kuomintang and the Bureau of
Social Affairs called on the Co. at their offices, Nanking
Road at 11 a.m. October 3. They were interviewed by Mr. Heald,
General Manager who informed them that he was quite prepared
to give them any information they required but was not
prepared to listen to any mediation on behalf of the strikers.

At 10.15 a.m. October 3 four representatives of 4th
District Water & Electricity Workers' Union called at the
offices of the Shanghai Municipality and appealed for
assistance in requesting the management of the Shanghai Power
Co. to issue retiring gratuity to the dismissed workers.
Chang Zung-ngo (张成务) a staff member of the Municipality
who received them promised to convey their application to the
Mayor and advised the representatives to persuade the strikers
to resume work at once in order to avoid any untoward
incident. The callers left at 11 a.m.
page_data.zh:
10月4日，3时。

劳工（3）
上海电力公司——局势

今晨上海电力公司罢工员工总数约为1,557人，包括装配工、线路工、车间及工场工人和仓库苦力。这一数字较10月3日《情报报告》中给出的1,196人有所增加，原因是此次统计纳入了所有杂项工人，而此前的统计数据仅限于装配工和线路工。约有1,090名员工，包括电站轮班人员、职员、拖船船员等，未受罢工影响。各电站或公司分支机构受罢工影响及未受影响的员工详细统计数据，作为“附录A”附于本摘要之后。

罢工工人的工资已于昨日上午送至江边电站（Riverside Station），但截至目前，尚无工人前来领取其应得份额。

10月3日上午11时，国民党代表和社会局代表前往该公司位于南京路的办事处。公司总经理希尔德（Heald）先生接见了他们，并告知对方，他完全愿意提供所需的任何信息，但不准备听取任何代表罢工工人进行的调解。

10月3日上午10时15分，第四区水电工人工会的四名代表前往上海市政府办事处，请求协助，要求上海电力公司管理层向被解雇工人发放退休金。接待他们的市政府职员张成务（Chang Zung-ngo）承诺将他们的申请转达给市长，并建议代表们劝说罢工者立即复工，以避免发生任何意外事件。来访者于上午11时离开。

page_data.en:
October 4. 3.

Labour

At 5 p.m. October 3, about 100 strikers of the
Shanghai Power Company assembled in the offices of the 4th
District Water & Electricity Workers' Union, 15 Shou
Ying Faung, Tiendong Road, Chapei, when they were informed
by Chu Hao-sung (朱浩深), a committee member, that the
appeal made by representatives to the Shanghai Municipality
on the morning of October 3 and the negotiations undertaken
by members of the local Kuomintang and the Bureau of Social
Affairs with the management had produced no result. On
learning this the attendance shouted that all workers should
persist in the strike to the bitter end. It was
decided to appoint 11 members to supervise the strike
movement. Subsequently the eleven members held a
secret meeting in an inner room of the Union and passed
the following resolutions :-

1. That the communication groups be held responsible for
conveying the instructions of the strikers to the workers
on shift work at Riverside Power Station.

2. That pickets be held responsible for carrying out
intimidation and taking advantage of every chance
to interrupt the supply of electricity.

3. That arrangements be made to obtain a loan from
local public bodies for the purpose of carrying on
the strike movement.

4. That should the declaration of a general strike
prove insufficient to overcome the obstinate attitude
of the Company, drastic action be taken against
the more important members of the management.

5. That the movements of all strikers be kept secret and
that a careful watch be kept at all times for spies
acting for the Police and the management.
page_data.zh:
10月4日。3时。

劳工

10月3日下午5时，约100名上海电力公司罢工工人聚集在闸北天通庵路寿英坊15号的第四区水电工人工会办事处。工会委员朱浩深（Chu Hao-sung）向他们通报，10月3日上午代表向上海市政府提出的呼吁，以及当地国民党员和社会局成员与管理层进行的谈判，均未取得结果。得知此情况后，在场人员高呼所有工人应将罢工坚持到底。会议决定任命11名成员监督罢工运动。随后，这11名成员在工会内室举行秘密会议，并通过以下决议：

1. 联络组负责将罢工者的指令传达给江边电站的轮班工人。

2. 纠察队负责实施恐吓，并利用一切机会中断电力供应。

3. 安排向地方公共团体贷款，以维持罢工运动。

4. 如果宣布总罢工仍不足以克服公司的顽固态度，则对公司管理层的重要成员采取严厉行动。

5. 所有罢工者的行动必须保密，并时刻警惕为警方和管理层效力的间谍。

page_data.en:
October 3, 1933. Morning Transl·tionl

LABOUR.

China Times and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER CO.P.NY.

The workers of the new factory of the
Shanghai Power Company, Yangtsepoo, went on a "go-slow"
strike on September 29. Owing to the firm attitude
adopted by the Company and with a view to supporting
the strikers, the 800 hands of the old factory, as
resolved at a meeting of the "Go-slow" Strike Committee,
joined the movement yesterday morning. The two factories
employ more than 2,000 hands. It is understood that
with the exception of the Distribution Department,
work in other departments has come to a complete stand-
still.

The "Go-slow" Strike Committee yesterday
issued the following order :-
1. That the "Go-slow" Strike Committee be recognised
as the supreme organ during the period of the "go-slow"
strike.
2. That the workers of both the new and the old
factories give absolute obedience to the orders and
directions of the "Go-slow" Strike Committee.
3. That during the period of the "go-slow" strike,
all workers observe peace and order and not resort to
unlawful activities.
4. That during the period of the "go-slow" strike,
no rumours be spread which are liable to unsettle
the mind of the community.
5. That all workers await a settlement of the
dispute; they are not to become excited during the
strike.
6. That all workers be restrained from proceeding
to the factories during the period of the "go-slow"
strike.
7. That during the period of the "go-slow" strike,
all hands proceed to a certain appointed place to
secure information; they are not to pay heed to rumours.
8. That any worker who does not observe this order
be regarded as a "labour thief".
9. That drastic measures be adopted to deal with
willing "running dogs" and "labour thieves".

With a view to preventing workers from
creating disturbances, both the new and the old factories
are being being carefully protected by the Police.

The hands of the old factory yesterday
proceeded to the General Labour Union to hold a meeting.

The Company has engaged about 60 white
Russians who commenced working yesterday.

According to a worker named Chwang Chi-zung
of the Distribution Department, the 200 distribution
workers will join the strike should the management
maintain its stubborn attitude. There is a possibility
that the Russians may not be able to do the work.
page_data.zh:
1933年10月3日。晨间译稿

劳工。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司劳工局势。

上海电力公司杨树浦新厂工人于9月29日举行“怠工”罢工。鉴于公司采取强硬态度，且为了支持罢工者，老厂的800名工人根据“怠工”罢工委员会会议的决议，于昨日上午加入该运动。两家工厂雇佣工人超过2,000名。据悉，除配电部外，其他部门的工作已完全停滞。

“怠工”罢工委员会昨日发布如下命令：
1. 在“怠工”罢工期间，“怠工”罢工委员会被确认为最高机构。
2. 新老两厂工人必须绝对服从“怠工”罢工委员会的命令和指示。
3. 在“怠工”罢工期间，所有工人应保持和平与秩序，不得从事非法活动。
4. 在“怠工”罢工期间，不得散布可能扰乱社会民心的谣言。
5. 所有工人应等待纠纷解决；罢工期间不得情绪激动。
6. 在“怠工”罢工期间，严禁所有工人前往工厂。
7. 在“怠工”罢工期间，所有工人应前往指定指定地点获取信息；不得听信谣言。
8. 任何不遵守此命令的工人将被视为“工贼”。
9. 对自愿充当“走狗”和“工贼”的人采取严厉措施。

为防止工人制造骚乱，警方正严密保护新老两厂。

老厂工人昨日前往总工会开会。

公司已雇佣约60名白俄工人，他们于昨日开始工作。

据配电部一名名为庄志忠（Chwang Chi-zung，音译）的工人称，如果管理层保持其顽固态度，200名配电工人将加入罢工。白俄工人可能无法胜任这项工作。

page_data.en:
October 3, 1933.    Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

（批：D5310）

The 4th District Waterworks & Electricity
Trade Workers Union yesterday morning detailed
representatives to submit an appeal to the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai. There was no high official
present to receive the callers because they had all
left to participate in the ceremony of Mayor Wu Techen's
assuming the concurrent post of Garrison Commissioner
of Woosung and Shanghai.
The representatives then made an appeal to
the local Tanpu, the Social Bureau and the General
Labour Union for assistance.
Yesterday morning, several representatives
of the workers called on Mr. Ho Tuh-kwe, Associate
Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Council, to secure
information about the negotiations with the Company.
The callers were told to call at the Council in the
afternoon. At 4.30 p.m. the representatives called
again and were informed by Mr. Ho Tuh-kwe that Mr. Jones,
Secretary of the S.M.C. had discussed the matter with
the Company but owing to its firm attitude, nothing
had been done. The workers should resume work
immediately to prevent the trouble spreading.
It is reported that about 100 labour unions
have issued a long manifesto pledging their support
to the strikers.

S
The 4th District Waterworks and Electricity
Trade Workers Union yesterday sent the following letter
to the S.I.C.:-
"Our workers were formerly in the employ of
the Electricity Department of the Council. We were
given good treatment and there was sincere co-operation
between the workers and the employers. Therefore,
trouble seldom arose.
"Since the purchase of the Department by the
Shanghai Power Company, the latter has been making use of
this public utility enterprise as a means of enriching
a few individuals. The workers are frequently oppressed.
Although the Company has been in business for about
three years only, over 500 workers have already been
dismissed. The workers' benefits formerly given by the
Council have all been cancelled by the Company.
"In April this year, four workers were unreasonably
dismissed. We requested Messrs. Yu Yia Ching, Hsu Sing
Loh, and Yuan Li Teng, the Chinese members of the S.I.C.,
and Mr. Wang Hsao Lai of the Chamber of Commerce to
mediate, but the Company ignored the mediation.
Furthermore, the management of the Company has dismissed
two more long-service workers on the ground that they
were lazy. Recently a worker was also dismissed after
he had applied for three days' leave owing to serious
illness. The Company is now refusing to grant a pension
page_data.zh:
1933年10月3日。    晨间译稿。

劳工。

（批：D5310）

第四区水电行业工人工会昨日上午派遣代表向上海特别市政府提交请愿书。由于高官们均离去参加吴铁城市长兼任淞沪警备司令的就职典礼，现场无高官接待来访者。
随后，代表们向当地党部、社会局和总工会请求援助。
昨日上午，几名工人代表拜访了上海工部局副秘书何德奎（Ho Tuh-kwe，音译）先生，以了解与公司谈判的情况。来访者被告知下午再来工部局。下午4时30分，代表们再次来访，何德奎先生告知他们，工部局秘书琼斯（Jones）先生已与公司讨论此事，但由于公司态度强硬，未达成任何结果。工人应立即复工，以防止事态蔓延。
据报道，约有100个工会发表长篇宣言，承诺支持罢工者。

S
第四区水电行业工人工会昨日致函上海工部局（S.I.C.）：
“我方工人此前受雇于工部局电气处。当时待遇良好，劳资双方真诚合作。因此，鲜少发生纠纷。
“自上海电力公司收购该处以来，后者一直利用这一公用事业企业作为使少数人致富的手段。工人经常受到压迫。虽然公司经营仅约三年，但已有超过500名工人被解雇。此前由工部局提供的工人福利已被公司全部取消。
“今年四月，四名工人被无理解雇。我们请求工部局华董虞洽卿（Yu Yia Ching）、徐星洛（Hsu Sing Loh，音译）和袁履登（Yuan Li Teng，音译）先生，以及商会王晓籁（Wang Hsao Lai，音译）先生进行调解，但公司无视调解。此外，公司管理层又以懒惰为由解雇了两名长期服务的老工人。最近，一名工人因重病申请三天病假后也被解雇。公司现在拒绝发放养老金

page_data.en:
October 3, 1933.

LABOUR

（批：D5310）
（批：Cullin）

to the workers under the pretext that the Company had
the right to alter the regulations. All these acts are
unreasonable. Therefore, we have reluctantly decided
to declare a "go-slow" strike. We shall strictly
observe peace and order during the strike and no
unlawful action will be taken. As your former employees,
we request the Council to render us assistance."

The Shanghai Power Company yesterday issued a
statement in English denouncing the strike of the workers
in the new plant at Yangtzepoo as illegal because the
Company had not first been informed by the workers of
the reasons for the strike. The Company lays on the
workers the responsibility of endangering a public utility
service and local trade.

The general manager of the Power Company yesterday
issued a statement to the effect that the three workers
had been dismissed on account of bad conduct. As to
the sick worker, the Company did not dismiss him, he
had tendered his resignation. The present strike is
serious because the workers of the old plant are also
participating in the movement. The Company will devise
proper measures to maintain the supply of electricity in
the Settlement.

According to Loh Ching Sze of the District
Kueintang, the present strike was caused by the Company's
refusal to give a pension to the dismissed workers.
If the strike be continued for a long time, local peace
will be endangered.

1933年10月3日。
晨间译件

劳工

（批：D5310）
（批：Cullin）

以公司有权修改规章为借口对待工人。所有这些行为都是不合理的。因此，我们不得不决定宣布实行“怠工”罢工。在罢工期间，我们将严格遵守和平与秩序，不会采取任何非法行动。作为你们的前雇员，我们请求公董局给予我们援助。”

上海电力公司昨日发表英文声明，谴责杨树浦新厂工人的罢工为非法，理由是工人在罢工前未向公司通报罢工原因。公司将危及公用事业服务和地方贸易的责任归咎于工人。

电力公司总经理昨日发表声明称，三名工人因行为不端而被解雇。至于那名患病工人，公司并未将其解雇，而是他主动提出了辞职。目前的罢工形势严峻，因为老厂的工人也参与了此次运动。公司将制定适当措施，以维持租界内的电力供应。

据区党部罗青士（Loh Ching Sze，音译）称，此次罢工是由公司拒绝向被解雇工人发放养老金引起的。如果罢工长期持续，将危及地方治安。

page_data.en:
October 3, 3.

Labour (3)

Shanghai Power Company - situation

The strike of the 500 employees of the workshops
of the Riverside Power Station continues this morning.
In addition to the 456 men employed in the Fearon Road
Station, Yangchow Road and Haiphong Road Depots who
joined the strike on October 1 a further 240 from the
Riverside and Fearon Road plants including 10 workers of
the Tonquin Road Sub-Station participated in the strike
on October 2 making the total number of hands affected
up to 1,196. The absence of the Tonquin Road employees
it is reported, is due to intimidation by strike pickets
who visited the Sub-Station at noon yesterday.

The shift workers at the Riverside Power Station
all reported for work on October 2, whilst the 7 a.m.
shift to-day have all reported as usual. According to
reports from the Foreign engineers the situation there is
very quiet.

Three delegates of the strikers attended the office
of Mr. T.K. Ma, Chinese Secretary to the S.M.C. at 4.30 p.m.
October 2, when they were informed that the negotiations
with the Company had proved abortive.

Some eighty strikers held a meeting in the offices
of the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers' Union,
No.15 Shou Ting Fang, off Tiendeng Road, Chapei, between
5 and 7 p.m. October 2 when Chu Ah Fu (朱阿福) presided.
He stated that despite mediation by the S.M.C. the Management
of the Shanghai Power Company had refused to compromise. On
the contrary, they intimated that the Co. was prepared to cope
with any crisis arising out of the activities of the strikers.

（批：D5310）

10月3日，3。

劳工（3）

上海电力公司——局势

江边发电站车间500名员工的罢工今晨仍在继续。除了10月1日参加罢工的斐伦路（Fearon Road）电站、扬州路和海防路堆栈的456名员工外，10月2日又有240名来自江边和斐伦路电厂的工人（其中包括通北路（Tonquin Road）变电站的10名工人）参加了罢工，使受影响的工人总数达到1,196人。据报道，通北路员工缺勤是由于昨天中午前往该变电站的罢工纠察队进行恐吓所致。

江边发电站的轮班工人均于10月2日报到上班，而今天早7点的轮班工人也照常报到。据外籍工程师报告，那里的局势非常平静。

10月2日下午4时30分，三名罢工代表前往工部局华务秘书马特生（T.K. Ma）先生的办公室，被告知与公司的谈判已告失败。

10月2日下午5时至7时之间，约八十名罢工者在闸北天登路（Tiendeng Road）寿亭坊15号第四区水电工会办事处举行会议，由朱阿福主持。他表示，尽管工部局进行了调解，但上海电力公司管理层拒绝妥协。相反，他们暗示公司准备应对因罢工者活动而产生的任何危机。

（批：D5310）

page_data.en:
October 3, 3.

Labour (4)

Those present on learning of the Management's
decision became very indignant and decided to despatch
pickets to the vicinity of the Company's various premises
at 5 a.m. each morning to prevent any one from breaking
the strike.

Subsequently a secret meeting was held in an
inner room by some ten prominent agitators including
Chu Ah Foh and Tai Kao Tu (戴高土). It was decided to
ask the six foremen of the Riverside Power Station not
to turn up for duty on October 3, in return for which
they should be offered food and lodging at the expense
of the Union. Other resolutions reached at the meeting
were as follows:-

1. That efforts be made to get a number of strikers into the various power stations on the pretext of resuming work or some other excuse in order to induce the workers on 'shift' to join the strike, and to use violence against the wives and families of workers who persist in being loyal.

2. That all strikers, with the exception of those serving on Communication and Picketing Groups, be forbidden to go near any of the Company's premises and that any one ignoring the order be treated as strike breakers.

3. That efforts be made whenever possible to cause damage to the plant so as to embarrass the Company.

4. That these resolutions be secretly conveyed to members of the Communication and Picketing Groups for execution.

During the meeting it was also decided that in view of the activities of spies and running dogs of the Company who gained access to the meetings under the guise of being newspaper men, any stranger not vouched for by a member of the Union should be expelled from all

（批：D 5310 Canton）

在场人员得知管理层的决定后非常愤怒，决定每天凌晨5时向公司各场所附近派遣纠察队，以防止任何人破坏罢工。

随后，包括朱阿福（Chu Ah Foh）和戴高土（Tai Kao Tu，音译）在内的十余名主要煽动者在里间举行了一次秘密会议。会议决定要求江边发电站的六名领班在10月3日不要上班，作为交换，工会将承担他们的食宿费用。会议达成的其他决议如下：-

1. 设法以复工或其他借口让一批罢工者进入各个发电站，以诱导轮班工人加入罢工，并对坚持效忠公司的工人的妻子和家人使用暴力。

2. 除在联络组和纠察组服役的人员外，禁止所有罢工者靠近公司的任何场所，任何无视该命令的人将被视为破坏罢工者。

3. 尽可能设法破坏设备，以使公司陷入困境。

4. 将这些决议秘密传达给联络组和纠察组成员予以执行。

会议期间还决定，鉴于充当记者混入会议的为公司效力的间谍和走狗的活动，凡未经工会成员担保的陌生人，均应驱逐出所有

（批：D 5310 Canton）

At 10.45 a.m. October 2, four representatives of

10月2日上午10时45分，四名名为倪文富（Nyi Wen Fu）、陈宝根（Chen Pao Keng）、张才生（Chang Zai Sung）和潘庚龄（Pan Keng Ling，音译）的上海电力公司罢工代表前往市政府办公室，提交请愿书请求援助。工作人员建议他们将请愿书留在市政府，因为吴市长和其他市政府重要官员不在市内，而在龙华。来访者于上午11时离开。

1933年10月2日下午2时15分，包括倪文富和陈宝根在内的第四区水电工会的四名代表前往社会局，提交请愿书请求调解，以确保被解雇工人复职。接待他们的社会局职员彭振球（Pan Tseng Jui，音译）承诺将他们的请愿书转呈社会局局长。随后，来访者前往当地国民党部，会见了其中一名委员陆青士（Loh Ching Da，音译），后者承诺与社会局合作调查此事。来访者于下午3时离开。

October 3, 3.

Labour (6)

Beginning from 8.30 a.m. October 2, strikers of the
Shanghai Power Company appeared at the office of the
General Labour Union, 117 Foh Yeu Road, City, and in its
vicinity, and by 11.30 a.m. over 600 persons were present.
At 12.45 p.m. October 2, Pao Teh-foh (包德福), one
of the number, addressed some 100 persons on the premises of
the Union, reporting that during an interview, Mr. T.K.Ho,
Chinese Secretary to the S.M.C. stated that a reply would be
given at 4 p.m. October 2 as the negotiation with the Shanghai
Power Company was still in progress. He added that all
workers should persist in their demands. Nyi Wen-fu (倪文甫)
made a brief report on the appeal to the Shanghai Municipality
for assistance. Subsequently, one named Chang Foh-pao
(張福寶), claiming to represent the shift workers stated
that his comrades were quite willing to join the strike
provided the Strike Committee issued an order to that effect.
He remarked that the strike of the operation staff of shift
workers would produce no effect upon the service because
their work could be done by "white" Russians. Before
discussion, some ten workers took their departure declaring
that they were going to assault the strike breakers in the
Northern District. Subsequently Yih Ziang-kao (易祥高), a
Committee member of the General Labour Union urged the
attendance to unite together and fight against the capitalists
under the guidance of the General Labour Union, remarking that
the success of the movement depended upon the united strength
of the workers. In order to crown the movement with success,
all workers should abide by the instructions of the Union,
whereupon he distributed to the attendance copies of the
following two handbills :-

从10月2日上午8时30分开始，上海电力公司的罢工者出现在位于市区法租界法佑路（Foh Yeu Road，即今福州路或附近，此处依原文音译）117号的总工会办事处及其附近，到上午11时30分，已有600多人到场。10月2日中午12时45分，其中一人包德福（Pao Teh-foh，音译）在工会所在地对约100人发表讲话，报告说在一次会谈中，工部局华务秘书何德奎（T.K. Ho，音译，注：通常译为霍必兰或类似，此处依原文拼音及职位对应，实为何德奎或类似人物，但根据常见档案T.K. Ho常指何德奎或霍必兰，此处保留音译或通用译名，考虑到T.K. Ma是马特生，T.K. Ho可能是何德奎）先生表示，由于与上海电力公司的谈判仍在进行中，将于10月2日下午4时给予答复。他补充说，所有工人都应坚持他们的要求。倪文甫（Nyi Wen-fu，音译）简要报告了向上海市政府请求援助的情况。随后，一名自称代表轮班工人的张福宝（Chang Foh-pao，音译）表示，只要罢工委员会发出相应命令，他的同事们非常愿意加入罢工。他说，轮班操作人员的罢工不会对服务产生影响，因为他们的工作可以由“白俄”来完成。讨论开始前，约十名工人离开，声称要去北区袭击破坏罢工者。随后，总工会委员易祥高（Yih Ziang-kao，音译）敦促与会者在总工会的指导下团结起来对抗资本家，他指出运动的成功取决于工人的团结力量。为了使运动取得成功，所有工人都应遵守工会的指示，随即他向与会者分发了以下两份传单的副本：-

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
RECEIVED
October 2, 1935

Labour

Shanghai Power Company - Situation

The strike of the 500 employees in the workshops
of the Riverside Power Station continues this morning,
October 2.

D 5310

Only 100 out of a total of 376 operatives of the
Workshop, Stores, Transport Section, and the Operating
Division of the Pearson Road Power Station attended for
work, while the 100 men of the Yangchow Road Depot and
some 80 others of the Haiphong Road Depot failed to
report for duty. this morning.

At 9 a.m. September 30, the Bureau of Social Affairs
and the local Kuomintang detailed representatives to
collect information regarding the dispute in the Shanghai
Power Company.

At 9.50 a.m. September 30, about ten members of
the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers' Union
called at the Bureau of Social Affairs and appealed for
assistance in the existing dispute. They were told
that a careful investigation would be conducted into the
case.

At 11.45 a.m. September 30, the 500 strikers of the
Riverside Power Station, who gathered in the vicinity of
the Head Office of the Shanghai Power Company on the same
morning. (Vide I.R. 30/9/35) proceeded to the S.M.C.
Administration Building where four representatives
interviewed the Secretary of the Council, Mr. T.K. Ho,
Chinese Secretary to the Council and Miss Hunter for
assistance.

上海公共租界
收讫
1935年10月2日

劳工

上海电力公司——局势

江边发电站车间500名员工的罢工在今晨，10月2日，仍在继续。

D 5310

皮尔逊路（Pearson Road，即今北京西路或附近，依当时译名可能不同，此处保留音译或通用译名，通常指中央发电站相关设施）发电站车间、仓库、运输科和运营部的376名操作工中，只有100人上班，而扬州路堆栈的100名工人和海防路堆栈的约80名其他工人今晨未报到上班。

1935年9月30日上午9时，社会局和当地国民党派出代表收集有关上海电力公司纠纷的信息。

1935年9月30日上午9时50分，约十名第四区水电工会成员前往社会局，就现有纠纷请求援助。他们被告知将对案件进行仔细调查。

1935年9月30日上午11时45分，当天早上聚集在上海电力公司总办事处附近的江边发电站500名罢工者（参见1935年9月30日情报报告）前往工部局行政大楼，其中四名代表会见了公董局秘书、公董局华务秘书何特奎（T.K. Ho）先生和亨特小姐（Miss Hunter），请求援助。

Mr. Jones explained to the callers that he was
not conversant with the conditions under which they were
employed but that he would take the matter up with
Mr. Heald of the Shanghai Power Company and render a
reply on Monday, October 2. The representatives left
at about 12.25 p.m. whilst the group of about 400 men
dispersed about ten minutes later.

In order to avoid intimidation by the strikers,
the workers on "shift work" have for the past two days
been accommodated on the premises of the Riverside Power
Station, food etc. having been provided at the expense
of the Company.

Some 100 members of the 4th District Water and
Electricity Workers' Union held a meeting in their office at
15 Shou Ying Paung, Tien Doeng Road, Chapei, between 3 and

following resolutions were passed :-

2. That should negotiations by the S.M.C. prove abortive

3. That pickets be sent to the homes of those who do not

劳工（2）

琼斯先生向来访者解释称，他并不熟悉他们受雇的具体条件，但他会就此事与上海电力公司的希尔德先生进行交涉，并于10月2日星期一给予答复。代表们于下午12时25分左右离开，而约400人的群体则在大约十分钟后散去。

为了避免受到罢工者的恐吓，过去两天里，“轮班”工人被安置在江边发电站的厂区内，食物等由公司出资提供。

9月30日下午3时至5时之间，第四区水电工会约100名会员在闸北天潼路寿英坊15号的办事处举行会议，当地国民党及总工会的代表也出席了会议。会议通过了以下决议：-

1. 请求工部局总董代表工人与上海电力公司进行谈判，并对那些继续工作的人采取严厉行动。

2. 如果工部局的谈判证明无效，则于10月2日向有关当局进一步申诉，且在得到明确答复之前，代表们不得撤离。

Seventeen Chinese journalists were entertained in the

page_data.en:
October 2, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

According to the Shanghai Power Company,
the recent dismissal of three workers was due to the
following cases:- (1) sickness, (2) laziness, and
(3) sleeping in the machinery room.
The hands contend that these causes did not
constitute sufficient grounds for dismissal because
the worker who was dismissed on account of sickness
had been granted 3 days' sick leave by the doctor of
the Company. He did not call at the factory to request
for an extension of the sick leave because he had not
yet fully recovered.
As regards the hand who was dismissed because
of laziness, the Company gave no details of the particular
occasion or occasions when he was said to have been lazy.
The allegations against the third dismissed
worker of having slept in the machinery room were
regarded by the Union as untenable, because it was a
physical impossibility for any worker to sleep with the
electrical machines in operation. Furthermore, nobody
had seen him asleep in the room nor had the foremen of
the room made any report in this connection.
The Union is not demanding the reinstatement
of the 3 dismissed men but for the payment according to
the Rules of a pension of 5% of the total pay received
during the period of his employment. Such payment is
provided in the Rules which were drawn up at the time
when the plant was sold by the Shanghai Municipal Council
to the Shanghai Power Company.
Representatives of the Union have twice made
an appeal to the Company but without result.
According to the management, workers who are
dismissed for committing faults or who resign will not
be granted a pension.
The Company has violated the rules. As the
Company had no adequate explanation , it claimed that
it had the right to amend the Rules. The object of the
present "go-slow" strike is to secure the enforcement
of the original Rules.
In view of the fact that the electricity
service is of great importance to the citizens
throughout the whole of the Municipality, the entire
body of workers of the Shanghai Power Company will not
resort to a general strike. Therefore, only the regular
hands of the new factory are on a "go-slow" strike;
the workers of the machinery room and of the old factory
have not joined the movement because the strike of
workers of the machinery room would affect the whole of
the Municipality. The workers are paying great attention
to this matter and will not allow the trouble to become
serious.

（批：D.5210）
page_data.zh:
1933年10月2日。晨间译稿。

劳工。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的劳工局势。

据上海电力公司称，近期解雇三名工人是由于以下情况：(1) 患病，(2) 懒惰，以及 (3) 在机房睡觉。
工人们争辩说，这些理由不足以构成解雇的依据，因为因病被解雇的工人已获得公司医生批准的三天病假。他未去工厂申请延长病假，是因为他尚未完全康复。
至于因懒惰被解雇的工人，公司并未提供他被指懒惰的具体场合或次数的细节。
工会认为针对第三名被解雇工人在机房睡觉的指控站不住脚，因为在电气机器运行的情况下，任何工人都不可能睡觉。此外，没有人看到他在房间里睡觉，机房领班也未就此作出任何报告。
工会并不要求复职这三名被解雇的人员，而是要求按照规章支付相当于其受雇期间总收入5%的养老金。此类支付规定见于上海公共租界工部局将电厂出售给上海电力公司时制定的规章中。
工会代表曾两次向公司提出申诉，但均无结果。
据管理层称，因犯错被解雇或辞职的工人将不授予养老金。
公司违反了规章。由于公司没有充分的解释，它声称有权修改规章。目前“怠工”罢工的目的是为了确保执行原始规章。
鉴于电力服务对整个上海市的市民至关重要，上海电力公司的全体工人不会采取总罢工。因此，只有新厂的正式工人正在进行“怠工”罢工；机房和老厂的工人没有加入这一运动，因为机房工人的罢工会影响整个上海市。工人们非常关注此事，不会让事态变得严重。

（批注：D.5210）
