D.C. (-RIME)

October 1, 1933.    Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News, the Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

THE WORKERS OF THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

Immediately after the declaration of a
"go-slow" strike by its workers on September 29, the
Shanghai Power Company put up a notice intimating that
unless the strikers resumed work by 1 p.m. the same day,
they would be discharged. As the strikers did not return
to work, the Company issued the following notice .
yesterday morning:-
"Those workers attached to the new factory
who left their duties may call for their wages at the
Badges Room of the new factory, Yangtsepoo, on October 3."
At 7 a.m. yesterday, the strikers returned
at the working hour, but their entry was stopped by the
management.
Alleging that this action on the part of the
management means that they have been discharged, the
1,000 workers at 8.30 a.m. marched in groups to the
General Office of the Company on Kiangsi Road to open
negotiations. The hands demanded the payment of pension.
They selected 5 representatives to interview "Eldar",
the General Manager of the Company, but he refused to
see them. The hands dispersed at 11.46 a.m. on the
advice of detectives and policemen.
During the procession to the General Office,
four workers were arrested but were released at 11.30 a.m.
Four representatives of the workers were
then detailed to call on Mr. Fessenden, Secretary-General
of the Shanghai Municipal Council, to report on the
dismissal of workers without cause. The callers were
informed that the Secretary-General would find a settle-
ment of the dispute, and were advised to await for a
reply on the morning of October 2.
At 9.30 a.m. yesterday, officials of the local
Tangpu, the Social Bureau and the General Labour Union
called at the General Office and made an investigation .
into the trouble. They advised the General Manager to
grant the demands but this was ignored.
At 3 p.m. yesterday, the 4th District Water-
works & Electricity Trade Workers Union held a meeting
at which about 100 chiefs of various departments of both
the old and the new factories of the Company were present.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That a "Go-slow" Strike Committee of 13 members,
7 from the new factory and 6 from the old factory, be
formed.
2. That the hands of the old and the new factories
act in harmony.
3. That a propaganda section, a communications section
and a maintenance section be formed.

In an interview yesterday with our reporter,
one of the strikers stated that October 1 being Sunday,

D.C. (-RIME)

1933年10月1日。晨间译稿。

劳工。

《华中日报》、《申报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司的工人。

在其工人于9月29日宣布“怠工”罢工后，上海电力公司立即张贴通告，暗示除非罢工者在当天下午1时前复工，否则将被解雇。由于罢工者未返回工作岗位，公司于昨天上午发布了以下通告：
“附属新厂离职的工人可于10月3日到杨树浦新厂的徽章室领取工资。”
昨天上午7时，罢工者在上班时间返回，但被管理层阻止进入。
声称管理层的这一行为意味着他们已被解雇，这1,000名工人于上午8时30分分批前往江西路的公司总办事处进行谈判。工人们要求支付养老金。他们选出5名代表去会见公司总经理“Eldar”（音译），但他拒绝接见他们。上午11时46分，在侦探和警察的建议下，工人们散去。
在前往总办事处的游行过程中，四名工人被捕，但于上午11时30分获释。
随后，四名工人代表被指派去拜访上海公共租界工部局秘书长费森登先生，汇报无故解雇工人的情况。来访者被告知，秘书长将寻求解决纠纷，并建议他们等待10月2日上午的答复。
昨天上午9时30分，当地塘沽（音译）、社会局和总工会的官员前往总办事处，对此次纠纷进行了调查。他们建议总经理满足要求，但被无视。
昨天下午3时，第四区水电行业工会举行会议，公司新老两厂各部门的约100名主管出席。会议通过了以下决议：-
1. 成立一个由13名成员组成的“怠工”罢工委员会，其中新厂7人，老厂6人。
2. 老厂和新厂的工人协调行动。
3. 成立宣传部、联络部和维持部。

在昨天接受本报记者采访时，一名罢工者表示，由于10月1日是星期日，

September 30, 3.

Labour
(4)
Shanghai Power Company - situation

The strike of the 500 employees in the workshops of
the Riverside Power Station continues this morning.
At 11 a.m. September 29, the management posted
copies of a notice in both English and Chinese as follows
in the Compound of the Riverside Power Station :-

"Interruption of Work

"It has come to the Company's notice that owing to
"the recent discharge of two men for misconduct
"and also the resignation of a third man, that the
"staff are under the impression that the Company are
"attempting to reduce staff without paying bonus.
"This is definitely not the case - any man discharged
"through no fault of his own, or owing to shortage
"of work will be paid his bonus in accordance with
"regulations.

"All men who are not found to be at work at 1 p.m.
"will be discharged and steps taken to replace those
"absent where necessary."

Several copies of this notice were torn down by the workers.

At 1 p.m. the strikers showed no signs of
returning to work and were allowed to remain in the mess
room until 5 p.m. when they quietly left the premises.

During the period spent in the mess room the strikers
were addressed by numbers of their fellows on the subject
of the recent dismissals.
page_data.zh:
9月30日，3。

劳工
(4)
上海电力公司——局势

江边发电站车间500名雇员的罢工今晨仍在继续。
9月29日上午11时，管理层在江边发电站大院内张贴了中英文告示副本，内容如下：

“工作中断

“本公司获悉，由于近期因行为不端解雇了两名员工，
“以及第三名员工辞职，致使职员们误以为本公司
“试图在不支付奖金的情况下削减人员。
“事实绝非如此——任何非因自身过错或因工作量不足
“而被解雇的人员，将按规定发放其奖金。

“凡下午1时未到岗工作的人员，均将被解雇，并将在
“必要时采取措施替换缺勤者。”

该告示的几份副本被工人撕毁。

下午1时，罢工者没有表现出复工的迹象，获准留在食堂直至下午5时，随后他们安静地离开了厂区。

在滞留食堂期间，许多工友就近期解雇事件向罢工者发表了讲话。

page_data.en:
September 30, 3.

Labour (5)

200 members of the 4th District Water & Electricity
Workers' Union held a meeting in their office at 15 Sheu
Ying Faung, Tien Dong Road, Chapei, between 7.30 and 9 p.m.
September 29 when Pan Keng-ling ( ), ex worker and
staff member of the Union, stated that as soon as the strike
was declared, three members of the Union instantly proceeded
to the local Kuomintang and applied for assistance. He
added that in reply the responsible person of the Kuomintang
explained the difficulty in mediating in the dispute
owing to the uncompromising attitude of the management but
promised to send two representatives to the Riverside
Power Station to see what could be done to relieve the
situation. After some discussion, it was decided that
all workers turn up as usual on the morning of September 30
and that should the management refuse them admission all
should proceed in a body to the office of the company on
Nanking Road. It was further agreed that the workers
of the Fearon Road Power Station would join the strike on
September 30.

Copies of a notice purporting to emanate from the
Appeal Committee of the 4th District Water & Electricity
Workers' Union which is dated September 30, 1935, were
issued to the strikers on September 29. A summarized
translation of this pamphlet reads as follows :-

（批：D.5310 / Cauthin）

9月30日，3。

劳工 (5)

第四区水电工会的200名成员于9月29日晚7时30分至9时，在闸北天通庵路（Tien Dong Road）秀英坊15号的工会办公室举行会议。会上，前工会工人及职员潘庚龄（Pan Keng-ling，音译）表示，罢工一经宣布，三名工会成员立即前往当地国民党部请求援助。他补充说，国民党负责人答复称，鉴于管理层态度强硬，调解纠纷存在困难，但承诺派遣两名代表前往江边发电站，看看能采取何种措施缓解局势。经过讨论，决定所有工人于9月30日上午照常上班，若管理层拒绝其入内，则全体集体前往南京路的公司办事处。会议还商定，斐伦路（Fearon Road）发电站的工人将于9月30日加入罢工。

9月29日向罢工者分发了一份据称出自第四区水电工会申诉委员会的通知副本，日期为1935年9月30日。该传单的内容摘要翻译如下：

（批注：D.5310 / Cauthin）

page_data.en:
Labour (5)

Shanghai Power Company - 'tai-kung' strike at
Riverside Station

At 2.30 p.m. September 28 a deputation
of the Riverside Power Station interviewed
Generation Engineer and demanded the issue
gratuity to a worker who was dismissed on □
for misconduct. This demand was turned down and
deputation left.. The same evening a number of □
who had been instructed to work overtime refused
as they wished to attend a meeting to discuss □
of the retiring gratuity to the dismissed employee
7 a.m. this morning, however, the morning shift □
up at their places, but 90% of their number, about
declared a "tai-kung" strike which continues. The
Company is now considering what steps to take to deal
with the strikers although neither side has opened
negotiations for a settlement of the dispute.

（批：S）
page_data.zh:
劳工 (5)

上海电力公司——江边发电站“怠工”罢工

9月28日下午2时30分，江边发电站代表团面见发电工程师，要求向一名于□因行为不端被解雇的工人发放遣散费。该要求被拒绝，代表团随即离开。当晚，一些被指令加班的□拒绝加班，因为他们希望参加关于被解雇员工退休金的讨论□。然而，今晨7时，早班□到岗，但其中约90%的人宣布进行“怠工”（tai-kung）罢工，且持续至今。公司目前正在考虑采取何种措施应对罢工者，尽管双方均未开启解决纠纷的谈判。

（批注：D5310）
（批注：S）

page_data.en:
September 30, 3.

Labour (6)

（批：D5310 / Comlin）

"This time, the management dismissed workers without
"reason and has deprived them of their superannuation
"fund which they have saved up as a result of their hard
"work. Representatives have been sent to submit demands
"to the management but of no avail. Feeling enraged,
"the workers declared a "tai-kung" strike yesterday.
"We have, however, discovered that the workers of the
""three-shifts" are still working which undoubtedly
"impedes the progress of negotiation. Consequently it
"is sincerely expected that these workers will join
"the strike at once in conformity with the general wish.
"It has been decided to assemble in the Mess Room at
"7 a.m. and anyone ignoring this will be dealt with
"accordingly."

A notice purporting to emanate from the same organ
and urging workers to unite together to fight against
the management, which was dated September 28, 1933, was
found in the Mess Room of the Riverside Power Station
on September 29.

At 7.30 a.m. September 30, the 500 strikers presented
themselves at the gates of the Power Station in question,
whereupon the Time-keepers commenced to pick out the
men of good character whom the management intended to
re-employ. The strikers, however, decided not to
accept this arrangement and left.
page_data.zh:
9月30日，3。

劳工 (6)

（批注：D5310 / Comlin）

“此次，管理层无故解雇工人，并剥夺了他们通过辛勤工作积攒的养老金基金。已派代表向管理层提出诉求，但毫无结果。工人们感到愤怒，于昨日宣布‘怠工’罢工。然而，我们发现‘三班倒’的工人仍在上班，这无疑阻碍了谈判的进展。因此，真诚期望这些工人顺应大众意愿，立即加入罢工。已决定于上午7时在食堂集合，无视此规定者将受到相应处理。”

9月29日，在江边发电站食堂发现了一份据称出自同一机构、号召工人团结起来对抗管理层的通告，日期为1933年9月28日。

9月30日上午7时30分，500名罢工者出现在该发电站大门前，随即考勤员开始挑选管理层打算重新雇用的品行良好的工人。然而，罢工者决定不接受这一安排并离开。

page_data.en:
September 30, 1933.

Labour (7)

On arrival at the Fearon Road Station, the strikers
discovered the gate of the Station closed and having
failed to get into communication with the workers inside,
the crowd, numbering about 100, proceeded to Nanking Road
and joined their comrades in the vicinity of the Shanghai
Power Company, corner of Nanking and Kiangsi Roads. The
number of workers increased to about 500 by 9 a.m. when
the management informed representatives of the strikers
that pay for the dismissed workers would be issued at
9 a.m. October 3 at the Riverside Power Station.
page_data.zh:
1933年9月30日。

劳工 (7)

罢工者抵达斐伦路发电站后，发现站门紧闭，且未能与内部工人取得联系，于是这支约100人的队伍前往南京路，在南京路与江西路交界处的上海电力公司附近与同伴汇合。至上午9时，工人人数增至约500人，此时管理层告知罢工者代表，被解雇工人的工资将于10月3日上午9时在江边发电站发放。

September 30, 1933.    Morning Translation

LABOUR

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

GO-SLOW STRIKE OF SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY WORKERS

The dispute over the dismissal of several
foremen by the Shanghai Power Company has not yet been
settled.
On September 27, the Company dismissed three more
workers without cause and refused to pay them a
retirement gratuity. On September 28 the workers
elected five representatives to lodge a protest with
the Company.
Angered at the attitude of the Company, the entire
number of 1,000 workers in the new Power Plant went
on a go-slow strike at 7 a.m. yesterday. The workers
in the Nos.3 and 4 Departments remained at their duties
as usual.
After the declaration of the go-slow strike, the
strikers assembled in the dining room. Unexpectedly,
a foreigner named "Hai Ai", manager of the Boiler Room,
locked the door of the dining room. Fearing that this
might cause accidents, "Ai Er Men", Chief of the Plant,
opened the door.
The Company has issued the following notices:-
"This Company has dismissed three workers because
of bad conduct. Retirement gratuity will not be issued
when workers are dismissed for bad behaviour. The
entire body of workers must return to duty at 1 p.m..
to-day,(September 29), otherwise they will be dismissed
immediately and new hands will be engaged".

At 2 p.m. the 4th District Waterworks and
Electricity Labour Union detailed five representatives
to request the District Kuomintang to investigate and
to order the Company to issue the retirement gratuity
to the dismissed workers.
They were told that the case would be handled with
the co-operation of the Bureau of Social Affairs.
The workers made a similar appeal to the Social
Bureau in the afternoon.
The 4th District Waterworks and Electricity Workers
Labour Union yesterday issued a circular notice to the
workers relating the dismissal of a worker for being
absent from duty for three days on account of sickness.
The circular denounces the strong attitude taken up by the
Company and its oppression of workers. The workers
were requested to struggle unitedly against the capitalists.

The notice issued by the Company was torn off by
the strikers who then held a meeting at 3.30 p.m. in
the dining room at which the following resolutions were
passed:-
1. That no unlawful activities be undertaken by the
strikers.
2. That no resistance be offered should an attempt be made
to drive them out of the Plant by force.

（批：D.5310）

1933年9月30日。    晨间译文

劳工

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电力公司工人怠工罢工

上海电力公司解雇数名领班引发的纠纷尚未解决。
9月27日，公司又无故解雇了三名工人，并拒绝支付其退休遣散费。9月28日，工人们选出五名代表向公司提出抗议。
因对公司的态度感到愤怒，新发电厂的全部1000名工人于昨日上午7时开始怠工罢工。第三和第四部门的工人照常履行职责。
宣布怠工罢工后，罢工者在餐厅集合。出乎意料的是，名为“海爱”（Hai Ai，音译）的锅炉房经理锁上了餐厅的门。担心这可能引发事故，厂长“艾尔门”（Ai Er Men，音译）打开了门。
公司发布了以下通知：
“本公司因行为不端解雇了三名工人。因行为不端被解雇的工人不予发放退休遣散费。全体工人必须于今日（9月29日）下午1时返岗，否则将立即被解雇并雇佣新人”。

下午2时，第四区水电工会派出五名代表，请求区党部调查并命令公司向被解雇工人发放退休遣散费。
他们被告知，此案将在社会局的配合下处理。
工人们于下午向社会局提出了类似的诉求。
第四区水电工会昨日向工人发布了一份通告，涉及一名工人因病缺勤三天而被解雇一事。该通告谴责公司采取的强硬态度及其对工人的压迫。呼吁工人团结起来对抗资本家。

公司发布的通告被罢工者撕毁，随后他们于下午3时30分在餐厅举行会议，通过了以下决议：
1. 罢工者不进行任何非法活动。
2. 若有人试图强行将他们驱离工厂，不予抵抗。

（批注：D.5310）

From the time the o.1i.%.D. was established until it 
was handed over to the Shanghai wower Company a period of twenty

the period of peace is past, and everything goes wrong, showing

(2) Disregard of employees service conditions and rights. 
During the control of the electricity supply by the 
S.12.C. every worker who completed twenty years service was 
entitled to receive a gratuity equal to 5% of his wages. This 
is a modern means of encouraging workers to peacefully and 
conscienciously perform their duties, by which the S.11.C. gained 
/ good results without trouble during their twenty years of 
/ management. After the enterprise had been transferred to thé 
~?) present Company labour disputes instantly broke out owing largely 
to the dismissal of workers for trivial causes. The Company 
imposes unreasonable conditions upon its employees, and actsas 
if they could be justified. The question of the issue of the 
5% gratuity is the cause of all the trouble. The General Labour 
Union admits that the revised regulations goverr LOS the issue of 
the gratuity made by the Company are better than/old ones. On 
the other hand, the Company is dismissing employees who, in the + 
majority, have served for more than ten years. These workers 
were refused their shares of the gratuity on certain charges 
intentionally made by the Company. It is beyond @oubt that the 
Company discharges old hands and refuses to pay their gratuities, 
and replaces them by new men at cheaper wages. High wages and 
_ gratuities are the rights of workers; it is unjust to deprive 
them of their rights. During May, 1932, some 128 workers were 
discharged and the Company employed new hands in their place, 
a fact beyond refutation. The Union does not oppose propsr 
measures adopted by any company to reduce expenses owing to 
trade depression, but the censumption of vlectricity increases 
day by day, and the Company's income increases in propertion. 
The Company moreever has increase. its charges. It is evident 
that the circumstances’ of the Company do not justify the 
“reduction of the staff. On the contrary, the Company should 
provide better conditions for its employees. For instance, 
the foreign eaployees are permitted to have annual short leave 
ranging from two weeks to a month in addition to long leave.

Furthermore, the foreign staff are entitlec to study free of

of their monthly wages an@ gives them.a high rate of intcrest,;

- , There have been so many untruthful statements made in

"The pension-for workmen, which at the S.M.C. time were
